title: Siddur Edot HaMizrach
versionTitle: Publicado em 5784, Saymon Pires da Silva [pt]

Modeh Ani: De acordo com o ensino de sua Mishná, ele deve dizer.
"Modê ani lifanecha Melech chai vekayam shehechezarta bi nishmati bchemlá, rabá emunatêcha." A mulher diz: "Modá ani lifanecha Melech chai vekayam shehechezarta bi nishmati bchemlá, rabá emunatêcha."
Morning Blessings: Bênção da Manhã

Faça suas necessidades primeiro, e depois recite a bênção sobre a lavagem das mãos e Asher Yatsar (Ben Ish Chai, Vayetse 2). Depois de lavar as mãos, imediatamente eleve as mãos e os dedos para cima, erguendo-os até a altura da cabeça ou, no mínimo, até a altura do rosto, e então recite a bênção sobre a lavagem das mãos (Ben Ish Chai, Toledot 4). Se ele permaneceu acordado a noite toda, não recite a bênção, mas apenas lave as mãos sem bênção (ibid. 13).
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu mêlech haolam, asher kidshanu bemitzvotav vetzivanu al netilat yadayim.
Se urinou ou fez suas necessidades, recite a bênção dentro de meia hora (Ben Ish Chai, Vayetse 12).

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu mêlech haolam, asher yatsar et haadam bechochma, uvaram vo necavim necavim, chalulim chalulim. Galui veiadua lifnei chisse chevodecha, sheim yissatem echad mehem, o im yipateach echad mehem, ee efshar lehitkayem afilu shaá achat. Baruch ata Adonai, rofe chol bassar umaflí laassot.
Pode-se apoiar esta bênção de "Elokai..." na bênção de Asher Yatsar (Ben Ish Chai, Vayeshev 2).

Elohai, neshama shenatat bi tehorah, atah berataha, ataha yetsartaha, ataha nefachtaha bi, veata meshameraha bekirbi, veata atid letelah meimeni, ulehachaziraha bi leatid lavo. Kol zman sheneshama bekirbi, modeh (a mulher diz modah) ani lefanecha Adonai Elohai veilohei avotai, ribon kol hamaasim adon kol haneshamot. Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir neshamot lefigrim metim.
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, hanoten lashevii bina, lehavchin bein yom uvein lailah:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, pokeach ivrim:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, matir asurim:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, zokef kefufim:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, malbish arumim:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, hanotein layaef koach:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, roka haaretz al hamayim:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, hameichin mitzaadei gaver:
No nono dia de Av e no Yom Hakipurim não se diz esta bênção (Beit Yosef, Orech Chaim 46:9)
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, sheasa li kol tzarchi:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, ozer Yisrael bigvurah:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, oter Yisrael betifarah:
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, shelo asani goi: A mulher diz: goya
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, shelo asani eved: A mulher diz: shifcha
O homem faz a bênção
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, shelo asani isha:
A mulher faz a bênção sem mencionar o Nome de Deus (Ad-onai) e sem mencionar 'Melech HaOlam' (Rei do Universo).
Baruch sheasani kiratzono:

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, hamaavir chevlei shena meeinai vetenumah meafapai. Veyehei ratzon milefanecha Adonai, Elohai veElohei avotai, shetargileini betoratecha, vetadbikeyni bemitzvotecha, veal teviyeni lidei chet, velo lidei avon, velo lidei nisayon, velo lidei bizayon, vetarchikeini miyeitzer hara, vetadbikeyni biyeitzer hatov, vecof et-yitzri lehishtaved lach, uteneni hayom uvchol-yom lechen ulechesed ule'rachamim be'einecha uve'einei chol-ro'ai, vegomleni chasadim tovim. Baruch ata Adonai, gomel chasadim tovim le'amo Yisrael:

Yehi ratzon milefanecha Adonai, Elohai veElohei avotai, shetatzileini hayom uvchol yom vayom, meazei panim, umeazut panim, meadam ra, meyeitzer ra, mechaver ra, mishachen ra, mipega ra, meayin hara, umilashon hara, midin kashé, umibaal din kashé, bein shehu ben-brit, uvein sheeno ben-brit:
Torah Blessings: Baruch ata Adonai, Elohênu mêlech haolam, asher kidshanu bemitzvotáv vetsivanu al divrei Torá.

Vehaerêv na, Adonai Elohênu, et-divrei Toratcha befifiot amcha Beit Yisra'el, venihyeh anachnu vetzeatzaeinu, vetzeatzaei tzeatzaeinu, culanu yodeê shemcha, velomdei Toratcha lishmah. Baruch ata Adonai, hamelamed Torá leamo Yisra'el.
Baruch ata Adonai, Elohênu mêlech haolam, asher bachar banu mikol-haamim venatan lanu et-Torato. Baruch ata Adonai, notên haTorá.

Vayedaber Adonai el-Moshe lemor: Daber el-Aharon veel-banav lemor: Koh tevarechu et-bnei Yisra'el amor lahem: Yevarechecha Adonai veyishmirecha. Yaer Adonai panav eilecha viyunnecha. Yissa Adonai panav eilecha veyasêm lecha shalom. Vesamu et-shemi al-bnei Yisra'el vaani avarechem.

LeShem Yichud: Seder Tikum Chazot(Ordem da Correção da Meia-Noite)

Não recitamos Tikkun Chatzot na noite de Shabat, Rosh Hashaná, Yom Kipur, Pesach, Shavuot, Sukkot, Shemini Atzeret e Chol Hamoed de Pesach. Não recitamos Tikkun Rachel e recitamos Tikkun Leah nos dias em que não se diz Tachanun (como Shabat, Rosh Hashaná, Yom Kipur, Pesach, Shavuot, Sukkot, Shemini Atzeret, Chol Hamoed, Rosh Chodesh, durante os Dez Dias de Teshuvá entre Rosh Hashaná e Yom Kipur, no período de Ômer entre Pesach e Shavuot, após a lua nova antes de Rosh Chodesh mesmo que haja confissão nesse dia, na casa de um enlutado, na casa do noivo, e para o pai de um filho de até 30 dias pois é seu próprio dia de festa, e no ano de Shemita em Eretz Yisrael). As mulheres não recitam Tikkun Chatzot, e uma vez que amanhece não se deve recitar Tikkun Chatzot, nem Tikkun Rachel nem Tikkun Leah. Ao meio-dia dos dias entre as angústias (Bein Hametzarim), recitamos Tikkun Rachel. L'shem ichud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchintei, b'dchilu ur'chimu, ur'chimu udchilu, l'yachda shem Yud Kei Vav Kei b'ichuda shlem, b'shem col Yisrael. Hareini mukan lomar Tikkun Rachel v'Tikkun Leah (em dias especiais como Shabat, Rosh Hashaná, Yom Kipur, Pesach, Shavuot, Sukkot, Shemini Atzeret, Chol Hamoed, Rosh Chodesh, durante os Dez Dias de Teshuvá, no período de Ômer, após a lua nova antes de Rosh Chodesh, na casa de um enlutado, na casa do noivo, e para o pai de um filho de até 30 dias pois é seu próprio dia de festa, e no ano de Shemita em Eretz Yisrael, dizemos apenas: Tikkun Leah. Ou: Tikkun Rachel.) como nossos Rabênu zecheronom livracha ordenaram, para corrigir suas raízes (sua raiz) em um lugar elevado, para proporcionar conforto ao nosso Criador e fazer a vontade de nosso Criador. E seja o favor de Adonai Eloheinu sobre nós, e estabeleça a obra de nossas mãos sobre nós; sim, estabeleça a obra de nossas mãos.

Ana Adonai Eloheinu veElohei Avoteinu, tavo lefanêcha tefilateinu, veal tit'allem malkeinu mitchinatênu, sheein anachnu azêi panim ukeshei oref lomar lefanêcha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei Avoteinu tzadikim anachnu velo chatanu. Aval chatanu, avinu, pasheinu, anachnu vaavoteinu veanshei veiteinu: ashameinu, bagadnu, gazalnu, dibarnu dofí uleshon hara, heevinu, vehirshánu, zadnu, chamásnu, tafalnu sheker umirmah, yaatsnu etsot raot, kizavnu, kaasnu, latznu, maradnu, marinu devarêcha, niatsnu, niapnu, sararnu, avinu, pasheinu, pagamnu, tsararnu, tsiarunu av vaem, kishinu oref, rashánu, shichatnu, tiavnu, ta'inu vetiaateanu, vesarnu mimitzvotecha umimishpatecha hatovim velo shavah lanu. Veatah tzadik al kol haba aleinu, ki emet asita, vaanachnu hirshanu.

Mah-nomar lefanecha yoshev marom, u’mah-nesaper lefanecha shochêin shechakim? Halo chol-hanistarot v’haniglot atah yodea, atah yodea razei olam, v’ta’alumot siteri chol-chai, atah chofer chol-chadrei beten, roêh chelavot v’lev, ein davar ne’elam mimmecha, v’ein nistar mineged einecha. Yehi ratzon milfanecha, Adonai Eloheinu v’Elohei avoteinu, shetimchol lanu et-kol-chatateinu, utchapeir lanu et-kol-avonoteinu, v’timchol v’tislah l’chol-pesha’einu.
Tikkun Rachel: Al naharot Bavel, sham yashavnu gam bachinu, bezochreinu et Tziyon. Al aravim betocha talinu kinoroteinu. Ki sham sheilununu shovênu divrei shir vetolaleinu simcha: "Shiru lanu mishir Tziyon." Eich nashir et shir Adonai al admat nechar? Im eshkachech Yerushalayim, tishkach yemini. Tidbak leshoni lechiki im lo ezkerêch, im lo aaleh et Yerushalayim al rosh simchati. Zchor Adonai livnei Edom et yom Yerushalayim, haomrim: "Ar'u, ar'u ad hayesod bah." Bat Bavel hashduda, asherê sheshalem lach et gemulêch shegamalt lanu. Ashre sheyocheiz venifetz et olaleich el hasela.

Mizmor leAsaf: Elohim, ba'u goyim benachalatecha tim'u et heichal kodshecha samu et Yerushalayim leiei. Natnu et nevlat avadecha ma'achal leof hashamayim, besar chasidecha lechayat ha'aretz. Shafchu damam kamayim svivot Yerushalayim ve'ein kover. Hayinu cherpa lishcheneinu, laag vakeles lisvivoteinu. Ad matai Adonai te'anaf l'anetzach? Tivaer kemo eish kinat'cha. Shfoch chamatecha el hagoyim asher lo yedauchah ve'al mamlechot asher beshimcha lo karau. Ki achal et Yaakov ve'et navehu hashamu. Al tizkor lanu avonot rishonim, mahaer yekadmuna rachameicha ki dalnu meod. Ozerênu Elohei yisheinu al davar kavod shimcha vehatzileinu vechapeir al chatoteinu lema'an shimcha. Lamah yomru hagoyim: "Ayei Eloheihem?" Yivada bagoyim le'eineinu nekamat dam avadecha hashafuch. Tavo lefanêcha enkat asir, kegodel zeroa'echa hoter benei temutah. Vehashiv lishcheneinu shivatayim el cheikam cherpatam asher cherfucah Adonai. Vanachnu amecha vetzon mar'itecha nodeh lach le'olam ledor vador nesapper tehilatecha.

Zchor Adonai meh haya lanu, habet ureh et cherpateinu. Nachalateinu nehafchah lezarim, batteinu lenochrim. Yatomim hayinu ve'ein av, imoteinu ke'almanot. Meimeinu bechesef shat'inu, etzeinu bemechir yavo'u. Al tzavareinu nirdafnu, yaga'nu velo hunach lanu. Mitzrayim natnu yad, Ashur lisseva lechem. Avoteinu chat'u ve'einam, vanachnu avonoteihem sabalnu. Avadim mashlu vanu, porek ein miyadam. Benafshenu navim lachmeinu mipnei cherev hamidbar. Orênu ketanur nichmaru mipnei zalafot ra'av. Nashim betziyon inu, betulot be'arei Yehudah. Sarim beyadam nitlu, penei zekenim lo nehedaru. Bachurim techon nasau, vene'arim ba'etz kashalu. Zekenim mish'ar shabatu, bachurim mineginatam. Shavat mesos livaveinu, nehefach le'avel mecholênu. Nafelah ateret roshênu, oyi na lanu ki chatanu. Al zeh haya daveh libênu, al eleh chashchu eineinu. Al har Tziyon sheshameim, shualim halchu vo. Atah Adonai le'olam teshev, kis'acha ledor vador. Lamah l'anetzach tishkacheinu ta'azveinu le'orech yamim. Hashiveinu Adonai eilecha venashuvah, chadesh yameinu kekedem. Ki im ma'os me'as'tanu, katzafta aleinu ad meod. Hashiveinu Adonai eilecha venashuvah, chadesh yameinu kekedem.

Habet mishamayim ureh, mizbul kodshêcha vetifartecha. Ayei kinatcha ugvurotecha? Hamon me'echa verachamecha eilai hitapaku? Ki atah avinu, ki Avraham lo yeda'anu, v'Yisrael lo yachireinu. Atah Adonai avinu, go'aleinu meiolam shemecha. Lamah tat'enu Adonai midrachecha? Takshi'ach libênu miyir'atecha. Shuv lema'an avadecha, shivtei nachalatecha. Lamit'ear yarasu am kodshêcha, tzareinu bos'su mikdashecha.

Ve'atah Adonai avinu, ata. Anachnu hachomer ve'atah yotzerênu, umaaseh yadecha culanu. Al tiktzof Adonai ad meod, ve'al la'ad tizkor avon. Hen habeit na amcha culanu. Arei kodshêcha hayu midbar, Tziyon midbar haytah, Yerushalayim shamamah. Beit kodshênu vetifarteinu asher hillucha avoteinu hayah lisrefat eish, vechol machmadênu hayah lechorvah. Ha'al eleh titapak Adonai? Techeseh uta'anênu ad meod.

No final dos versículos das lamentações, deve-se dizer (Moshe bebetsér [45]): Oy li al galut haShechiná, oy li al churban Beit HaMikdash, oy li al sereifat haTorá, oy li al harigat hatsadikim, oy li al chillul Shemo hagadol vetorato hakdoshah, oy li al ki gavar oyev, oy li al tzaar kol haolamot, oy li al tzaar haAvot hakdoshim vehaImahot hakdoshot, oy li al tzaar haNeviim vehachassidim vehatzadikim asher bagan Éden, oy li al tzaaro shel Mashiach. Avonoteinu hitu eleh ufshayeinu hearchíu kitzenu, vechatotainu manu hatov mimenu, oy lahem labanim shegalu meal shulchan Avihem zeh chamah orech yamim veshanim rabbim veraim, kol dor shelo nivnah Beit HaMikdash beyamav keilu necherav beyamav.

Al-chomotayich Yerushaláim, hipkadeti shomrim, kol-hayom v'chol-halaila tamid lo yecheshu, hamazkirim et-Hashem, al-domi lachem. V'al titnu domi lo, ad-y'chonen v'ad yasim et-Yerushaláim tehilah ba'aretz. Nishba Hashem bimino uvizroa ozó, im-et-dganeich od ma'achal l'oiveich, v'im yishtu vnei-nechar tirosheich, asher yaga'at bo. Ki m'aspav yocheiluhu, v'hilu et-Hashem, um'kabtzav yishtuhu b'chatzrot kodshi.
Atah takum t'racheim Tzion, ki-eit l'chenenah ki-va mo'ed. Ki ratzu avadeicha et-avaneha, v'et-afarah y'chonenú. Boneh Yerushaláim Hashem, nidchei Yisra'el y'kannes.
Tikkun Leah: Lamnatsêach, mizmor livnei Korach. K'ayal ta'arog al afikei mayim, ken nafshi ta'arog elecha Elohim. Tzam'ah nafshi leElohim, leEl chai; matai avo ve'era'eh penei Elohim? Haytah-li dim'ati lechem yomam valailah, be'emor eilai kol hayom: Ayeh Eloheicha? Eleh ezkerah veshipchah alai nafshi, ki e'avor basakh edadêm ad beit Elohim, bekol rinah vetodah hamon chogeg. Mah tishtochachi nafshi uvetehemi alai, hachili leElohim, ki od odeynu, yeshuot panav. Elohai, alai nafshi tishtochach, al-ken ezkorcha me'eretz Yarden vehermonim mehar mitzar. Tehom el-tehom kore lekol tzinorecha; chol mishbarecha ugalêcha alai avru. Yomam yetzaveh Adonai chasdo uvallaylah shiro imi, tefillah leEl chai. Omrah leEl salkhi, lamah shachachtani? Lamah kodêr eilech balachatz oyeiv? Beretzach be'atzmotai cherfuni tzorerai, be'omram eilai kol hayom: Ayeh Eloheicha? Mah tishtochachi nafshi utemehemi alai, hachili leElohim, ki od odeynu, yeshuot panai veilohei.

Shofetêni Elohim veriva riví bemalchut lo chasid, mei'ish mirma va'avlah tefalletêni. Ki ata Elohei ma'uzzi, lamah zanachtani? Lamah kodêr et'halech balachatz oyeiv? Shlach orcha ve'amitecha hemah yanichuni, yevi'uneni el har kodshêcha uveit mishknotecha. Ve'avoah el mizbei'ach Elohim, el-El simchat gilai, ve'odecha bechinor Elohim Elohai. Mah tishtochachi nafshi utemehemi alai, hachili leElohim, ki od odeynu, yeshuot panai veilohei.
Nos dias em que não se diz Tachanun, este salmo não deve ser dito.

Lamnatsêach mizmor ledavid. Ya'anêcha Adonai beyom tzarah, yesagevcha shem Elohei Yaakov. Yishlach ezrecha mikodesh umitzion yisadeka. Yizkor chol minchotecha ve'olah tzedoshcha selah. Yiten lach kilvavecha vecol atzatecha yemale. Niranenah vishu'atcha uveshem Eloheinu nidgol; yemale Adonai chol mish'alotecha. Atta yadati ki yoshi'a Adonai meshicho ya'anehu mishmei kodsho bigvurot yeshua yemino. Eleh barchev ve'eleh vasusim, ve'anachnu besheim Adonai Eloheinu nazkir. Hemah kar'u vanafalu, ve'anachnu kamnu vanithoded. Adonai hoshi'ah, hamelech ya'aneinu beyom kareinu.

Ledavid mizmor, layhovah ha'aretz umele'ah tevel veyoshevai bah. Ki hu al yamim yesadah ve'al neharot yechonenah. Mi ya'aleh behar Adonai, ume yavo bemekom kodsho? Neki chapayim uvar levav asher lo nasa lashav nafshi velo nishba l'mirma. Yisa veracha me'et Adonai utzdakah me'Elohei yish'i. Ze dor dorshav mevakshei fanêcha Yaakov selah. Sa'u shearim rosheichem vehinas'u petchei olam v'yavo melech hakavod. Mi zeh melech hakavod? Adonai azuz ugvir Adonai gvir milchama. Sa'u shearim rosheichem use'u petchei olam v'yavo melech hakavod. Mi hu zeh melech hakavod? Adonai tzva'ot hu melech hakavod selah.

Lamnatsêach binginot mizmor shir. Elohim yechaneinu uvayvarecheinu, ya'ir panav itanu selah. Ladat ba'aretz darcha uvechol goyim yeshu'atcha. Yoduchah amim Elohim yoduchah amim kulam. Yismachu viranenu legoyim ki tishpot amim mishor ul'amim ba'aretz tanchêm selah. Yoduchah amim Elohim yoduchah amim kulam. Eretz natnah yevulah yevarecheinu Elohim Eloheinu. Yevarecheinu Elohim uveyiru oto chol afsei aretz.

Halleluyah! Odeh Adonai bechol levavi besod yesharim ve'edah. Gdoli ma'asei Adonai derushim lechol chefzteihem. Hod vehadar po'olo vetsidkato omedet la'ad. Zecher asah leniflotav chanun verachum Adonai. Teref natan lire'av yizkor le'olam brito. Choch ma'asei yadav emet umishpat ne'emanim col pikudeihem. Semuchim la'ad le'olam asuyim be'emmet veyashar. Pedut shalach le'ammo tzivah le'olam berito kadosh venora shemo. Rêshit chochmah yirat Adonai seichel tov lechol oseihem tehilato omedet la'ad. Noa tanua aretz kashechor vehitnodadah camelunah vecavad aleha pisha ve'nafalah velo tosif kom. Vehayah bayom hahu yifkod Adonai al tzeva hamaron bamaron ve'al malchei ha'adamah al ha'adamah.

Lamnatsêach mizmor ledavid. Bevo elav natan hanavi ka'asher ba el bat-sheva. Chaneni Elohim kechasdecha kerov rachamecha mechey pish'ai. Harbeh kab'sênai me'avoni umechatta'ati tahareini. Ki pish'ai ani eda vehata'ati negdi tamid. Lecha levadecha chatati vehara be'inecha asiti lema'an titzdek bedab'recha tizkeh beshoftecha. Hen be'avon cholalti uvechattat yechmatni imi. Hen emet chafatzta vatuchot uvesatum chochmah todieini. Techate'eini be'ezov vetaher techab'seini umisheleg albin. Tashmi'eini sasson vesimchah tagelna atzmot dichita. Hastir paneicha mechata'ai ucol avonotai mechey. Lev tahor bara li Elohim veruach nachon chadesh bekirbi. Al tashlichaini mil'fanecha veruach kadsh'cha al tikach mimeni. Hashiva li sason yish'echa veruach nedivah tism'cheni. Alam'dah fosh'im derachecha ve'chata'im eilecha yashuvu. Hatzileni midamim Elohim Elohei teshuatî teranen leshoni tzedekatcha. Adonai sfatay tiftach ufî yagid tehilatecha. Ki lo tachpotz zevach ve'etenah olah lo tirzeh. Zivchei Elohim ruach nishbarah; lev nishbar venidkeh Elohim lo tivzeh. Heiteivah beretzoncha et Tzion tivenê chomot Yerushalaim. Az tachpotz zivchei tzedek olah uchalil az ya'alu al mizbe'achcha parim.
Nos dias em que não se diz Tachanun, não deve ser dito.
Ad anah bechiyah betsion umisped biyerushalayim:
Takum terachem Tzion, tivenê chomot Yerushalayim.
É costume dizer, após a conclusão de Tikkun Leah, "Malkh Ramjan etc." e o salmo "Beshuv etc.", para concluir com consolo (BeAh"Kh Vayishlach He"yb).

Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, melech rachaman racheim aleinu, tov umeitiv hadarêsh lanu, shuvah aleinu b'hamon rachamecha, biglal avot she'asu retzonecha, beneh beitechah kevatchilah, konein beit mikdash'cha al mechono, hareinu bevinyano, samcheinu betiku'no, vehashiv Shechinatcha letôcho, vehashiv kohanim le'avodatam, uleviyim ledouchanam, leshiram uzmiram, vehashiv Yisrael linvehem. Vesam na'aleh venir'eh venishtachaveh lefanêcha: Yehi ratzon milfanecha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, she'ta'aleinu besimchah le'artzeinu, vetita'einu bigvuleinu, vesam na'aseh lefanêcha et korbanotei chovoteinu, temidim kesidram umusafim kehilchatam.

Shir hama'alot, beshuv Adonai et shivat Tzion hayinu kecholmim. Az yimalê sichok pinu uleshoneinu rinah, az yomru vagoyim higdil Adonai la'asot im eleh. Higdil Adonai la'asot imanu, hayinu samechim. Shuvah Adonai et [shivteynu] shivteynu ca'afikim banegêv. Hazore'im bedim'ah birinah yiktzoru. Haloch yelech uvacho nosei meshech hazara bo yavo birinah nosei alumotav.

Petichat Eliyahu: Oração Matinal para os Dias Úteis
Após os Salmos de Tikkun Leah, é costume dizer a Abertura de Eliyahu (em Orech Chaim e Yishlach HaYav).
Vihiei noam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu, umaaseh yadeinu chonenah aleinu, umaaseh yadeinu chonenêhu.

Fatách Eliyahu hanavi zechur letov veamar: Ribon olmin deant at hu chad velá bechushban. Ant at illa al kol illin, setima al kol setimin. Leit machshavah tefisá bach clal: Ant at deapat ét eser tikunin vekareinan lón eser sefirán. Leanhagá bén olmin setimin delá itgalían veolmin deitgalían. Uvén itchasat mibnei nashá. Veant at dekashir lón umeiached lón: Uvguin deant milgáo. Kol man deaprish chad min chaveréih meilein eser itchashiv leih keilu aprish bách.

V'eilêyn essêr s'firân innun azlin k'sidrân. Chad arich v'chad katser v'chad beinuni: v'ant hu d'an'hig lon. V'leit mân d'an'hig lach. La l'elá v'la l'tatá v'la michol sitra. L'vushin takant lon d'minayhu p'r'chin nishmatin livnêy nasha: v'chamah gufin takant lon d'itk'riu gufa l'gabêy l'vushin d'michsayan alêhon: v'itk'riu b'tikuná da. Chesed d'roa y'miná. G'vurá d'roa smalá. Tif'eret gufa. Netzach v'hod t'rein shokin. Yesod siyumá d'gufo oht b'rit kodêsh. Malchut peh Torá Sheb'al Peh kar'inan lah. Chochmá mocha ihi machshavá mil'gao. Biná libá u'vah halêv mevin. V'al ilêyn t'rein ch'tiv hanistárot laHashém Eloheinu. Keter elyon ihu keter malchut. V'alêihu itmar magid m'rashit acharit. V'ihu karkaftá d'tfillêy: mil'gao iyu [oht] Yud [v'oht] Hei [v'oht] Vav [v'oht] Hei d'ihu orach atsilut. Ihu shak'yu d'ilaná b'd'roy v'anpoy. K'mayá d'ashkêy l'ilaná v'itrabei b'hahu shak'yu.

Ribbon olamim Ant hu ilat ha'ilót v'sibát hasibót d'ashkêy l'ilaná b'hahu n'vi'u. V'hahu n'vi'u iyu k'nishmatá l'gufo d'ihu chayim l'gufo: uvach leit dimyon v'leit diyukná (d'gufo) michol ma dilgao ul'vár. Uvaráta shamayim v'artza. V'afakt minhon shimsha v'sihará v'chokh'baya v'mazalêy. U'v'artza ilanin v'dsháin v'gin'ta d'Eden v'isbin v'chaywan v'ofin v'nunin u'v'irin u'vnei nasha. L'ishtmoda bohen ila'in v'eich yitnahagun bohen ila'in v'tatatáin. V'eich ishtmodan meilá'e v'tatatáe v'leit d'yadá bach klal. Uvar minnach leit yichudá b'ilá'e v'tatatáe. V'ant ishtmodá Adon al kolá: v'chol s'firán chol chad it léhu shem y'dia. U'v'hen itk'riu mal'akháya. V'ant leit lach shem y'dia. D'ant hu m'malé chol sh'mahan v'ant hu shlímu d'kulhon: v'kad ant tistalak minhon. Isht'aru kulhon sh'mahan k'gufo blá nishmatá: ant hu chachím v'lav b'chochmá y'dia. Ant hu m'vin v'lav m'biná y'dia. Leit lach atar y'dia. Elá l'ishtmoda tukfach v'chilach l'vnei nasha. U'l'achzáah lon eich itnahig olmá b'diná u'v'rachamêy d'inun tzedek u'mishpat k'phum ovadéihon d'vnei nasha: din iyu g'vurá. Mishpat amudá d'emtza'itá. Tzedek malchutá kadisha. Moznêy tzedek t'rein samchey k'shot. Hin tzedek ot b'rit. Kola l'achzáah eich itnahig olmá: aval lav d'it lach tzedek y'dia d'ihu din. V'lav mishpat y'dia d'ihu rachamêy. V'lav mikol ilêyn midót klal: Kum Rabi Shimon v'yitchadshun milin al y'dach, d'ha rashutá it lach l'galáah razin tmirin al y'dach, ma d'la ityav rashu l'galáah lasum bar-nash ad kan.

Kam Rabi Shimon patach v'amár, L'cha Hashém hag'dulá v'hag'vurá v'hatif'eret v'hanetzach v'had hod ki chol bashamayim uvááretz. L'cha Hashém hamamlachá v'hamitnassé l'chol l'rosh. Ila'in shm'u ilêyn d'michin d'chavrón, v'ra'ya m'haymaná itt'aru mish'natchon, hakitzu v'ran'nu shoch'nei afar. Ilêyn ilêyn tzadikaya d'ilêyn misitra d'hiy d'itamar bah Ani y'shená v'libi ér, v'lo ilêyn m'eitim, u'vgin da itamar b'chon hakitzu v'ran'nu v'cu', ra'ya m'haymaná, ant v'avahán hakitzu v'ran'nu l'itt'aruta dish'chin'tá, d'hi y'shenáh b'galutá, d'ad kan tzadikaya kúl'hu d'michin v'shintá b'chorêhon: Miyad yehivat sh'chin'tá t'lat kalim l'gabêy ra'ya m'haymaná, v'yêyma lêy Kúm ra'ya m'haymaná, d'ha alach itamar kol dodí dofêk l'gabai b'arba atvan dilêy, v'yêyma b'chon, P'tchi-li achoti ra'yati yonati tammati, d'ha tam avoneich bat Tziyon, lo yosif l'haglotêch: Sh'roshi nimlá-tal, mai nimlá tal, ela amar Kudsha Brich Hu, Ant chashavt d'miyoma d'itcharav bei mikdashá d'alna b'veita dili, v'alna byishuvá, lo hachi, d'lo alna kol z'mna d'ant b'galutá, harei l'cha simaná, sh'roshi nimlá-tal, Hei sh'chin'tá b'galutá, shlímú dilá v'chayim dilá hu tal, v'da iyu [oht] Yud [v'oht] Hei [v'oht] Vav, v'Hei iyu sh'chin'tá d'lo m'chushbán tal, ela [oht] Yud [v'oht] Hei [v'oht] Vav, d'saliku atvan l'chushbán tal, d'ihu mal'á lish'chin'tá min n'vi'u d'chol m'korin ila'in. Miyad kam ra'ya m'haymaná, v'avahán kadishin imêy, ad kan razá d'yichudá. Baruch Hashém l'olam Amen v'Amen.

Yehê ra'avá min kodam Atiká Kadišá d'khol-kadišin, tmirá d'khol-tmírin stímá d'khóla d'yit'mashakh talá ila'á minnei l'malyá reišei d'Zeir Anpin ul'háttil l'ḥakal tappuḥin kadišin b'nehiru d'anfin b'ra'avá uv'ḥedváta d'khóla. V'yit'mashakh min kodam Atiká Kadišá d'khol-kadišin, tmirá d'khol-tmírin stímá d'khóla, re'utá v'rakhaméi ḥiná v'ḥisdá b'nehiru ila'á b're'utá v'ḥedvá alai v'al-khol-b'nei veiti v'al-khol-hanilvim eilai v'al-khol-Yisra'el amei. V'yifr'kinan mikol-ak'tin bišin d'yeytun l'ol'má v'yazmin v'yityehiv laná u'l'khol-nafshotána ḥiná v'ḥisdá v'ḥayei arikhei u'm'zonéi revikhei v'rakhaméi min kodamei. Amen. Ken yehi ratzon. Amen v'Amen.
Após a abertura de Eliyahu Zechor Latov, dirão as palavras de Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, conforme escrito no Zohar HaKadosh, Parashat Noach, página 65, e Pekudei, página 265: (BeAh "Vayishlach" 12).

Amár Ribí Shim'on: Arimít yedái bitslotín le'elá, dechad re'utá iláá le'elá le'elá kaymá al hahu re'utá delo ityadá ve lo itpás kelál le'olamín, réishá desatím iatír le'elá, vehahu réishá afík maí de'afík velo yediá, venahir maí denahir kólá bis'timú, re'ú demachshavá iláá limradáf avateréih ul'itnahará minnéih. Chad parísu itparís, umigo hahu parisá biradifú dehahi machshavá iláá mateí velo mateí, ad hahu parisá nahir maí denahir, uchdein hahu machshavá iláá nahir binehiro s'tím delo yediá, vehahu machshavá lo yadá, chdein batsash hai nehiro demachshavá delo ityadá binehiro defarsá dekaymá denahir mimah delo yediá velo ityadá velo itgal'yá, uchdein dá nehiro demachshavá delo ityadá batsash binehiro diprisá veneharín kachadá, veit'avídu tish'á heichalín. Veheichalín lav innún nehorín, velav innún ruchín, velav innún nishmatín, velo it mán dekaymá b'hon. Re'utá dechol-tish'á nehorín dekayméi chul'hon bemachshavá, dei hu chad minnáhon bechushbáná, chul'hon limradáf batr'aihon, besha'atá dekayméi bemachshavá velo mitdabkán velo ityad'u, veilín lo kayméi lo bire'utá velo bemachshavá iláá tafsín bah velo tafsín, beilín kayméi chol-razei dimheimnutá. Vechol-innún nehorín merazá demachshavá iláá uletatá, chull'hon ik'rún ein sof. Ad hachá matú nehorín, velo matún velo ityad'u, lav hachá re'utá velo machshavá kad nahir machshavá velo ityadá mimman denahir, chdein itlavash v'astím go biná, venahir lemán denahir, ve'ail dá vedá, ad deitch'lílu chull'hon kachadá. Uverazá dekarbaná kad salík, kólá itch'shar dá vedá, venahir dá vedá, chdein kayméi chull'hon bis'likú umachshavá it'atar be'ein sof. Hahu nehiro de'itnehir minnéih machshavá iláá (delo ityadá bah kelál) ik'rei ein sof, deminnéih ishtachách vekaymá venahir lemán denahir, ve'al dá kólá ka'im. Zakáá chul'kéihon d'tzadikáya be'olmá dein uv'olmá de'atéi.
Order of Talit: Leshem iechud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchintêhu, bidchilu urêchimô, urêchimô udchilu, lêiachadá shêm Yud Kei uvav ô vav Kei bêi'ichudá shelêm (Yud Hei Vav Hei) bêshêm col Israêl. Harêini muchân lêkayêm mitzvat assêh lilbôs Talit metsuiêtsêt kihilchatá, kemo shêtsivânu Yud Hei Vav Hei Eloheinu bêtorató hakdoshah: (Bamidbar 15:38) Veassu lahêm tzitzit al canfê vigdêhem. Kedêi shê nizcor col mitzvotav laassotam sheneemar (Bamidbar 15:39) Ureitem oto uzchartem et col mitzvot Yud Hei Vav Hei vaassitem otam. Vaarêini muchân lêvarech al atifat hatalit ketikun rabotênu zichronam livrachah. Vaarêini mechaven liftor bibrachah zo gam talit hakatan shealai. Kedei laassôt nachat rûach lyotzerênu ulaassôt retson boreinu. Vihî noam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu umaassei yadeinu conênah aleinu umaassei yadeinu conenêhu.
Baruch ata Yud Hei Vav Hei, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher kidshanu bemitzvotav vetsivanu lehitatêf betsitsit.
Order of Tefillin: Em nome da união de Kudsha Brich Hu e Sheckintei, com temor e amor, e com amor e temor, para unir o Nome Yud Kei Vav Kei em união completa (YHWH) no nome de todo Yisrael. Eis que estou preparado para cumprir o mandamento positivo de colocar os tefilin na minha mão e na minha cabeça, como Yehovah Eloheinu nos ordenou: (Devarim 11:18) "E os atareis como um sinal sobre vossas mãos, e eles serão como frontais entre vossos olhos." E o Santo Bendito Seja Ele nos ordenou a colocar estas quatro porções que contêm a unidade do Seu Nome e a saída de Mitzrayim no braço, oposto ao coração, e na cabeça, oposta ao cérebro, para que nos lembremos dos milagres e maravilhas que Ele fez conosco. E eis que estou preparado para abençoar a bênção instituída por nossos Rabbanim, que sua memória seja abençoada, sobre o mandamento dos tefilin, e eis que intenciono cumprir com esta bênção tanto os tefilin da mão quanto os tefilin da cabeça, e que suba diante de Ti, Yehovah Eloheinu e Elohim de nossos avós, como se eu tivesse concentrado em todas as intenções apropriadas durante a colocação dos tefilin e na bênção. E seja o favor de Adonai Eloheinu sobre nós, e estabeleça a obra de nossas mãos sobre nós; sim, estabeleça a obra de nossas mãos.

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher kidshanu bemitzvotav, vetzivanu lehanich tefillin: Se houver uma interrupção significativa entre a colocação dos tefilin da mão e dos tefilin da cabeça, então deve-se recitar a seguinte bênção sobre os tefilin da cabeça (Orach Chaim Veira 6): Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher kidshanu bemitzvotav, vetzivanu al mitzvat tefillin:

Após colocar os tefilin da cabeça, imediatamente deve-se completar a colocação dos tefilin da mão com três voltas ao redor do dedo médio, chamado de amá, fazendo uma volta na junta média do dedo e duas voltas na junta inferior, e ao fazer as voltas mencionadas deve-se dizer (Orach Chaim Veira 16): Veerashtich li leolam veerashtich li betzedek uvmishpat uvechesed uverachamim. Veerashtich li beemunah vedayata et Adonai.

Após colocar os tefilin, deve-se recitar as parashiot de Kadesh e Ve'hayah Ki Yeviacha para completar as quatro parashiot todos os dias. Se não for possível recitá-las antes da oração, deve-se dizê-las após a oração (Orach Chaim Veira 25): Vayedaber Adonai el Moshe lemor. Kadesh li chol bechor petter chol rechem bivnei Yisrael baadam uvabehemah li hu. Vayomer Moshe el haam zacor et hayom hazeh asher yetzatem mimitzrayim mibeit avadim ki bechozeq yad hotzi Adonai etchem mizeh velo yeachel chometz. Hayom atem yotzim bachodesh haaviv. Vehayah ki yeviacha Adonai el eretz hacnaani vehachiti vehaemori vehachivi vehayevusi asher nishba laavotecha latet lach eretz zavat chalav udvash veavadeta et haavodah hazot bachodesh hazeh. Shivat yamim tochel matzot uvayom hashvi’i chag laAdonai. Matzot yeachel et shivat hayamim velo yerá lach chometz velo yerá lach seor bekhol gevulecha. Vehigadeta levinkha bayom hahu lemor baavur zeh asah Adonai li betzetí mimitzrayim. Vehayah lach leot al yadecha ulezikaron bein eineicha lemaan tihyeh torat Adonai beficha ki beyad chazakah hotziacha Adonai mimitzrayim. Vesamarta et hachukah hazot lemoado mimyamim yamimah.

Vehayah ki yeviacha Adonai el eretz hakenaani kaasher nishba lecha velavotecha venatanah lach. Vehaavarta chol peter rechem laAdonai vechol peter sheger behemah asher yihyeh lach hazecharim laAdonai. Vechol peter chamor tipdeh vaseh veim lo tipdeh vaarapto vechol bechor adam bivaneicha tipdeh. Vehayah ki yishalkha vincha machar lemor mah zot veamarta eilav bechozek yad hotziánu Adonai mimitzrayim mibeit avadim. Vayehi ki hikshah Paroh lesalecheinu vayaharog Adonai chol bechor beeretz mitzrayim mibechor adam ve’ad bechor behemah al ken ani zoveach laAdonai chol peter rechem hazecharim vechol bechor banei afdeh. Vehayah leot al yadecha uletotafot bein eineicha ki bechozek yad hotziánu Adonai mimitzrayim.
Hanna's Prayer: E Chana titpaleil e tomá: "Alátz libí b'Adonai, ramáh karní b'Adonai; racháf pi al oyvái, ki samáchti viyshuató. Eín kadósh kaAdonai, ki eín biltecha; ve'ein tzur k'Eloheinu. Al tarbu t'dabru g'vohá g'vohá, yetzei aták mifíchém, ki El d'ot Adonai, velo nitkenu alilot. Keshét giborím chatím, venichshalím azru chayil. S'veím balechem nischáru, ur'reim chadélu. Ad akará yaldá shivá, verabát baním umlalá. Adonai memit um'chayé, morid sh'ol vaya'al. Adonai morish uma'asir, mashpil af maromém. Mekim meafár dal, meashpot yarim evyon, l'hoshiv im nedivim, v'chisei chavod yanachilém, ki laAdonai metzukei aretz, vayasheyt aleihem teivel. Ragléi chasidav yishmor, ur'sha'im bachoshech yidammu, ki lo vecho'ach yigbar ish. Adonai yechatu merivav, alav bashamáyim yara'em, Adonai yadin afsei aretz, veyiten oz l'malko, veyerem keren meshicho." Atóhi kemá ravrevím, vetimhóhi kemá takífím! Malchutei malchut olam, veshaltano im dor vagor. Va'anachnu am'cha vetzon mareitecha, nodé lecha leolám ledor vador, nesaper tehilatecha. Erev vavoker vetzohoráim asicha véhemeh, vayishma kolí. Beran yachad cochvei boker, vayari'u chol bnei Elohim. Lo irá merivvót am, asher savív shatu alai. Va'ani b'Adonai atzapeh, ochilah l'Eilohei yish'i; yishma'eini Elohai. (Em Shabat e Yom Tov este versículo não é recitado) Al tism'chi oyavti li, ki nafálti kamtí; ki eshev bachoshech, Adonai or li. Ki lecha Adonai hochalti, ata taaneh, Adonai Elohai. Raglí amda bemishor, bimak'helím avarech Adonai.
Morning Prayer: Cada pessoa deve ter o cuidado de recitar este texto antes da Parashá do Laço, e com este texto que uma pessoa diz todos os dias antes da oração será protegida do perigo pela Meritíssima Prece de Rabi Shimon bar Yochai, que está no Idra Rabá, página 141b (Parte 3, página inicial, b), e Hashem não negará o bem àqueles que andam na integridade (Orach Chaim 180:12). Ribon Olamá, Yehei Ra'avá Kammákh Lan Chailá Le'itar Bikará, Uleme'abd Re'utá, Ulesadra Kholá Kidká Ya'út. V'af Al Gab Delá Anan Yada'in Leshavá Re'utá Vilbá Letaken Kholá, Yehei Ra'avá Kammákh Detit'rei Bemilin Utzlotán, Letakana Tikuná Dil'eilá Kidká Ya'út, Vel'havu Heikhalin Ilá'in, Veruchin Ilá'in Ayli Heikhala Beheikhala, Veruchá Beruchá, Ad Demitchabran Beduchteihon Kidká Chazé, Sháifá Besháifá, Ve'ishtlimu Dá Bedá, Ve'it'yachadu Dá Bedá Ad Innun Chad, Venaharin Dá Bedá, Uchedein Nishmátá Ilá'á Dekholá Atiá Mil'eilá Venahir Lon, Vel'havu Nehirin Kulhon Votzin Beshlimú Kidká Chazé, Ad Dehahu Nehorá Ilá'á It'ar, Vekholá A'il Legabei Kodésh Kodashim, Ve'itvareichá Ve'itmalyá Kevirá Demayin Nav'in Velá Faskin, Vekulhon Mitvarechin Le'eilá Vetattá, Vehahu Delá Ityadá Velá A'il Bichushbená Re'utá Delá Itfas Le'olmin Basim Legó Legó Begaváihon Velá Ityadá Hahu Re'utá Velá Itfas Limdá, Uchedein Kholá Re'utá Chadá Ad Ein Sof Vekholá Ihu Bishlimú Milletatá Umigó Legó Ad De'it'avíd Kholá Chad, Ve'itmalyá Kholá Ve'ishtlim Kholá Ve'itnehir Ve'itvasám Kholá Kidká Ya'út. Ribon Olamá, Yehei Re'utá Im Ammá Yisra'el Le'olám, Ufirkán Yeminá Achazi Le'amá Beveit Mikdashá, Ul'amtuí Lan Mituv Nihorá, Ulkabelá Tzlotán Berachaméi, Yehei Ra'avá Kammákh Detehévi Sa'id Vesámich Lan, Denimá Milin Be'orách Meishár, Betikuná Dil'eilá, Betikunin Demalká Kadoshá Umatronaitá Kadoshá, Ul'me'abd Yichudá Shlem, Leshaláfá Lehahu Nishmátá Dekhol Chayei Midargá Ledargá Ad Sofá Dekhol Dargin, Bigín Detehévi Hahu Nishmátá Mishtachechá Bekholá Umitfashetá Bekholá, Dehá Eilá Vetattá Talin Behahu Nishmátá Umitkayméi Bah.

Para unir Kudsha Brich Hu e Sh'chinatêh com temor e amor, e amor e temor, para unir o Nome Yud Kei Vav Kei em união completa, no nome de todo Yisra'el. Eis que nós viemos para rezar a tefilá de Shacharit, que Avraham nosso pai, sobre ele a paz, estabeleceu, juntamente com todos os mitzvot nela contidas, para corrigir sua raiz no lugar elevado, para proporcionar Nachat Ruach ao nosso Criador e para cumprir a vontade do nosso Criador. E seja o favor de Adonai nosso Elohim sobre nós, e a obra de nossas mãos estabelecida sobre nós, sim, a obra de nossas mãos estabeleça-a. E eis que aceito sobre mim a mitzvat aseh de "V'ahavta l're'acha kamocha" (amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo), e eis que amo a cada um dos filhos de Yisra'el como a minha própria alma e extremamente, e eis que dirijo meus lábios para rezar diante do Rei dos reis dos reis, o Kadosh Baruch Hu.

Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, zachreinu bezichron tov mil'fanecha, ufakeidenu bifkudat yeshuah verachamim mishemei shemei kedem, uzchor-lanu Hashem Eloheinu ahavat hakadmonim Avraham Yitzchak veYisrael avadecha, et habrit ve'et hachesed ve'et hashvuah shenishbata leAvraham avinu behar Hamoriyah, ve'et haakeidah she'akad et Yitzchak bno al-gabei hamizbei'ach kakatuv beToratecha:

Vayehi achar hadevarim ha'eleh veha'Elohim nissah et-Avraham vayomer eilav Avraham vayomer hineni. Vayomer kach-na et-bincha et-yechidecha asher ahavta et-Yitzchak velech-lecha el-eretz Hamoriyah veha'aleihu sham leolah al echad heharim asher omar eilecha. Vayashkem Avraham baboker vayachavosh et-chamoro vayikach et-shenei nearav ito ve'et Yitzchak bno vayevake'ah atzei olah vayakam vayeilech el-hamakom asher amar-lo ha'Elohim. Bayom hashlishi vayisa Avraham et-einav vayar et-hamakom meirachok. Vayomer Avraham el-ne'arav shevu-lachem poh im-hachamor va'ani vehana'ar neilechah ad-ko venishtachaveh venashuvah aleichem. Vayikach Avraham et-atzei haolah vayasem al-Yitzchak bno vayikach beyado et-ha'eish ve'et-hama'achelet vayelchu sheneihem yachdav. Vayomer Yitzchak el-Avraham aviv vayomer avi vayomer hineni beni vayomer hinei ha'eish veha'etzim ve'ayeh hasheh leolah? Vayomer Avraham Elohim yireh-lo haseh leolah beni vayelchu sheneihem yachdav. Vayavo'u el-hamakom asher amar-lo ha'Elohim vayiven sham Avraham et-hamizbei'ach vaya'aroch et-ha'etzim vaya'akod et-Yitzchak bno vayasem oto al-hamizbei'ach mima'al la'etzim. Vayishlach Avraham et-yado vayikach et-hama'achelet lishchot et-beno. Vayikra eilav mal'ach Hashem min-hashamayim vayomer Avraham Avraham vayomer hineni. Vayomer al-tishlach yadecha el-hana'ar ve'al-ta'aseh lo meumah ki atah yada'ti ki yerei Elohim ata velo chasachta et-bincha et-yechidecha mimmeni. Vayisa Avraham et-einav vayar vehinei-ayil achar ne'echaz basvach bekarnav vayelech Avraham vayikach et-ha'ayil vaya'aleihu leolah tachat beno. Vayikra Avraham shem-hamakom hahu Hashem Yir'eh asher ye'amair hayom behar Hashem yera'eh. Vayikra mal'ach Hashem el-Avraham shenit min-hashamayim. Vayomer bi nishbati ne'um-Hashem ki ya'an asher asita et-hadavar hazeh velo chasachta et-bincha et-yechidecha. Ki-varuch avarechecha veharbah arbeh et-zar'acha kechokhvei hashamayim vecachol asher al-sefat hayam ve'irash zarecha et-sha'ar oyevav. Vehitbarechu vezar'echa kol goyei ha'aretz eikev asher shamata bekoli. Vayashav Avraham el-ne'arav vayakumu vayelchu yachdav el-Be'er Sheva vayeishev Avraham biVe'er Sheva.
Alguns têm o costume de recitar a seguinte passagem:
Veshachat oto al yerech hamizbei'ach tzafonah lifnei Hashem vezarku venei Aharon hakahanim et-damo al-hamizbei'ach saviv.

Yehi ratzon milefanecha Hashem Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, shetimale rachamim aleinu, uvechein berov rachamecha tizkor lanu akeidato shel Yitzchak avinu ben Avraham avinu aleihem hashalom, ke'ilu eifro tsaveur umunach al gabei hamizbei'ach, vetabit be'eifro lirachem aleinu, ulevatteil me'aleinu kol-gezirot kashot verau'ot, utezakeinu lashuv beteshuvah sheleimah lefanecha, vetatzileinu miyetzer hara umikkol chet ve'avon, vet'arich yameinu batov ushenoteinu banne'imim.

Ribono shel olam, kemosh shekavesh Avraham avinu et rachamav la'asot retzonecha beleivav shalem, kein yikveshu rachamecha et-ka'asecha, veyigolu rachamecha al midotecha, vetitnahag imanu Hashem Eloheinu bemiddat hachesed uvemiddat harachamim, vetichanes lanu lifnim mishurat hadin, uvetovcha hagadol yashuv charon apecha, meal'ammecha ume'ircha ume'artzacha uminachalatecha, vekayeim lanu Hashem Eloheinu et-hadavar shehivtachtanu batorah al yedei Moshe avdecha ka'amar: vezacharti et-briti Yaakov ve'af et-briti Yitzchak ve'af et-briti Avraham ezkor veha'aretz ezkor. Venomar: ve'af gam-zot biheyotam be'eretz oyveihem lo-me'astim velo-ge'altem lechalotam lehaper briti itam ki ani Hashem Eloheihem. Venomar: vezacharti lahem brit rishonim asher hotzeitim me'eretz Mitzrayim le'einei hagoyim lihyot lahem leilohim ani Hashem. Venomar: veshev Hashem Eloheicha et-shevutcha verachamecha veshev vekibetzcha mikol-ha'amim asher hefitzcha Hashem Eloheicha shamah. Im-yihye nidachecha biketzeh hashamayim misham yekavetzcha Hashem Elohecha umisham yikachecha. Vehaviacha Hashem Elohecha el-ha'aretz asher-yarshu avotecha virishtah vehetivcha vehirbecha me'avotecha. Venomar al yedei neviecha: Hashem chanenu lach kivinu heye z'ro'am labekarim af yeshuatenu be'et tzarah. Venomar: ve'et-tzarah hi leYaakov umimenah yivashae. Venomar: bekhol-tzaratam lo tzar vel'mal'ach panav hoshiam be'ahavato uvechemlato hu gealam vayenatlem vayenase'em kol-yemei olam. Venomar: yachin ley"g middot Mi-el kamocha El nosei avon verachum ve'over al-pesha vechanun lish'erit nachalato erech lo-hechezik la'ad apo ki chafetz chesed hu verav chesed. Yashuv yerachameinu ve'emet yichbosh avonoteinu notzer chesed utashlich bimtzulot yam chol-chatotam le'alafim. Titain emet leYaakov nosei avon chesed leAvraham ufash'ah asher nishbata la'avoteinu vechat'ah mimei kedem venakeh. Venomar: vahavi'otim el-har kodshi v'simachtim bevait tefilati oloteihem vezivcheihem leratzon al-mizbei'ach ki veiti beit-tefilah yikare lechol-ha'amim.

Elu devarim she'ein lahem shiur: Hape'ah, vehabikkurim, veharea'yon, ug'milut chasadim, vetalmud torah. Elu devarim she'adam oseihem ve'ochel pe'roteihem ba'olam hazeh, vehakeren kayemet la'olam haba: v'elu hen: kibud av va'em, ug'milut chasadim, uvikur cholim, vehachnasat or'chim, vehashkamat beit hakneset, v'hava'at shalom bein adam lachavero uvein ish le'ishto vetalmud torah keneged kulam.

Le'olam yehi adam yerei shamayim baseter kevagalu, uemode al ha'emet, vedoveir emet bilvavo, v'yashkim v'yomar: Ribono shel olamim va'adonei ha'adonim, lo al tzidkoteinu anachnu mafillim tachanuneinu lefanecha ki al rachamecha harabbim. Adonai sha'ma Adonai solach Adonai hakshivah va'aseh al te'acher lema'an'cha Elohai ki shimcha nikra al-ir'cha ve'al ammecha. Mah anachnu, mah chayyeinu, mah chasdeinu, mah-tzidkoteinu, mah-kocheinu, mah-g'vurateinu. Mah nomar lefanecha Hashem Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, halo kol-hagiborim ke'ayin lefanecha, ve'an'shei hashem ke'lo hayu, vachachamim kivil madua, unevonim kivil haskel, ki chol-ma'aseinu tohu, v'yemei chayyeinu hevel lefanecha, umotar ha'adam min-habehemah ayin ki hakol havel. Levad haneshamah hatt'horah shehi atidah litain din v'cheshbon lifnei kissai kvodecha. V'chol-hagoyim ke'ayin negdecha, shene'emar: Hen goyim kemar mid'li uk'shachak moznayim nech'shavu hen iyyim kadak yitol. Aval anachnu am'mecha b'nei britecha, b'nei Avraham ohavecha shenishba'ta-lo b'har hamoriyah, zera Yitzchak ake'decha shene'ekad al-gabei hamizbei'ach, adat Yaakov bin'cha bechor'cha, sheme'ahavatcha she'ahavta oto, umisimatcha shesamachta-bo, karata oto Yisrael viShurun.

Lefichach anachnu chayavim lehodot lach, uleshabe'achacha ulfa'arecha ulromemcha, v'litain shir shevach v'hoda'ah lishmecha haggadol bechol yom tamid. Ashreinu, mah tov chelekenu, u'mah na'im goraleinu, u'mah yafeh me'od yerushateinu, ashreinu keshe'anachnu mashkimim uma'arivim bebatei kenesi'ot uvbatei midrashot ume'yachdim shimecha bechol yom tamid omrim pa'amayim be'ahava.

Quando chegar à leitura do Shemá antes da Parashá do Tamid, deve-se tomar cuidado para recitar os versículos de Shemá Israel e Baruch com grande intenção, como na leitura do Shemá do Yotzer (BeAch 46:7). E se perceber que o tempo da leitura do Shemá está passando, deve recitá-la aqui por completo.
Shemá Yisra'el, Hashem Elohênu, Hashem Echad.
E diz em voz baixa: Baruch shem kevod malchuto l'olam va'ed.

Atá hu Echad kodém shebaráta haolám, veatá hu Echad leáchar shebaráta haolám, atá hu El baolám hazé, veatá hu El baolám habá, veatá-Hu ushnótêcha lo yitamu. Kadésh shemá beolamá al am mekadshei shemácha, uvishuatá Malkeinu tarum vetagbiáh karnénu, vetoshiénu bekarov lemaán shemácha, baruch hamkadesh shemó barabim.

Atá hu Hashem HaElohim bashamáyim mima'al veal ha'aretz mitachat, bishméi hashamáyim haelyonim vehatachtónim, atá hu rishon veatá hu acharón umibal'adecha ein Elohim. Kabétz nafutzot kovecha me'arba kanfot ha'aretz. Yakiíru veyedaú kol baéi olám ki atá hu HaElohim levadécha lechol mamlechot ha'aretz, atá asita et hashamáyim veet ha'aretz, et hayám veet col asher bam, umi becol ma'asei yadécha baelyonim uva'tachtónim sheyomar lach má ta'aseh uma tipol. Avinu shebashamáyim chai vekayam, ase imánu chésed ba'avur kvod shimchá hagadol hagibor venora she nikrá aleinu, vekayém lanu Hashem Eloheinu et hadavar shehitvachta lanu al yedei Tzfaniá chozécha ka'omar: Ba'et hahi avi etchem uva'et kabetzi etchem ki etén etchem lesheim velithilá bichol améi ha'aretz beshuvi et shivuteichem le'eineichem amar Hashem.

Yehi ratzon mil'fanecha Hashem Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu shetirachem aleinu, vetimchol lanu et col chatateinu, utchaper lanu et col avonoteinu, vetimchol vetislah lechol pesha'einu, vetivné Beit Hamikdash bimeiráh biyameinu, venakriv lefanecha korban hatamid sheyechaper badádeinu, kemo shekatavta aleinu betoratecha al yedei Moshe avdécha ka'omar:

Vayedaber Hashem el-Moshe leimor. Tzav et-bnei Yisra'el ve'amarta aleihem et-korbani lachmi le'ishi rei'ach nichochi tishmeru lehakriv li bemo'ado. Ve'amarta lahem zeh ha'ishah asher takrivu laHashem kevasim bnei-shanah temimim shnayim layom olah tamid. Et hakeves echad ta'aseh baboker ve'et hakeves hasheni ta'aseh bein haarbayim. Ve'asirit ha'eifah solet leminchah belulah beshemen katit revi'it hahin. Olah tamid ha'asu'ah behar Sinai lerei'ach nicho'ach isheh laHashem. Venisko revi'it hahin lakeves ha'echad bakodesh hasech nesec shechar laHashem. Ve'et hakeves hasheni ta'aseh bein haarbayim keminchat haboker uchenisko ta'aseh isheh rei'ach nicho'ach laHashem.
Incense Offering: Pitum HaKetoret
Atah Hu Adonai Eloheinu, Shehiktiru Avoteinu Lefanecha Et Ketoret Hasamim, Bizman SheBeit Hamikdash Kayam, Ka’asher Tzivita Otam Al-Yad Mosheh N’veiacha, Kakatuv BeToratecha:

Vayomer Adonai El-Mosheh: Kach-L’cha Samim Nataf | U’shchelet Ve’chelbenah Samim U’levonah Zakah. Bad Bavad Yihyeh. Ve’asita Ota Ketoret Rokach Ma’aseh Roké’ach Memulach Tahor Kodesh. Veshachakta Mimenah Hadek, Venatata Mimenah Lifnei Ha’edut Be’Ohel Mo’ed, Asher Ivare L’cha Shamah. Kodesh Kodashim Tihyeh Lachem. Ven’eimar: Vehiktir Alav Aharon Ketoret Samim Baboker Baboker Behetivo Et-Hanerot Yakhtirena; Uveha’alot Aharon Et-Hanerot Bein Ha’arbayim Yakhtirena; Ketoret Tamid Lifnei Adonai Ledoroteichem.

Tanya: Rabbi Natán Omer: K’shehu Shochek, Omer: Hadek Heitev, Heitev Hadek. Mipnei Shehakol Yafeh Labsamim. Pitmehah Lachatayim, Kesheirah. Leshalish U’leravi’a, Lo Sham’anu. Amar Rabbi Yehudah: Ze Haclel, Im Kemidat’ah, Kesheirah Lachatayim. Ve’im Chiser Achat Mikol-Sammaneiha, Chayav Mitah.

Tanei Bar-Kapara: Achas Lishtim O Lishivi’im Shanah, Haytah Ba’ah Shel Shirayim Lachatayim. Ve’od Tanei Bar-Kapara: Ilu Hayah Noten Bah Kartov Shel Dvash, Eyn Adam Yachol La’amod Mipnei Reicha. Adonai Tzevaot, Ashrei Adam Botieach Bach. Adonai Hoshiah, Hamel’ech Ya’aneinu Beyom Koreinu. Ve’arvah Ladonai Minchat Yehudah ViYerushalayim, Kiymei Olam Uchshanim Kadmoniyot.

E diz em voz baixa:
Baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed.

Ribbon HaOlamim, Atah Tzivitanu Lehakriv Korban Hatamid BeMoado, Velihyot Cohanim BeAvodatam, ULeviim Beduchanam, VeYisrael BeMa'amadam. VeAtta Ba'Avonoteinu Charav Beit HaMikdash UVatal Hatamid, VeEin Lanu Lo Cohen BeAvodato Veloh Levi Beduchano, Veloh Yisrael BeMa'amado, VeAtah Amarta: Uneshalmah Parim Sefateinu.

Lachen Yehi Ratzon Milfanecha Hashem Eloheinu VeElohei Avoteinu, SheYehi Siach Sifvoteinu Ze Chashuv Umechubal Umerutzeh Lifanecha Ke'ilu Hikravnu Korban Hatamid BeMoado Va'amadnu Al Ma'amado, Kemo Shen'emar: Uneshalmah Parim Sefateinu. Ven'emar: Veshachat Oto Al Yerech Hamizbe'ach Tzafonah Lifnei Hashem Uzar'ku Bnei Aharon Hacohanim Et Damo Al Hamizbe'ach Saviv. Ven'emar: Zot HaTorah La'olah Laminchah Velachatat Velasham Velamilu'im Ulezavach Hashelamim.

Eizehu Makoman Shel Zevachim? Kodshi Kadashim Shechitatam Batzafon, Par Vesair Shel Yom Hakippurim Shechitatam Batzafon, VeKibul Damam Bichlei Shareit Batzafon, Vedamam Tatzun Hazayah Al Bein Habadim Ve'al Haparochet Ve'al Mizbach Hazahav. Matanah Achat Mehen Me'achevet. Shiyirei Hadam Hayah Shophech Al Yesod Maaravi Shel Mizbe'ach Hachitzon. Im Lo Natan, Lo Ichev.

Parim Hanisrafim Useirim Hanisrafim Shechitatam Batzafon, VeKibul Damam Bichlei Shareit Batzafon, Vedamam Tatzun Hazayah Al Haparochet Ve'al Mizbach Hazahav. Matanah Achat Mehen Me'achevet. Shiyirei Hadam Hayah Shophech Al Yesod Maaravi Shel Mizbe'ach Hachitzon. Im Lo Natan, Lo Ichev. Elu VeElu Nisrafim Beveit Hadashen.

Chatot HaTzibur Vehayachid. Elu Hen Chatot HaTzibur, Seirei Rashei Chodashim Vesel Mo'adot, Shechitatam Batzafon, VeKibul Damam Bichlei Shareit Batzafon, Vedamam Tatzun Arba Matanot Al Arba Kranot, Keitzad? Alah Bachelvesh Ufanah Lasovev, Uva Lo Lekeren Deromit Mizrit, Mizrit Tzfonit, Tzfonit Maaravit, Maaravit Deromit. Shiyarei Hadam Hayah Shophech Al Yesod Deromi, Ven'echalin Lifnim Min Hakela'im LeZichrei Cohunah BeChol Ma'achal Leyom Valailah Ad Chatzot.
HaOlah, Kodesh Kadashim, Shechitatah Batzafon, VeKibul Damah Bichlei Shareit Batzafon, VeDamah Tatzun Shtei Matanot Shehen Arba, Ut'teunah Hephet VeNituch VeChalil La'eishim.

Zivchei Shalmei Tzibur VeAshamot. Elu Hen Ashamot, Asham Gezelot, Asham Meiilot, Asham Shifchah Charufah, Asham Nazir, Asham Metzora, Asham Talui, Shechitatam Batzafon, VeKibul Damam Bichli Shareit Batzafon, Vedamam Tatzun Shtei Matanot Shehen Arba, Ven'echalin Lifnim Min Hakela'im LeZichrei Cohunah BeChol Ma'achal Leyom Valailah Ad Chatzot.

Hatodah VeEil Nazir, Kodoshim Kalim, Shechitatam BeChol Makom Ba'Azarah, Vedamam Tatzun Shtei Matanot Shehen Arba, Ven'echalin BeChol Ha'ir, LeChol Adam, BeChol Ma'achal, Leyom Valailah Ad Chatzot. Hamuram Mehem Kayotze Bam, Elah SheHamuram Ne'echal Lakohanim Linshaihem UleVneihem UleAvdeihem.

Shelamim, Kodoshim Kalim, Shechitatam BeChol Makom Ba'Azarah, Vedamam Tatzun Shtei Matanot Shehen Arba, Ven'echalin BeChol Ha'ir LeChol Adam BeChol Ma'achal Lishnei Yamim Valailah Echad. Hamuram Mehem Kayotze Bahem, Elah SheHamuram Ne'echal Lakohanim, Linshaihem UleVneihem UleAvdeihem.

Habechor VeHaMaaser VehaPesach, Kodoshim Kalim, Shechitatam BeChol Makom Ba'Azarah, Vedamam Tatzun Matanah Achat, Uvilvad SheYiten Keneged HaYesod. Shinah BeAchilatan, Habechor Ne'echal Lakohanim, Vehamaaser LeChol Adam, Ven'echalin BeChol Ha'ir LeChol Adam BeChol Ma'achal Lishnei Yamim Valailah Echad. HaPesach Eino Ne'echal Elah Balailah, VeEino Ne'echal Elah Ad Chatzot, VeEino Ne'echal Elah Limnuyav, VeEino Ne'echal Elah Tzeli.

Rebbi Yishmael Omer: Bishelosh Esrei Midot HaTorah Nidreshet: Mikal Vachomer, Migezerah Shaveh, MiBinyan Av VeKatuv Echad, UMibinyan Av Ushnei Ketuvim, Miklal Ufrat, MiPrat Ukhlal, Klal Uprat Ukhlal, Ei Atah Dan Elah Ke'ein Haprut, Miklal Shehu Tzarich Liprat, UmiPrat Shehu Tzarich Likhlal, VeChol Davar Shehayah Bichlal Veyatzah Min Haklal Lilamed, Lo Lilamed Al Atzmo Yatzah, Elah Lilamed Al Haklal Kuloh Yatzah, VeChol Davar Shehayah Bichlal Veyatzah Lit'on To'un Acher Shehu Ke'in Aniano, Yatzah Lehakel Veloh Lehachmir, VeChol Davar Shehayah Bichlal Veyatzah Lit'on To'un Acher Shelo Ke'in Aniano, Yatzah Lehakel Ulehachmir, VeChol Davar Shehayah Bichlal Veyatzah Lidon Bedavar Chadash, Ei Atah Yachol Lehachziruhu Likhlalo Ad Shehachzirenu Hakatuv Likhlalo Beferush, Vedavar Halameid Mei'inyano, Vedavar Halameid Misof, Vechein Shenei Ketuvim Hamachchishim Zeh Et Zeh, Ad Sheyavo Hakatuv Hashlishi Veyachri'a Beineihem.
Yehudah Ben Teima Omer, Hevei Az Kanamer, VeKal Kanesser, VeRatz Katzevi, VeGibor Ka'ari La'asot Retzonecha Shebashamayim. Hu Hayah Omer, Az Panim Lagehinom, Uvoshet Panim Legan Eden.
Yehi Ratzon Milfanecha Hashem Eloheinu VeElohei Avoteinu, SheTivneh Beit HaMikdash Bimeheirah Beyameinu, Vetain Chelekenu Betoratecha, La'asot Chukei Retzonecha, Ule'avdacha Belevav Shalem.
E dizemos aqui o Kaddish "Al Yisrael".

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabba. [Amên] Bealma divra, kirvuteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amên] Bechayêchon uvêyomechon uvêchayê dechol beit Yisrael, baagalá uvizman kariv, veimru Amên. [Amên] Yehê shemeh rabba mevorach lealam ulalmê almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyitaleh. Veyithalal shemeh dekudsha, bêrich hu. [Amên] Leela min kol birkhata shirata, tushb’chata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru Amên. [Amên]

Al Yisrael veal Rabanân, veal Talmideihon veal kol Talmidei Talmideihon, deaskin beOraita Kedisha, divbêatara hadên vedichol atar veatar. Yehê laná ulhôn ulchôn chiná vechisdá verachamei, min kodam Marê shamayá vearets, veimru Amên. [Amên]

Yehê shlamá rabbá min shamayá, chayim vesavá vishuá venchamá, veshezavá urfuá ugeulá uslichá vechapará veravach vhatzalá lanu ulchol amo Yisrael, veimru Amên. [Amên]. Osseh shalom bimromav, hu berachamav yaaseh shalom aleinu veal kol amo Yisrael, veimru Amên. [Amên]
Hodu: Hodu la'Adonai, kir'u viShemo; hodi'u va'amim alilotav. Shiru lo, zamru lo; sichu v'chol niflotav. Hit'halelu biSheim kodsho; yismach lev mevakshei Adonai. Dirshu Adonai v'ozzo; bakshu fanav tamid. Zichru niflotav asher asah, mofetav u'mishpetei piv. Zera Yisrael avdo, bnei Yaakov bachirav: hu Adonai Eloheinu; b'chol ha'aretz mishpatav. Zichru l'olam brito, davar tziva l'elef dor, asher karat et Avraham, u'shvuato l'Yitzchak. Vaya'amideha l'Yaakov l'chok, l'Yisrael brit olam: leimor lach etein eretz Kena'an, chevel nachalatchem. Bi'heyotechem metei mispar, kim'at, v'geirim bah. Vayit'hallechu migoy el goy, u'mimamlacha el am acher. Lo hinich l'ish l'oskam, vayochich aleihem melachim. Al tig'u v'meshichai, u'v'neviei al tare'u.

Shiru la'Adonai kol ha'aretz; basru miyom el yom yeshuato. Sapp'ru vagoyim et k'vodo, b'chol ha'amim niflotav. Ki gadol Adonai u'mehulal me'od, v'nora hu al kol elohim. Ki chol elohai ha'amim elilim, v'Adonai shamayim asah. Hod v'hadar l'fanav, oiz v'chedvah bimkomo. Havu la'Adonai mishp'chot amim; havu la'Adonai kavod va'oz. Havu la'Adonai k'vod Shemo; sa'u minchah u'vo'u l'fanav, hishtachavu la'Adonai b'hadrat kodesh. Chilu mil'fanav kol ha'aretz, af tichon teivel bal timot. Yism'chu hashamayim v'tagel ha'aretz, v'yomru vagoyim Adonai malach. Yir'am hayam um'lo'o, ya'alot hasadeh v'chol asher bo. Az y'ranenu atzei ha'ya'ar mil'fanei Adonai ki va lishpot et ha'aretz. Hodu la'Adonai ki tov, ki l'olam chasdo. V'imru hoshia'einu Elohei yish'einu, v'kabetzeinu v'hatzileinu min hagoyim, l'hodot l'Sheim kod'shecha, l'hishtabech bit'hilatecha. Baruch Adonai Elohei Yisrael min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam, vayomru chol ha'am Amen, v'halleluyah.

Romemu Adonai Eloheinu, v'hishtachavu lahadom raglav; kadosh hu. Romemu Adonai Eloheinu, v'hishtachavu l'har kodsho; ki kadosh Adonai Eloheinu. V'hu rachum, y'chapeir avon v'lo yashchit, v'hirbah l'hashiv apo v'lo ya'ir chol chamato. Atah Adonai lo tichlah rachamecha mimeinu; chasdecha v'amitecha tamid yatzruni. Z'chor rachamecha Adonai v'chasadecha ki meiolam hemah. T'nu oiz l'Elohim al Yisrael ga'avato, v'ozzo bashchakim. Nora Elohim mimikdashcha; Elohei Yisrael hu noten oiz v'ta'atzumot la'am. Baruch Elohim.

Eil nekamot Adonai, Eil nekamot hofia. Hinasei shofeit ha'aretz, hashiv g'mul al ge'im. La'Adonai hay'shuah; al amecha bir'chatecha selah. Adonai Tzva'ot imanu; misgav lanu Elohei Yaakov selah. Adonai Tzva'ot, ashrei adam botie'ach bach. Adonai hoshiah, hamelech ya'aneinu b'yom kareinu. Hoshi'ah et amecha u'vareich et nachalatecha, ur'eim v'nasa'eim ad ha'olam. Nafsheinu chiketa l'Adonai, ezreinu u'magineinu hu. Ki vo yismach libeinu, ki b'Sheim kodsho batuachnu. Y'hi chasdecha Adonai aleinu, ka'asher yichalnu lach. Har'einu Adonai chasdecha, v'yeshuatecha titen lanu. Kumah ezrat lanu uf'deinu l'ma'an chasdecha. Anochi Adonai Eloheicha, hamaga'leich me'eretz Mitzrayim, harchev picha, va'amaleihu. Ashrei ha'am she'chacha lo, ashrei ha'am she'Adonai Eloheihem. Va'ani b'chasdecha batuachti; yagel libi b'yishuatecha. Ashirah la'Adonai ki gamal alai.

Aromimecha Adonai ki dilitanu, v'lo simacht oyeivai li. Adonai Elohai shivati eilecha, vatirpa'eini. Adonai he'elita mei'sheol nafshi, chiyitanu miyordei bor. Zamru l'Adonai chasidav, v'hodu l'zecher kodsho. Ki rega b'apo, chayim birtzono; ba'erev yalin bechi, v'lavoker rinah. Va'ani amarti b'shalvi, bal emot l'olam. Adonai birtzonecha he'emadata l'harrei oz; histarta panecha hayiti nivhal. Eleicha Adonai ekra, v'el Adonai etchanan. Mah betza b'dami, b'ridati el shachat; hayodecha afar? Hayagid amitecha? Shema Adonai v'chaneni Adonai heyeh ozer li. Hafachta mispadi l'machol li; pitachta saki, v'ataz'reini simchah. L'ma'an y'zamercha kavod, v'lo yidom; Adonai Elohai l'olam odecha.
Nos Dez Dias de Arrependimento e em Hoshana Rabá recitam-se:
"Adonai hu ha'Elohim, Adonai hu ha'Elohim." (Shtayim pe'amim)
"Adonai malach, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch l'olam va'ed." (Shtayim pe'amim)
V'haya Adonai l'melech al kol ha'aretz; bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad u'Shemo echad.

Hoshia'einu Adonai Eloheinu, v'kabetzeinu min hagoyim, l'hodot l'Sheim kodshecha, l'hishtabech bit'hilatecha. Baruch Adonai Elohei Yisrael min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam, v'amru chol ha'am Amen, halleluyah. Kol haneshama tehalel Yah, halleluyah.
No Shabat continua-se com o Mizmor Hashamayim mesaprim.
É bom recitar Mizmor Elohim yachanenu uvareichu na forma da Menorá (Orach Chaim 583:4):

Lamenatzeach(Tehilim 67:1-3) binginot mizmor shir. Elohim y’choneinu uvarecheinu, ya’er panav itanu selah. Ladat ba’aretz darcha, b’chol goyim y’shu’atecha. Yoducho amim Elohim, yoducho amim kulam. Yismechu viranenu l’umim, ki tishpot amim mishor, ul’umim ba’aretz tanchem selah. Yoducho amim Elohim, yoducho amim kulam. Eretz natnah y’vulah, y’varechenu Elohim Eloheinu. Y’varechenu Elohim, v’yiru oto chofsei ha’aretz.
Pesukei D'Zimra: Baruch sheAmar

Assim que começar a recitar "Baruch sheAmar", segure as tzitzit das duas pontas à sua frente, mantendo-as em suas mãos até o final de "Baruch sheAmar", então beije-as e as coloque de volta (BA"CH Vayigash 5:7). Baruch sheamar veHaya HaOlam, Baruch Hu, Baruch Omer veOseh, Baruch Gozer uMekayem, Baruch Oseh Bereishit, Baruch Merachem al HaAretz, Baruch Merachem al Habriot, Baruch Meshalem Sachar Tov liYereiav, Baruch Chai La'ad veKayam LaNetzach, Baruch Podeh uMatzil, Baruch Shemo. Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech HaOlam, HaEil, Av HaRachaman, HaMehulal bePeh Amo, Meshubach uMfa'ar biLeshon Chasideihi vaAvadav, uvShirei David Avdecha Nehallelcha Adonai Eloheinu biShvachot uvZemirot, uNegdalcha uNeshabechacha uNefa'archa uNamlichcha, uNazkir Shimcha Malkeinu Eloheinu, Yachid Chai HaOlamim, Melech Meshubach uMefa'ar Adei Ad Shemo Hagadol. Baruch Atah Adonai, Melech Mehulal baTishbachot. Se uma pessoa terminar de recitar "Baruch sheAmar" antes do chazan, deve-se apressar para imediatamente recitar "Mizmor LeTodah" e responder Amen à bênção do chazan (BA"CH Vayigash 5:8).

Mizmor LeTodah (Tehilim 100:1-2) Hodu laAdonai kol HaAretz. Ivdu et Adonai besimcha, bo'u lefanav birnana. De'u ki Adonai Hu HaElohim, Hu Asanu veLo Anachnu, Amo veTzon Mar'ito. Bo'u She'arav beTodah, Chatzeirotav beTehila, Hodu Lo, Barachu Shemo. Ki Tov Adonai LeOlam Chasdo, veAd Dor vaDor Emunato.
Dezoito versículos de "Yehi Kavod", correspondendo às dezoito letras das seis combinações de Shaday (BA"CH Vayigash 11).

Sh Yehi Kevod Adonai LeOlam, Yismach Adonai BeMa'asei'av: D Yehi Shem Adonai Mevorach meAta veAd Olam: Y Mimizrach Shemesh Ad Movo, Mehalal Shem Adonai: Sh Ram Al Kol Goyim Adonai, Al HaShamayim Kevodo: Y Adonai Shimecha LeOlam, Adonai Zichrecha LeDor vaDor: D Adonai BaShamayim Hechin Kis'o, uMalchuto BaKol Mashala: D Yismechu HaShamayim veTagel HaAretz, veYomru vagoyim Adonai Malach: Sh Adonai Malach, Adonai Malach, Adonai Yimloch LeOlam vaEd: Y Adonai Malach olam va'ed, Avadu Goyim meArtzo: D Adonai Hefer Etzat Goyim, Heini Machshavot Amim: Y Rabot Machashavot beLev Ish, veEtzat Adonai Hi Takum: Sh Etzat Adonai LeOlam Ta'amod, Machshevot Libo LeDor vaDor: Y Ki Hu Amar veHayah, Hu Tziva veYa'amod: Sh Ki Bachar Adonai BeTzion, Avah Lo Lemoshav Lo: D Ki Yaakov Bachar Lo Yah, Yisrael Lisgulato: Y Ki Lo Yitosh Adonai Amo, veNachalato Lo Ya'azov: D VeHu Rachum Yechaper Avon, veLo Yashchit veHarbia Lehashiv Apo, veLo Ya'ir Col Chamato: Sh Adonai Hoshia, HaMelech Ya'aneinu BeYom Kar'einu:
Ashrei Yoshvei Beitecha, Od Yehallelucha Selah: Ashrei Ha'am Shekacha Lo, Ashrei Ha'am SheAdonai Elohav:

Tehillah LeDavid (Tehilim 145:1-2) Arumimcha Eilohei HaMelech, vaAvarecha Shimcha LeOlam va'ed. BeChol Yom Avarechecha, vaAhalela Shimcha LeOlam va'ed. Gadol Adonai uMehulal Me'od, veLigdulato Ein Cheker. Dor LeDor Yeshabe'ach Ma'aseicha, uGvuroteicha Yagidu. Hadar Kevod Hod'cha, veDivrei Nifle'otecha Asicha. Ve'ozuz Nor'oteicha Yomru, veGduloteicha Asaprena. Zecher Rav Tovcha Yavi'u, veTzedekcha Yeranenu. Chanun veRachum Adonai, Erech Afayim veGadol Chesed. Tov Adonai LeChol, veRachamav Al Kol Ma'asav. Yoducha Adonai Kol Ma'aseicha, veChasidecha Yevarechuha. Kevod Malchutecha Yomru, uGvuratecha Yedabru. Lehodia Livnei HaAdam Gvurotav, uKevod Hadar Malchuto. Malchutecha Malchut Kol Olamim, uMemshaltecha BeChol Dor vaDor. Someich Adonai LeChol HaNoflim, veZokeif LeChol HaKefufim. Einei Chol Eilecha Yeshavru, veAtah Noten Lahem Et Oklam BeIt'o. Poteach Et Yadecha, uMasbia LeChol Chai Ratzon. Tzadik Adonai BeChol Derachav, veChasid BeChol Ma'asav. Karov Adonai LeChol Kor'av, LeChol Asher Yikra'uhu VeEmet. Retzon Yere'av Ya'aseh, veEt Shav'atam Yishma veYoshi'em. Shomer Adonai Et Kol Ohavav, veEt Kol HaResha'im Yashmid. Tehillat Adonai Yedabber Pi, vYivarech Kol Basar Shem Kodsho LeOlam va'ed. VaAnachnu NeVarech Yah meAta veAd Olam Haleluya.

Haleluya (Tehilim 146:1-3) Haleli Nafshi Et Adonai. Ahalela Adonai BeChayai, Azamerah LeElohav BeOdai. Al Tivtechu BeNadivim, Beven Adam SheEin Lo Teshu'ah. Teitzei Rucho Yashuv LeAdamto, Bayom Hahu Avdu Esteinotav. Ashrei SheEil Yaakov BeAzro, Sivro Al Adonai Elohav. Oseh Shamayim veAretz Et HaYam veEt Kol Asher Bam, HaShomer Emet LeOlam. Oseh Mishpat LaAsukim, Noten Lechem LaRe'evim, Adonai Matir Asurim. Adonai Pokeach Ivrim, Adonai Zokef Kefufim, Adonai Ohev Tzadikim. Adonai Shomer Et Gerim, Yatom veAlmanah Ye'oded, veDerech Resha'im Ye'avet. Yimloch Adonai LeOlam, Elohai'ch Tziyon Ledor vaDor Haleluya.

Haleluyah (Tehilim 147:1-2) Ki Tov Zamrah Eloheinu, Ki Na'im Nava Tehillah. Boneh Yerushalaim Adonai, Nidchei Yisrael Yechanes. Harofei Lishvorei Lev, uMechabesh LeAtzvotam. Monneh Mispar Lakochavim, LeChulam Shemot Yikra. Gadol Adoneinu veRav Koach, LeTvunato Ein Mispar. Me'odatei Anavim Adonai, Mashpil Resha'im Adei Aretz. Enoo Ladonai Betodah, Zamru LeEloheinu BeChinor. Hamchaseh Shamayim BeAvim, Hamchein LaAretz Matar, Hamatzmi'ach Harim Chatzir. Noten Livhemah Lachmah, Livnei Orev Asher Yikra'u. Lo BeGvurat HaSus Yechapes, Lo Bishokei HaIsh Yirtze. Rotzeh Adonai Et Yere'av, Et HaMyachelim LeChesdo. Shabchi Yerushalaim Et Adonai, Haleli Elohai Tziyon. Ki Chizak Berichei Sha'areich, Beirach Banayich Bekirbech. Hashem Gevulech Shalom, Chelev Chitim Yesabiech. Hasholeach Imrato Aretz, Ad Mehera Yarutz Davaro. Hanoten Sheleg KaTzemer, KeFor KaEfer Yefazer. Mashlich Karcho Kefitim, Lifnei Korato Mi Ya'amod. Yishlach Dvaro veYamsem, Yashiv Ruchu Yizzalu Mayim. Maggid Divarav LeYaakov, Chukav uMishpatav LeYisrael. Lo Asah Chen LeChol Goy veMishpatim Bal Yeda'um Haleluya.

Haleluyah (Tehilim 148) Halelu Et Adonai Min HaShamayim, Haleluhu BaMeromim. Haleluhu Kol Malachav, Haleluhu Kol Tzeva'avo. Haleluhu Shemesh veYareach, Haleluhu Kol Kochvei Or. Haleluhu Shamayei HaShamayim, vehaMayim Asher Me'al HaShamayim. Yehalelu Et Shem Adonai, Ki Hu Tziva veNibreu. VaYa'amideim Le'ad LeOlam, Chok Natan veLo Ya'avor. Halelu Et Adonai Min HaAretz, Taninim veChol Tehomot. Esh uVarad Sheleg veKitor, Ruach Sa'arah Oseh Dvaro. HeHarim veChol Gva'ot, Etz Pri veChol Arazim. HaChayah veChol Behemah, Remes veTzipor Kanaf. Malchei Aretz veChol Leumim, Sarim veChol Shoftei Aretz. Bachurim uGam Betulot, Zekenim Im Ne'arim. Yehalelu Et Shem Adonai, Ki Nishgav Shemo Levado, Hod'o Al Aretz veShamayim. VaYarem Keren LeAmo, Tehillah LeChol Chasidav, LeBnei Yisrael Am Kerovo Haleluya.

Haleluyah (Tehilim 149:1-2) Shiru Ladonai Shir Chadash, Tehillato Bekhel Chasidim. Yismach Yisrael BeOso, Bnei Tzion Yagilu BeMalcham. Yehalelu Shemo BeMachol, BeTof veChinor Yezameru-lo. Ki Rotzeh Adonai BeAmo, Yefa'er Anavim BiYeshua. Yaelzu Chasidim BeChavod, Yerananu Al Mishkevotam. Romemot Eil Bigronam, veCherev Pipiyot BeYadam. La'asot Nekamah BaGoyim, Tochachot BaLeumim. La'asor Malcheihem Bizikkim, veNichbadeihem BeChavlei Barzel. La'asot Bahem Mishpat Katuv, Hadar Hu LeChol Chasidav Haleluya.

Haleluyah (Tehilim 150:1-2) Hallelu Eil Bekodsheho, Halleluhu Birki'a Uz'o. Halleluhu BeGvurotav, Halleluhu Cherov Gedul'o. Halleluhu BeTeika Shofar, Halleluhu BeNevel veChinor. Halleluhu BeTof uMachol, Halleluhu BeMinim veUgav. Halleluhu Betziltzlei Shama, Halleluhu Betziltzlei Teru'ah. Kol HaNeshama Tehalel Yah, Haleluya. Kol HaNeshama Tehalel Yah, Haleluya.

Baruch Adonai LeOlam, Amen veAmen: Baruch Adonai MiTzion, Shochen Yerushalaim Haleluya: Baruch Adonai Elohim Elohei Yisrael, Oseh Niflat LeVado: uBaruch Shem Kevodo LeOlam veYimalai Kevodo Et Kol HaAretz, Amen veAmen:
Será dito de pé.

VaYivarech David Et Adonai LeEinei Kol HaKahal vaYomer David, Baruch Atah Adonai Elohei Yisrael Avinu me'Olam veAd Olam. Lecha Adonai HaGedulah veHaGevurah veHaTiferet veHaNetzach veHaHod, Ki Kol BaShamayim uvaAretz, Lecha Adonai HaMamlachah veHaMitnasei LeCol LeRoash. VeHaOsher veHaKavod Milifanecha, veAtah Mosheil BaCol, Yiten Tzedakah shelosh Prutot, veYemasheir et haShnayim b'Bat Achas, veAcharaihem haShlishit (BA"CH Vayigash 13) uVeyadcha Cho'ach uGevurah, uVeyadcha LeGadel uLeChazek LaCol. VeAtah Eloheinu Modim Anachnu Lach, uMehallelim LeShem Tifarteicha. ViVarchu Shem Kevodecha, uMromam Al Col Brachah uTehillah. Atah Hu Adonai Levadecha, Atah Asita Et HaShamayim Shemei HaShamayim veCol Tzeva'am HaAretz veCol Asher Aleiha HaYammim veCol Asher Bahem veAtah Mechaye Et Kulam, uTzeva HaShamayim Lach Mishatachvim. Atah Hu Adonai HaElohim, R"T Ehyeh. Até aqui de pé (KA"H CH 53:3) Asher Bacharta BeAvraham, veHotzeitu MeiUr Kasdim, veSamta Shemo Avraham. uMatzata Et Levavo Ne'eman LeFanecha, veCharota Ito HaBrit Latet Et Eretz HaCna'ani HaChiti HaEmori veHaPerizi veHaYevusi veHaGirgashi Latet LeZar'o, vaTaKem Et Dvar'echa Ki Tzadik Atah. VaTera Et Oni Avoteinu BeMitzrayim, veEt Ze'akatam Shamata Al Yam Soof. VaTitain Ot veMoftim BePar'o uBeChol Avadav uBeChol Am Artzo, Ki Yada'ta Ki Hezidu Aleihem, vaTa'aseh Lecha Shem KeHayom HaZeh. VeHaYam Bakata Lifneihem, vaYa'avru BeToch HaYam BaYabashah, veEt Rodfeihem Hislhacta BeMetzolot Kemoh Even BaMayim Azim.

VaYosha (Shemot 14:30) Adonai BaYom HaHu Et Yisrael MiYad Mitzrayim, vaYar Yisrael Et Mitzrayim Met Al Sfat HaYam. vaYar Yisrael Et HaYad HaGedolah Asher Asah Adonai BeMitzrayim, vaYiru HaAm Et Adonai, vaYa'aminu BeAdonai uVeMoshe Avdo.

Az (Shemot 15) Yashir Moshe uVnei Yisrael Et HaShirah HaZot LeAdonai, vaYomeru Leimor, Ashirah LeAdonai Ki Ga'oh Ga'ah, Sus veRochvo Rama BaYam. Azzi veZimrat Yah, vaYehi Li LiYeshu'ah, Zeh Eli veAnvehu, Elohei Avi vaAromemenhu. Adonai Ish Milchamah, Adonai Shemo. Markivot Par'o veCheilo Yarah BaYam, uMivchar Shalishav Tub'u BaYam Soof. Tehomot Yechasyumu, Yardu BeMetzolot Kemoh Even. Yemin'cha Adonai Ne'dari BaCho'ach, Yemin'cha Adonai Tire'atz Oyev. uVerov Ge'on'cha Taharos Kam'cha, Teshalach Charone'cha Yochlemu Chakash. uBeru'ach Api'cha Ne'er'mu Mayim, Nitzvu Kemoh Ned Nozlim, Kaf'u Tehomot BeLev Yam. Amar Oyev Erdof Asig Achalek Shalal, Timla'eimo Nafshi, Aric Charbi Torishemu Yadi. Nashaf'ta BeRu'ach'cha Kis'samu Yam, Tzal'lu ChaOf'eret BeMayim Adirim. Mi Chamocha BaElim Adonai, Mi Kamocha Ne'edar BaKodesh, Nora Tehilot Oseh Fele. Natita Yemin'cha, Tivla'eimo Aretz. Nachita BeChasdecha Am Zu Ga'alta, Nehalta BeOz'cha El Nevei Kodshecha. Sham'u Ammim Yir'gazun, Chil Achaz Yoshevei Pleshet. Az Nivhalu Alufei Edom, Eilei Mo'av Yachazeimo Ra'ad, Namogu Col Yoshevei Canaan. Tipol Aleihem Ematah vaPachad, Bigdol Zero'acha Yid'mu CaEven, Ad Ya'avor Am'cha Adonai, Ad Ya'avor Am Zu Kanita. Tivi'eimo veTitaeimo BeHar Nachalatecha, Machon LeShevtecha Pa'alta Adonai, Mikdash Adonai Konenu Yadecha. Adonai Yimloch LeOlam va'ed. Adonai Yimloch LeOlam va'ed. Adonai Malchuto Ka'im LeOlam uLeOlmei Olamaya: Ki Ba Sus Par'o BeRichbo uBeParashav BaYam, vaYashiv Adonai Aleihem Et Mei HaYam, uVnei Yisrael Halchu BaYabasha BeToch HaYam.

Ki Ladonai HaMeluchah uMosheil BaGoyim. VeAlu Moshi'im BeHar Tzion Lishpot Et Har Eisav, veHaytah Ladonai HaMeluchah. VeHayah Adonai LeMelech Al Col HaAretz, BaYom HaHu Yihyeh Adonai Echad uShemo Echad.

Yishtabach Shimecha La'ad Malkenu, HaEil HaMelech HaGadol veHaKadosh, BaShamayim uvaAretz. Ki Lecha Na'eh Adonai Eloheinu veElohei Avoteinu LeOlam va'ed. A Shir, B uShevachah, G Halel, D veZimrah, H Oz, V uMemshalah, Z Netzach, Ch Gedulah, T Gevurah, Y Tehillah, IA veTiferet, IB Kedushah, IG uMalchut. Berachot veHoda'ot, LeShimecha HaGadol veHaKadosh, uMeOlam veAd Olam Atah Eil. Baruch Atah Adonai, Melech Gadol uMehullal Batishbachot, Eil HaHoda'ot, Adon HaNifla'ot, Borei Col HaNeshamot, Ribon Col HaMa'asim, HaBocher BiShirei Zimrah, Melech Eil Chai HaOlamim, Amen.
Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento, adiciona-se

Shir HaMa'alot (Tehilim 130:1-2) Mimma'amakim Kirati'cha Adonai. Adonai Shima Bekoli, Tiheyena Aznecha Kashuvot LeKol Techinnai. Im Avonot Tishmar Yah, Adonai Mi Ya'amod. Ki Im'cha HaSelicha LeMa'an Tevare. Kiviti Adonai Kivitah Nafshi, veLiDvaro Hochalti. Nafshi LaAdonai MiShom'reem LaBoker, Shom'reim LaBoker. Yachel Yisrael El Adonai, Ki Im Adonai HaChesed, veHarbeh Imo Pedut. veHu Yifdeh Et Yisrael MiCol Avonotav.
O chazan diz metade de Kaddish.

Yitgadal veYitkadash Shemei Rabbah. [Amein] Be'almah di v'ra kirusneh, veYamlich Malchutei, veYatzmach Purkanei, viKarev Meshichei. [Amein] BeChayei'chon uV'yomei'chon uVeChayei deChol Beit Yisrael, BeAgala uViZman Kariv, veImru Amein. [Amein] Yehei Shemei Rabbah Mevarach Le'alam uLe'almei Almayah Yitbarach. veYishtabach. veYitpa'ar. veYitromam. veYitnasei. veYithadar. veYit'aleh. veYithalah Shemei deKudsha, Brikh Hu. [Amein] Le'ela min Kol Birchata Shirota, Tushbechata veNechemata, da'Amiran Be'almah, veImru Amein. [Amein].
O chazan diz: Barachu Et Adonai HaMevorach.
E a congregação responde: Baruch Adonai HaMevorach LeOlam va'ed.
O chazan diz: Baruch Adonai HaMevorach LeOlam va'ed.
The Shema: Shemá e suas bênçãos

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, quando começar Yotzer Or deve tocar nos tefilin da mão (BeÔH Shemot 5:1) Yotzer or uvorei choshech oseh shalom uvorei et hakol. Hamaír laaretz veladariym aleha berachamim, uvetoivo mechadesh bechol yom tamid maaseh bereishit. Ma rabu maasecha Adonai kulam bechochmah asita, malah haaretz kinyanecha. Hamelech hamromam levado meiaz, hamshubach vehamfoar vehamitnasei mimot olam. Elokai olam, berachemeicha harabim racheim aleinu, Adon ozenu, tzur misgabeinu, magen yisheinu, misgav baadeinu. El baruch gedol deah, hechin ufáal zoharei chamah. Tov yatzar kavod lishmo, meorot natan sevivot uzô. Piotz tzevaot kedoshim, rommei Shadai, tamid mesaprim kevod El ukedushato. Titbarach Adonai Eloheinu bashamayim mimaal veal haaretz mitachat al kol shevach maaseh yadecha veal meorei or sheyatzarta hemma yefaúruca selah:

Titbarach lanetzach tzureinu malkeinu vegoaleinu borei kedoshim, yishtabach shimcha laad malkeinu yotzer meshartim, veasher meshartav kulam omadim berum olam umashmiim beyirah yachad bekol divrei Elohim chayim umelech olam. Kulam ahuvim, kulam verurim, kulam giborim, kulam kedoshim, kulam osim beaima uvayera ratzon koneihem, veculam potchim et pihem bikedushah uvetaharah, beshirah uvezimrah, umevareichim umeshabechim umefaarim umakdishim umaaritzim umamlichim et shem HaEl hamelech hagadol hagibor venora Kadosh hu. Veculam mekablim aleihem ol malchut shamayim ze mizeh, venotnim res hut ze lazeh lehakdish leyotzram benachat ruach besafa verurah uveneimah kedushah, culam keechad onim beaima, veomrim beyirah:
Kedushat Yotzer precisa ser dito sentado e se estava em pé deve sentar (BeÔH Shemot 5:2)
Kadosh Kadosh Kadosh Adonai Tzevaot melo chol haaretz kevodo: Vehaofanim vehachayot hakodesh berash gadol mitnasim leummat haserafim, leummatam meshabechim veomrim: Baruch kevod Adonai mimekomo:

LaEl baruch, neimot yiten, lamelech El chai vekayam, zemirot yomru vetishbachot yashmia, ki hu levado marom vekadosh, poel gevurot, oseh chadashot, baal milchamot, zoreia tsedakot, matzmich yeshuot, borei refuot, nora tehillot, Adon haniflaot, hamechadesh betuvo bechol yom tamid maaseh bereishit kaamur: Leoseh orim gedolim ki leolam chasdo. Baruch ata Adonai yotzer hameorot:

Ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai Eloheinu, chemlah gedolah viyeterah chamalta aleinu. Avinu malkeinu, baavor shimcha hagadol uvabor avoteinu shevat chu bach vat lamdem chukei chayim laasot retzonecha beleivav shaleim, chen techaneinu Avinu, Av harachaman hamracheim, racheim na aleinu, veten bileveinu binah lehavin, lehaskil, lishmoa, lilmod ulelamed, lishmor uleaasot ulekayeim et col divrei talmud toratecha beahavah:

Vehaer eineinu betoratecha vedabeik libeinu bemitzvotecha, veyached leveinu leahava uleyir a et shimcha. Lo nevosh velo nichlam velo nichasheil leolam vaed. Ki beshem kodshecha hagadol hagibor venora batachu, nagilah venismechah biyshuatecha, verachameicha Adonai Eloheinu vechasadeicha harabim, al yaazvu nu netzach selah vaed:

Quando disser Maher vehevei alenu deve colocar os dois lados do talit sobre seus ombros e quando disser Beracha veshalom mikol arba kanfot kol haaretz deve juntar todas as quatro pontas do talit e segurá-las com sua mão esquerda próxima ao coração que está à esquerda. (BeÔH Shemot 5:5) Maher vehevei aleinu beracha veshalom mehera me'arba kanfot kol haaretz, ushbor ol hagoyim meial tzavarenu, veholichenu mehera komemiut leartzeinu, ki El poel yeshuot ata, uvánu vacharta mikol am velashon, vekeravtanu Malkeinu leshimcha hagadol beahavah, lehodot lach uleyachedcha leyirah uleahava et shimcha, Baruch ata Adonai, habocher be'am Yisrael beahavah:

Antes de recitar Kriat Shema deve ter intenção de cumprir o mandamento positivo que fomos ordenados a recitar Kriat Shema duas vezes ao dia, e também deve ter intenção de cumprir o mandamento positivo de unificar o Nome, e deve fechar seus olhos com sua mão direita no primeiro versículo até completar Baruch Shem, e assim aqui diz Shema Yisrael, ou seja, aceite estas palavras, entenda-as e conheça-as para crer nelas, e isto porque o Adonai é nosso Deus, e ainda, Ele é o único Adonai, e neste ato há aceitação e confissão em duas coisas: uma é a aceitação do Reino dos Céus ao dizer Adonai Eloheinu, confessando que aceitamos Sua divindade para ser nosso Deus e nós somos Seus servos, e o segundo é o conceito da unicidade do Nome ao dizer Adonai echad, que é sem associar outro (BeÔH Vaera 5:6-7).
Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad:
Em voz baixa: Baruch, shem kevod malchuto, leolam vaed:

Ve'ahavta (Devarim 6:5) Et Adonai Eloheicha bechol levavcha uvchol nafshecha uvchol meodecha: Vehayu hadevarim ha'eileh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha: Vesinantom levanecha vedibarta bam beshivtecha bevetecha uvlechtecha vaderech uveshachbecha uvkumecha: Ukshartam leot al yadecha yemashmesh batefilin shel yad (BeÔH Vaera 21) vehayu letotafot yemashmesh batefilin shel rosh bein einecha: Uchtavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvisharecha:

Vehaya (Devarim 11:13) Im shamoa tishmeu el mitzvotei asher anochi metzave etchem hayom leahava et Adonai Eloheichem ulevado bechol levavchem uvchol nafshechem: Venatati metar artzechem beito yoreh umalkosh veasaf ta deganecha vetiroshecha viyts harecha: Venatati esev basadecha livhemtecha veachalta vesavata: Hishameru lachem pen yiftah levavchem vesartem vaavadtem Elohim acheirim vehishtachavitem lahem: Vecharah af Adonai bachem veatzar et hashamayim velo yihye matar vehadamah lo titen et yevulah veavad tem meherah meial haaretz hatovah asher Adonai noten lachem: Vesamtem et devarai eleh al levavchem veal nafshechem ukshartem otam leot al yedchem yemashmesh batefilin shel yad vehayu letotafot bein eineichem yemashmesh batefilin shel rosh: Vil madtem otam et beneichem ledaber bam beshivtecha bevetecha uvlechtecha vaderech uveshachbecha uvkumecha: Uchtavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvisharecha: Lemaan yirbu yemeichem viyemei veneichem al haadamah asher nishba Adonai laavoteichem latet lahem kimai hashamayim al haaretz:

Vayomer (Bamidbar 15:37) Adonai el Moshe leimor: Daber el benei Yisrael veamarta alehem veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vigdeihem ledorotam venatnu al tzitzit hakanaf petil techelet: Vehaya lachem letzitzit ureitem oto yitlel betsitsiot shebeyadav, yaaviro n al gabei einei v yinish kem shetayim vezchartem et col mitzvotei Adonai vaasitem otam velo tat uru acharei levavchem veacharei eineichem yaaviro hatsitsiot al gabei einei v yinish kem asher atem zonim achareihem: Lemaan tizkeru vaasitem et col mitzvotei vihyitem kedoshim leEloheichem: Ani Adonai Eloheichem asher hotzeitichem me'eretz Mitzrayim lihiyot lachem leElohim ani Adonai Eloheichem Emet.
E o chazan repete: Adonai Eloheichem Emet:
Veyatziv, venachon, vekayam, veyashar, veneeman, veahuv, vechaviv, venechmad, vena im, venora, ve'adir, umetukan, umekubal, vetov, veyafeh, hadavar haze alenu leolam vaed.

Emet, Elohei olam malkeinu tzur Yaakov magen yisheinu, ledor vador hu kayam, ushemo kayam, uchiso nachon, umalchuto ve'emunato laad kayemet, udevoroi chayim vekayamim, veneemanim vechamudim laad yinishk hatsitsiot shehu ochaz bahem v yaaviro n al gabei einei visi rem miyado (BeÔH Shemot 5:8) uleolemei olamim. Al avoteinu, aleinu ve'al banenu ve'al doroteinu ve'al col dorot zera Yisrael avadeicha. Al harishonim ve'al haacharonim davar tov vekayam beemet ve'emuna chok velo yaavor. Emet sheata hu Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu. Malkeinu melech avoteinu. Goaleinu goel avoteinu. Yotzereinu tzur yeshuateinu. Podeinu umatzileinu meolam hu shemecha, ve'ein lanu od Elohim zulatecha selah:

Ezrat avoteinu ata hu meiolam, magen umoshia lahem ulevneihem achareihem bechol dor vador, berum olam moshavecha, umishpatecha, vetsidkatecha ad afsei aretz, Emet ashrei ish shiyishma lemitzvoteicha vetoratecha udevarecha yasim al libo. Emet sheata hu adon le'amecha umelech gibor lariv rivam le'avot uvanim, Emet ata hu rishon ve'ata hu acharon umibaladeicha ein lanu melech goel umoshia. Emet mimitzrayim gealtanu Adonai Eloheinu, mibeit avadim feditanu, col bechor eihem haragta, uvchorcha Yisrael gaalta, veyam suf lahem bakata, vezdim tibata, vididim avru yam. Vaychasu mayim tzareihem echad mehem lo notar. Al zot shibchu ahuvim, verommu laEl, venatu yedidim zemirot shirot vetishbachot berachot vehodaot lamelech El chai vekayam, ram venisa, gadol venora, mashpil geim ad aretz, magbiah shfalim ad marom, motzi asirim, podea anavim, ozer dalim, haoneh le'amo Yisrael be'et shavem elav.
Imediatamente ao começar a palavra Tehilot deve se levantar e terminar a palavra Tehilot em pé (BeÔH Shemot 5:8).

Tehilot laEl elyon goaleinu, baruch hu umevorach, Moshe uvenei Yisrael lecha anu shirah besimchah rabah, veamru culam: Mi chamocha baElim Adonai mi kamocha needar bakodesh nora tehillot oseh pele: Shirah chadashah shibchu geulim lishmecha hagadol al sefat hayam, yachad culam hodu vehimlichu veamru: Adonai yimloch leolam vaed: Venemar: Goaleinu Adonai Tzevaot shemo Kadosh Yisrael: Baruch ata Adonai gaal Yisrael:
Amida: Amidá para Shacharit de Dia de Semana.
Adonai sefatáy tiftách ufí yagíd tehilátecha.

Baruch ata Adonai, Elohênu veElohei avoteinu, Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, veElohei Yaakov. HaEl hagadol hagibor vehanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, koneh hakol, vezocher chasdei avot, umevi goel livnei veneihem lemaan shemo beahavah. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: Zochreinu lechayim, melech chafetz bachayim, katveinu besêfer chayim, lemaancha Elohim chayim. Melech ozer umoshia umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham.
Atta gibor leolam Adonai, mechayeh metim ata, rav lehoshia.
No verão: Morid Hatal. No inverno: Mashiv Haruach Umorid Hageshem.

Mekhalkhel chayim bechesed, mecha'yeh metim berachamim rabbim, someich nophlim, verofê cholim, umatir asurim, umekayem emunato liyshenei afar. Mi chamocha ba'al gevurot, umi dome lecha, melech memeit umecha'yeh umatzmiach yeshuah.  Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento diz-se: Mi chamocha av harachaman, zocher yetsurav berachamim l'chayim.
