Veneman atah lehachayot metim. Baruch ata Adonai, mecha'yeh hametim.
Kedushah:
Durante a repetição do Shaliach Tzibur, dizemos:

Nakdishákh vene'aritzákh, kenó'am síach sod sarefei kódesh, hamshalleishím lekhá kedusháh, vechén katuv al yad nevi'ákh: vekará zé el-zé ve'amar kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzva'ót melo chol ha'aretz kevodo. Le'umátem meshabchím ve'omrim: baruch kevod-Adonai mimekomo. Uvedivre khodshekhá katuv le'emor: yimlokh Adonai le'olam Elohai'ikh Tziyon ledor vador haleluyá.
Atah Kadosh veShimcha Kadosh, uKedoshim bechol yom yehalelucha selá. Baruch ata Adonai, HaEl hakadosh. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: hamelech hakadosh.
Atta chonen leadam da'at umelamed leenosh binah. Vechanênu me'itcha chochmah binah vedaat. Baruch ata Adonai, chonen hadda'at.
Hashivênu Avinu Letôratecha, Vekarevênû Malkeinu Laavodatecha, Vehachazirênu Bitshuvah Shlemah Lefanecha. Baruch Atah Adonai, Harotzeh Bitshuvah.
Selach lanu Avinu ki chatanu, mechol lanu Malkeinu ki pasha'anu, ki El tov vesalach atah. Baruch ata Adonai, chanun hamarbeh lisloach.
Reê na beOnyênu, verivá rivênu, umaher legaaleinu geulá shelêmá lemaan shemêcha, ki El goel chazák atah. Baruch ata Adonai, goel Yisraêl.
Durante o jejum coletivo, o shaliach tzibur (emissário da comunidade) repete em voz alta.

Anênu Avinu anênu bêyom tsom hata'anit hazeh, ki vetsarah g'dolah anachnu. Al têfen lêrish'einu, v'al tit'alám Malkeinu mibakkashatênu. Heyeih na karov l'shav'atênu, terem nikra élêcha atah ta'aneh, n'dabêr v'atah tishma, kadavar shen'emar: v'hayah terem yikrá'u vaani e'eneh, od hem m'dabrim vaani eshma: ki atah Adonai pôdeh umatsil, v'ôneh um'rachêm b'chol êt tzarah v'tzukah.
Baruch ata Adonai, Haoneh leamo Yisrael betzarah.

Refáeinu Adonai venêrape, hoshíeinu venevaveshá, ki tehilatênu atá, vehaaleh aruchá umarpei lechol tachaluênu ulechol machovênu ulechol makotênu. Ki El rofe rachmán venéeman atá. Baruch ata Adonai, rofe cholê amo Yisra'el.
No verão:

Bar'cheinu Adonai Eloheinu bechol ma'asei yadeinu, uvarêch shenatênu betalêi ratzon berachá unedavá, ut'hi acharitá chayim vesava veshaalom kasshaním hatovot livrachá, ki El tov umetiv atá umevarêch hashanim. Baruch ata Adonai, mevarêch hashanim.
No inverno:

Baréch alênu Adonai Eloheinu et-hashanah hazot ve'et-kol-minei tivuatah letovah, veten tal umatar livrachah al kol-pnei ha'adamah, veraveh pnei tevel vesava et-ha'olam kulô mituvecha, umalei yadeinu mibrachotecha ume'osher matanot yadecha. Shomrah vehatzilah shanah zo mikol-davar ra, umikol-minei mashchit umikol-minei pur'anut, va'aseh lah tikvah tovah ve'acharit shalom. Chus verachem aleha ve'al kol-tivuatah ufeiroteha, uvarechah bageshmei ratzon berachah unedavah, utehi acharitah chayim vesava veshalom. Kashanim hatovot livrachah, ki El tov umeitiv atah umevarech hashanim. Baruch ata Adonai, mevarech hashanim.
Teka beshofar gadol lecheruteinu, vesa nes lekabetz galuyoteinu, vkabetzeinu yachad me'arba kanfot ha'aretz le'artzeinu. Baruch ata Adonai, mekabetz nidchei amo Yisra'el.

Hashivah shofteinu kivarishonah, veyoatzeinu kivatchilah, vehaseir mimenu yagon vaanachah. Umeloch aleinu meheirah atah Adonai levadecha, bechesed uverachamim, betzedek uvemishpat. Baruch atah Adonai, melech ohev tzedakah umishpat. Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento, diz-se: hamelech hamishpat.

Lamminim velamalshinim al-tehi tikvah, vechol-hazedim ke-rega yoveidu, vechol-oyvecha vesoneicha meheirah yikareitu, umalchut harishah meheirah teaker veteshaber vetechalem vetachniyam bemheirah beyameinu. Baruch ata Adonai, shover oyevim umachnia minnim.

Al hatsadiqim veal hachasidim, veal sheerit amechá beit Yisra'el, veal pleitát beit sofrehem, veal gerei hatzedek vealeinu, yehemu na rachamecha, Adonai Eloheinu, veten sachar tov lechol habotcheim bishmecha be'emét, vesim chelkeinu imahem. Ule'olam lo nevosh ki vechá vatáchnu, ve'al chasdecha hagadol be'emét nis'anánu: Baruch ata Adonai, mishe'an umivtach latsadiqim.
Tishkón betóch Yerushaláyim írêcha kaasher dibbárta, vechisé David avdecha meherá betócha tachín, uvne otáh binyán olám bimeherá beyamenu. Baruch ata Adonai, boneh Yerushaláyim.
Et tsemach David avdecha meheirah tatzmich, veqarno tarum biyshu'atecha, ki liyshu'atecha qivvinu khol-hayyom. Baruch ata Adonai, matzmich qeren yeshu'ah.

Shema kolênu, Adonai Eloheinu, Av harachaman, racheim aleinu, vekabel berachamim uvratzon et tefilateinu, ki El shomea tefilot vetachanunim atah. Umilfanecha Malkeinu, reikam al teshiveinu, chanenu vaaneinu ushema tefilateinu.

Durante o jejum, o indivíduo diz "Anênu", e da mesma forma o emissário da comunidade que esqueceu de recitá-lo entre a bênção de Goêl (Redentor) e Rofê (Curador) deve dizê-lo aqui sem a conclusão formal. Anênu Avinu, anênu bêYom Tzom hatTa'anit hazZeh ki vêtzaaráh gdolah anachnu. Al-têfen lêrishênu, vêal tit'alám Malchênu mibbakashatênu. Hêyeh na karov lêshav'atênu. Têrem nikrá êlecha Atah ta'aneh, nêdabêr vêAtah tishma, kadavar shêne'emar: vêhaya têrem yikrá'u vaAni e'eneh, ôd hêm m'dabrim vaAni eshma. Ki Atah Yud-Kê-Vav-Kê podeh umatzil vêôneh um'rachêm bêchol-êyt tzara vêtsuka.

Texto de "Anênu" nos três jejuns (Sofrim 3:9). Anênu Avinu anênu bêyom tsom hataaniit hazeh ki vêtzaráh g'dolah anachnu, al kol asher chatanu avinu pashanu anachnu vaavotênu, vêal yadê zeh charvah irênu vêsamêm mikdashênu, oyi vaavoy lanu ki avonotênu hitu êle vêfshâênu he'arichu kitsênu, êin lanu pêh lêhashiv vêlo mêtzach lêharim rosh, uchmo tsa'ar bênapshênu al churban Bêit Hamikdash uvitul Torah va'avodah zeh kamah meot shanim vêzeh tsa'ar hashamayim, aha alênu. Lachen ata shavnu êlecha bvoshet vêcherpah uchlammah uvdim'a lev nivakshah mêElohênu m'rachêm, anna Adonai, yêhi ratzon milfanêcha Adonai Eloheinu vêElohei avotênu, shêyêhi mi'ut chêlvênu vêdamênu hamitma'et bêtaaniitênu hayom kachêlev munach al gabêi hamizbê'ach, shêtichapêr bo chol chatotênu avonotênu ufshâênu. Ha'ir panêcha al mikdashcha hashamêm lêma'an Adonai, uvá lêtsiyyon go'el. Al têfen lêrishênu, vêal tit'alâm Malchênu mibakkashatênu. Hêyeh na karov lêshav'atênu. Têrem nikra êlecha atah ta'aneh, n'dabêr vêatah tishma, kadavar shêne'emar: vêhaya têrem yikra'u vaani e'eneh, od hem m'dabrim vaani eshma: ki ata Adonai podeh umatzil vêoneh um'rachêm bêchol êt tzarâh vêtsukah.
Ki atah shomeia tefilat kol peh. Baruch ata Adonai, shomeia tefilah.

Retsêh Adonai Eloheinu be'am'cha Yisra'el velitfillatam shêah, vehashêv ha'avodá lidvir beitecha, ve'ishêi Yisra'el utfillatam, meherá be'ahavá t'kabel beratsôn, ut'hí leratsôn tamíd avodát Yisra'el am'echa.
No início do mês e em Chol Hamoed dizemos:

Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, yaaleh veyavo, veyagi'ah veyeráeh, veyerátzeh veyishama, veyifakeid veyizakeir, zikhronénu vezikhron avoteinu, zikhron Yerushalayim ircha, vezikhron Mashiach ben-David avdecha, vezikhron kol-amekha Beit Yisra'el lefanekha, lifleitah, letovah, lekhen, lekhesed ule'rakhamim, lekhayim tovim uleshalom, beyom.
No início do mês: Este é o início do mês, {Rosh Chodesh Hazeh},
Durante Chol Hamoed de Pesach: Este é o festival dos matzot, este é um dia de reunião sagrada, {Chag Hamatzot Hazeh, Beyom Mikra Kodesh Hazeh},
Durante Chol Hamoed de Sukkot: Este é o festival das sukkot, este é um dia de reunião sagrada, {Chag Hasukkot Hazeh, Beyom Mikra Kodesh Hazeh},

Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, yaaleh veyavo, veyagi'ah veyeráeh, veyerátzeh veyishama, veyifakeid veyizakeir, zikhronénu vezikhron avoteinu, zikhron Yerushalayim ircha, vezikhron Mashiach ben-David avdecha, vezikhron kol-amekha Beit Yisra'el lefanekha, lifleitah, letovah, lekhen, lekhesed ule'rakhamim, lekhayim tovim uleshalom, beyom.
Veachatah berachamecha harabim, tachpótz banu vetirtzénu, vetéchezéna eineinu beshuvcha letziyon berachamim. Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir shechinato letziyon.
Na bênção de "Modim", ele se ajoelhará em "Modim" e se levantará com o Nome(No livro "BeAch" ( Beit Aharon, ou seja, o comentário de Aharon HaKohen), na porção de Shalach, página 21.)).

Modim anachnu lach, sheatah hu Adonai Elohênu veElohei avoteinu leolam vaed, tzurênu tzur chayênu umagen yishênu atah hu, ledor vador nodeh lach unesaper tehilatecha, al chayênu hamesurim beyadecha, veal nishmoteinu hapkudot lach, veal nisecha shebekol yom imanu, veal niflotecha vetovotecha shebekol et, erev vavoker vetsahorayim. Hatov, ki lo chalu rachamecha, hamrachem, ki lo tamu chasadecha, ki meiolam kivvinu lach.
Modim derabanan:
Quando o chazan repete e diz "Modim", a congregação responde:

Modim anachnu lach, shaata Hu Hashem E-loheinu veE-lohei avoteinu, E-lohei col bashar, yotzerênu yotzer bereshit. Berachot vehodaot lishmecha hagadol vehakadosh, al shehecheyitanu vekiyamtanu. Chen techayeynu utchanenu vetesof galuyoteinu lechatzrot kodshecha, lishmor chukecha velassot retzonecha uleavdecha belebab shalem, al sheanachnu modim lach. Baruch El hahodaot.
Em Chanucá e Purim dizemos:
Al hanissim veal hapurkan veal hagevurot veal hateshuot veal haniflaot veal hanechamot sheasisa laavoteinu bayamim hahem bazman haze.

Durante o Chanucá dizemos: Bimey Matityah ven-Yochanan kohen gadol, Chashmona'i uvanav keshe'amdah malkhut Yavan har'sha'ah al amecha Yisra'el, lesachcham Toratecha ulehava'iram mechukei retzonecha. Ve'atah berachamecha harabim amadta lahem be'et tzaratam, ravta et rivam, danta et dinam, nakamta et nikmatam. Masarta giborim beyad chalashim, verabim beyad me'atim, uredashim beyad tzadikim, utme'im beyad tehorim, vezedim beyad oskei Toratecha. Lecha asita shem gadol vekadosh be'olamecha, ule'amcha Yisra'el asita teshu'ah gedolah ufarqan kehayom hazeh. Ve'achar kach ba'u vanecha lidvir beitecha, ufino et-heichalecha, vetiharu et-mikdashecha, vehadliku nerot bechatzrot kodshecha, ve'kav'u shemonat yemei Chanukah eilu behallel uvehoda'ah. Ve'asita imahem nissim venifla'ot venevodeh lishimcha hagadol selah.

Em Purim dizemos: Bimei Mordechai vEster beshushan habirah. Kshe'amad aleihem Haman harasha. Bikesh lehashmid, laharog uleabed et kol hayehudim mina'ar ve'ad zaken, taf venashim beyom echad. Bishloshah asar lechodesh shneim asar, hu chodesh Adar, ushelalam lavoze. Ve'ata berachamecha harabbim hefarta et atzato, vekilkalta et machashevato, vehashevota lo gemulo verosho. Vetalu oto ve'et banav al ha'etz. Ve'asita imahem nes vafele, veneodeh lesheimcha haggadol selah.

Vial culam yitbarach, veyitromam, veyitnasei tamid, shimcha malkeinu, leolam vaed. Vechol hachayim yoduchah selah: Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento dizemos: (Uchtov lachayim tovim col bnei beritecha.) Viyehalelu viyvarechu et shimcha hagadol beemet leolam ki tov, haEl yeshuateinu veazarateinu selah, haEl hatov: Baruch ata Adonai, hatov shimcha ulecha naeh lehodot.
Bênção dos Cohanim:

Quando o kohen se levanta para erguer suas mãos, ele diz (Bêrachot 12a). Leshem Yichud Kudsha Brich Hu Ushchinteih. Bidchilu Urechimu, Urechimu Udchilu. Leyachda Shem Yod Kei Bevav Kei Beyichuda Shelim. Beshem Kol Yisra'el. Hine Anochi Muchan Umezuman Likayem Mitzvat Aseh Levarech Et Yisra'el Birkat Cohanim Binisiut Kapayim, La'asot Nachat Ruach Leyotzereinu Ulhamshich Shefa Uvracha Lekol Ha'olamot Ula'asot Retzon Boreinu. Vihii No'am Adonai Eloheinu Aleinu Uma'aseh Yadeinu Konenah Aleinu Uma'aseh Yadeinu Konenehu.

E quando os Cohanim estão sobre a plataforma após responderem "Modim Derabanan", eles dizem: Yehiyê ratson milifanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu shetihiyêh berachah zu shetsivitanu levarech et amecha Yisra'el berachah shelemah velo yihyêh bah michshol ve'avon me'atah ve'ad olam.

Ao retornar o Shats, diz-se a Birkat Cohanim; se houver mais de um Cohen, o Chazan chama-os: Cohanim! Os Cohanim abençoam: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher kidshanu bikdushato shel-Aharon, vetsivanu levarech et-ammo Yisrael beahava. A congregação responde Amen.
E o chazan diz, e os kohanim após ele, palavra por palavra:
"Yevarechêcha Adonai veYishm'recha." E respondem: "Amém."
"Yaer Adonai panav eilecha viChunêcha." E respondem: "Amén."
"Yissa Adonai panav eilecha veYaseim lecha shalom." E respondem: "Amén."
Se não houver Cohanim, o chazan diz:
Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, bareichenu babrachah hamushleshet batTorah haktuvah al yedei Mosheh avdecha, haamurah mipi Aharon uvanei hem hakohanim am kodshecha kaamur:
Yevarechêcha Adonai veyishm'recha. E respondem: Ken yehi ratzon.
Yáyer Adonai panav elecha vichunnecha. E respondem: Ken yehi ratzon.
Yissa Adonai panav eilecha, veyasem lecha shalom. E respondem: Ken yehi ratzon. Vesamu et shemi al benei Yisrael, vaani avarechem.
Keshemachil shelich tzibur "shim shalom" machazirin kohanim paniehem kefenei heheichal veomrim:
Ribon haolamim asinu mah shetagazerta aleinu, aseh atah mah shehibtachta otanu. Hashkifah mimeron kodshcha min hashamayim uvereich et amecha et Yisra'el.

Sim shalom tová uverachá, chayim chen vachesed verachamim, aleinu veal col Yisra'el amecha. Uvarêcheinu Avinu culanu keechad beor panêcha, ki veor panêcha natata lanu Adonai Eloheinu Torá vechayim, ahavá vachesed, tzedaká verachamim, verachá veshalom. Vetov be'einecha levarecheinu ulevarech et col amecha Yisra'el, berov oz veshalom. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá, dizemos: Uvesêfer Chayim, Berachah Veshalom, Ufarnasah Tovah Viyshuah Venichamah, Ugezerot Tovot, Nizakeir Venicatev Lefanecha, Anachnu Vechol Amecha Beith Yisra'el, Lechayim Tovim Uleshalom. Baruch Atah Adonai, Hammevarech Et Amo Yisra'el Bashalom. Amen.
Yihyu leratzon imrei-fi vehegyon libi lefanêcha Adonai tsuri vegôali.

Elohai, netsor leshoni meirá vesifatái midabêr mirma, velimkalai nafshi tidom, venafshi keafar lakol tihieh, petaḥ libi betoratecha, veacharei mitzvotecha tirdof nafshi. Vechol haqamim alai leraá, meheirah haref atsatam vekalqel machshavotam. Yihyu kemot lifnei ruach umalákh Adonai dochéh. Kabel rinat amecha. Sagbénu taharénu norá. Aseh lemaán shemácha, aseh lemaán yemincha, aseh lemaán toratecha, aseh lemaán kedushatacha.
É uma segulá (prática espiritual) dizer um versículo que começa e termina com a mesma letra com que começa e termina o seu nome: Lema'an yechaltsun yedidecha, hoshia yeminecha ve'aneini.

Yihyu leratzon imrei fi vehegyon libi lefanêcha Adonai tzuri vegôali. Há quem diga a oração de Rav Meguemará Brachot 16b, que o Chidá (de bendita memória) escreveu em seu sidur: Yehi ratson mil'fanêcha, Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetiten lanu chayim aruchim, chayim shel shalom, chayim shel tovah, chayim shel b'rachah, chayim shel parnasah, chayim shel chilutz atzamot, chayim sheyesh bahem yir'at chet, chayim she'ein bahem bushah uchl'mah, chayim shel osher vechavod, chayim shet'hé beinu ahavat Torah veyir'at shamayim, chayim shet'male et kol mish'alot libeinu letovah.
Oseh Shalom(Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá diz: Hashalom) Bimeromáiv, hu verachamáiv iaasê shalóm aleinu, veal col amo Yisraél, veimru amen.
Yehi ratson milfanêcha, Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetivneh Beis Hamikdash bimeheirah biyameinu, veten chelkeinu betoratecha laasot chukei retzonecha uleavdacha belebav shalem.
No início do mês, diz-se aqui o Hallel.
Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos:
Avinu Malkeinu chatanu lefanêcha racheim aleinu.
Avinu Malkeinu ein lanu melech ela Atah.
Avinu Malkeinu aseh imanu lemaan shemêcha.
Avinu Malkeinu chadesh aleinu shanah tovah.
Avinu Malkeinu batel mealeinu col gezerot kashot veraoth.
Avinu Malkeinu batel machshavot soneniu.
Avinu Malkeinu hareir atsat oyveniu.
Avinu Malkeinu kaleh col tzar umasitin mealeinu.
Avinu Malkeinu kaleh dever vecherev veraah veraav ushvi uvizah umashchit umageifah veyetzer hara vecholaim ra'im mibnei beritecha.
Avinu Malkeinu shelach refuah shlemah lechol cholei amêcha.
Avinu Malkeinu mena mageifah minachalatecha.
Avinu Malkeinu zechor ki afar anachnu.
Avinu Malkeinu mechol uselech lechol avonoteinu.
Avinu Malkeinu kera roa gezar dineinu. (Se concentre no nome Kar"a Shat"n).
Avinu Malkeinu mechok berachamecha harabim col shitrei chovoteinu.
Avinu Malkeinu mecheh vehaaver peshaeinu mineged einecha.
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besefer chayim tovim.
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besefer tzadikim vechasidim.
Avinu Malkeinu chtevenu besêfer yesharim utemimim.
Avinu Malkeinu chtevenu besêfer parnasah vecalkalah tovah.
Avinu Malkeinu chtevenu besêfer mechilah uslicha vecaparah.
Avinu Malkeinu chtevenu besêfer geulah viyshuah.
Avinu Malkeinu zochreinu bezichron tov milifanecha.
Avinu Malkeinu hatzmach lanu yeshuah bekarov.
Avinu Malkeinu harem keren Yisra'el amecha.
Avinu Malkeinu veharem keren Meshichecha.
Avinu Malkeinu chanênu va'anênu.
Avinu Malkeinu hachazirenu bitshuvah shelemah lifanecha.
Avinu Malkeinu shema koleinu chus verachêm aleinu.
Avinu Malkeinu aseh lema'anacha im lo lema'aneinu.
Avinu Malkeinu kabêl berachamim uvratzon et tefilateinu.
Avinu Malkeinu al teshivênu reikam milifanecha.
Nos dias em que não há Tachanun, dizemos.

Yehi shêm Adonai mevorach me'atah ve'ad olam. Mimizrach shemesh ad mevo'o mehulal shêm Adonai. Ram al col goyim Adonai al hashamayim kevodo. Adonai Adonênu mah adir shimecha becol ha'aretz. E depois o chazan diz o Chatzi Kaddish.
Vidui: Vidui

Anna Adonai Eloheinu veElohei Avoteinu. Tavo lefanêcha tefilateinu. Ve'al tit'allem Malkeinu mit'chinâteinu. She'ein anachnu azê fanim ukshei oref lomar lefanêcha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei Avoteinu tzadikim anachnu velo chata'anu. Aval chata'anu. Avinu. Fasha'anu. Anachnu va'avoteinu ve'anshei veiteinu: ashamnu. Bagadnu. Gazalnu. Dibarnu dofî velashon hara. He'evinu. Vehirshá'anu. Zadnu. Chamasnu. Tafalnu sheker umirmah. Ya'atznu etzot ra'ot. Kizavnu. Ka'asnu. Latznu. Maradnu. Marinu dvarêcha. Niatznu. Ni'afnu. Sarar'nu. Avinu. Fasha'anu. Pagamnu. Tzarar'nu. Tze'ar'nu av va'em. Kishinu oref. Rasha'anu. Shichatnu. Ti'avnu. Ta'inu veti'at'a'anu. Vesarnu mimitzvotecha umimishpatecha hatovim velo shavah lanu. Ve'atah tzadik al kol haba aleinu. Ki emet asita. Va'anachnu hirsha'anu.

El Erekh Apayim Atta Uvaal Harachamim. Gedulat Rachamecha Vachasadecha Hodata Laeanav Mikkedem. Vechen Katuv Betoratá. Vayered Adonai Beeanan Vayityatzev Imo Sham Vayikra Beshem Adonai. Vesham Neemar:
Vayaavor Yehová al-penav vaiyikrá Yehová Yehová El rachum vejanun érech apayim verav-chesed veemét. Notzer chesed laalafim nose avon vafeshá vechattatá venaké.
Rachum veChanun, chatanu lefanêcha, rachêm alênu vehoshiênu.
Senta-se e diz.

Ledavid (Tehilim 25) Elecha Hashem nafshi esa. Elohai becha vatachti al-eboshah al-ya’altzu oyevai li. Gam chol-kovecha lo yevoshu yevoshu habogdim reikam. Darchecha Hashem hodi’eni orchothecha lamdeini. Hadricheni be’emitecha velammedeni ki-ata Elohei yish’i otecha kiviti chol-hayom. Zechor-rachamecha Hashem vachasadecha ki-me’olam hemah. Chatot ne’uray ufshe’ai al-tizkor kechasdecha zchor-li-ata lema’an tovcha Hashem. Tov veyashar Hashem al-chen yoreh chata’im baderech. Yadreich anavim bamishpat vilamed anavim darko. Col-archoth Hashem chesed ve’emet lenotzrei berito va’edotav. Le ma’an-shimcha Hashem vesalachta la’avonai ki-rab-hu. Mi-ze ha’ish yerei Hashem yorenu bederech yivchar. Nafsho betov talin vezaro yirash aretz. Sod Hashem liyere’av uvrito lehodi’am. Einei tamid el-Hashem ki-hu-yotzi me’ereset raglai. Peneh-elai vechaneni ki-yachid ve’anii ani. Tzarot levavi hirchivu memetzukotai hotzi’eini. Re’eh onyi va’amali vesah lechol-chatotai. Re’eh oyvai ki-rabu vesinat chamas sne’unni. Shamrah nafshi vehatzileini al-ebosh ki-chasiti vach. Tom vayosher yitzruni ki-kiviti cha. Pdei Elohim et-Yisra’el michol tzarotav. Vehu yifdeh et-Yisra’el michol avonotav.
Yehová Elohei Yisra'el shuv mecharon apecha, vehinachêm al hara'ah le'ammecha.

Avînu Malkeinu, Avînu Atta. Avînu Malkeinu, êin lanu melech ella Atta. Avînu Malkeinu, racheim aleinu. Avînu Malkeinu, chaneinu vaaneinu ki êin banu maasim. Aseh imanu tzedakah vachesed lemaan shimcha hagadol vehoshieinu. Vaanachnu lo nedah mah naaseh ki alêcha eineinu.

Zachor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meiolam hemah. Yehi chasdecha Adonai aleinu kaasher yichalnu lach. Al tizkor lanu avonot rishonim maher yekadmuna rachamecha ki dalnu meod. Ezrenu beshem Adonai oseh shamayim vaaretz. Chanenu Adonai chanenu ki rab savanu buz. Berogez rachem tizkor. Berogez ahava tizkor. Berogez akeidah tizkor. Berogez temimut tizkor. Adonai hoshiah hamelêch yaaneinu beyom koreinu. Ki hu yada yitzreinu zacur ki afar anachnu. Ozrenu Elohei yisheinu al devar chevod shemecha vehatzileinu vecapper al chatoteinu lemaan shemecha.
Em jejuns públicos, dizem-se aqui súplicas adicionais encontradas em "Taaniot veAveilut".
Nos dias de segunda e quinta, não se diz este Kaddish e continua-se com "El Melech".

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemêh rabá. [Amên] Bealma divrá, kirvutêh, veyamlich malchutêh, veyatzmach purkanêh, vikarev meshichêh. [Amên] Bechayêchon uvêyomechon uvêchayê dechol beit Yisraél, baagalá uvizman kariv, veimru amên. [Amên] Yehê shemêh rabá mevorach lealam ulalmê almayá yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnassê. Veyithadar. Veyitalê. Veyithalal shemêh dekudsha, bêrich hu. [Amên] Leela min chol birkatá, shiratá, tushbchatá venechematá, daamiran bealma, veimru amên. [Amên].
Nos dias de segunda e quinta, adiciona-se:

El Melech Yoshev al Kisse Rachamim uMitnahég baChasidut, Mocheil Avonot Amo, Ma'avir Rishon Rishon. Marbeh Mechilah laChata'im, uSelichah laPosh'im, Oseh Tzedakot im Kol Basar veRuach, Lo cheRa'atam Lahem Gomel, El, Horénu Lomar Midot Shloshah Esreh, Zechor Lanu Hayom Berit Shloshah Esreh keMo SheHodáta La'anav Mikdem, veChen Katuv beToratach Vayered Adonai be'Anan vaYityatzéve Imo Sham vaYikra veShem Adonai: veSham Ne'emar:
Vayaavor Adonai al-penei Moshe vayikra Adonai Adonai Kel rachum vechanun erech apayim verav-chesed veemet notzer chesed laalafim nose avon vafesha vechataah venakeh.

Anshei Emunah Avadu, Ba'im Bechoch Ma'aseihem: Giborim La'amod Baperetz, Dochim Et Hagezerot: Hayu Lanu Lechomah, Ulemachseh Beyom Za'am: Zo'akim Af Belachasham, Chemah Atzru Beshava'am: Terem Keravucha Anitam, Yode'im La'atot Uleratzot: Ke'av Richamtam LeMa'anam, Lo Heshivotah Paneihem Reikam: Merov Avoneinu Avadnum, Ne'esfu Menú Bachata'einu: Sa'u Hemah Limnuchot, Azvu Otanu La'anachot: Pasu Godrei Gader, Tzumetu Meshivei Chemah: Kamim Baperetz Ayan, Re'uyim Leratzotcha Afesu: Shotatnu Bearba Pinot, Terufah Lo Matzanu: Shavnu Eilecha Bivoshet Paneinu, Leshacharcha El Be'et Tzaroteinu.

El Melech Yoshév Al Kisse Rachamim Umitnahég Bachesidút, Mocheil Avonot Amo, Ma'avir Rishon Rishon. Marbeh Mechilah Lachatatím, Uselichah Laposhe'im, Oseh Tzedakot Im Kol Basar Veru'ach, Lo Cheratam Lahem Gomel, El, Horétanu Lomar Midot Shlosha Esrei, Zechor Lanu Hayom Berit Shlosha Esrei Kemó Shehodáta La'anav Mikédem, Vechén Katuv Betoratecha Vayeréd Adonai Be'anan Vayityatzev Imo Sham, Vayikra Beshem Adonai: Vesham Ne'emar:
Vayaavor Adonai al-penav vaikra Adonai Adonai Kel rachum vechanun erech apayim verav-chesed veemet notzer chesed laalafim nosei avon vapesha vechataah venakeh.

Tamahnu meRaot. Tashash kochenû mitzarot. Shachnu ad limod, shafalnu ad afar. Rachum kach hi middatenu, keshei oref umamrim anachnu. Tzaaknu befenu chatanu, petaltol veikesh libeinu. Elyon, rachamecha meiolam, selicha imcha hi. Nicham al haraah, matêh klapê chesed. Lo titallam beitot cael, ki betzarah gedolah anachnu. Yivada leEinei hakol, tovcha vechasdecha imanu. Chatom peh-satan, veal yastin aleinu, zaom bo veyidom. Veyaamod melitz tov letsadkênu, hu yagid yashreinu. Drachecha rachum vechanun gilita leneeman bayit. Bevaksho az mifanecha, emunatecha hodata lo.

El Melech yoshev al kisse rachamim umitnahég bachasidut, mochél avonot amo, ma'avir rishon rishon. Marbéh mechilah lachata'im, uslichah laposh'im, oseh tzedakot im kol basar veru'ach, lo cheratam lahem gomel, El, horétanu lomar midot shloshah esreh, zechor lanu hayom brite shloshah esreh kemoh shehodáta la'anav mikédem, vechen katuv betoratecha vayered Adonai be'anan vayityatzéiv imo sham, vayikra veshem Adonai: vesham ne'emar:
Vayaavor Adonai al-penav vaikra Adonai Adonai Kel rachum vechanun erech apayim verav-chesed veemet. Notzer chesed laalafim nosei avon vapesha vechataah venakeh.

Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu. Al taase imanu chalah, tochez yadcha bamishpat. Bevo tochachah negdecha, shemenu misifrecha al temach. Gishtecha lachkor musar, rachameicha yekadmuragezecha. Dalut maasim besurecha, karev tzedek meeleicha. Horeinu, bezakeinu lach, tzav yeshuateinu bemafgia. Vetashiv shevut aholei tam, petaichav reeh ki shamu. Zchor naamta, edut lo tishkach mipi zar'o. Chotam teudah tatir, sodcha sim bilumudeicha. Tabur agan hakah, na al yechsar hamazeg. Yah, da et Yisra'el asher yedauchah, mager et hagoyim asher lo yedauchah. Ki tashiv levitzaron, lechudim asirei hatikvah.

Mah Nômar Lefanecha Yoshev Marom, UMah Nesapper Lefanecha Shokhen Shechakim, Halo Hanistarot Vehaniglot Atta Yodea, Atta Yodea Razei Olam, Vetaalumot Sitrei Col Chai, Atta Chofes Col Chadrei Beten, Roêh Clivôt Valev. Eín Dabar Neelam Mimmêca, Veên Nistar Minneged Einecha.

Yehiyê ratsón milifanecha Yehová Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetimchol lanu et chol chatoteinu, utchapper lanu et chol avonoteinu, vetimchol vetchas lachol pesháeinu, vesalachta laavoneinu ulechatateinu venechalatánu.

Selach lanu Avinu ki chatanu, mechol lanu Malkeinu ki pasha'anu: ki ata Adonai tov vesalach, verav chesed lechol kore'echa. Le'ma'an shimecha Hashem, vesalachta la'avoni ki rav hu. Le'ma'an shimecha Hashem techayeni, betzidkatcha totzi mitzarah nafshi. Hashem Tzevaot imanu, misgav lanu Elohei Yaakov selah. Hashem Tzevaot, asheri adam botéach bach. Hashem hoshia, hamelech ya'aneinu be'yom koreinu. Hashiveinu Hashem eleicha venashuvah, chadesh yameinu ke'kedem.

Vehu Rachum Yechaper Avon Veloh Yashchit Vehirbah Lehashiv Apo Veloh Ya'ir Col Chamato. Atah Adonai Lo Tichlah Rachamecha Mimeni Chasdecha Va'amitecha Tamid Yitzruni. Hoshieinu Adonai Eloheinu Vekabetzeinu Min Hagoyim Lehodot Leshem Kodshecha Lehishabeach Bit'hilatecha. Im Avonot Tishmor Yah Adonai Mi Ya'amod. Ki Imcha Haslichah Le'ma'an Ti'vare. Lo Cha'chataneinu Asah Lanu Velo Cha'avonoteinu Gamal Aleinu. Im Avoneinu Anu Vanu Adonai Aseh Le'ma'an Shemecha. Zechor Rachamecha Adonai Vachasadecha Ki Me'olam Hemah. Ya'ancha Adonai Beyom Tzarah Yesagevcha Shem Elohei Yaakov. Adonai Hoshiah Hamel'ech Ya'aneinu Beyom Koreinu. Avinu Malkeinu Chanenu Va'aneinu Ki Ein Banu Ma'asim. Aseh Imanu Tzedakah Kerov Rachamecha Vehoshieinu Le'ma'an Shemecha.

Vea'atah(Daniel 9:15) Adonai Eloheinu asher hotzeit et amecha me'eretz Mitzrayim beyad chazakah vatase lecha shem kayom hazeh chatanu rasha'anu. Adonai kechol tzidkotecha yashov na apcha vachamatecha me'ircha Yerushalayim har kodshecha ki vachata'einu uvavonot avoteinu Yerushalayim ve'amcha lecherpah lechol sevivotainu. Ve'atah shema Eloheinu el tefilat avdecha ve'el techanutav veha'ir panecha al mikdashecha hashamem lema'an Adonai. Hateh Elohai ozncha ushema pkachah einecha ureh shomemoteinu vehair asher nikra shimecha aleha ki lo al tzidkoteinu anachnu mafili techunoteinu lefanecha ki al rachamecha harabim. Adonai shema'ah Adonai selachah Adonai hakshivah va'aseh al te'achar lema'an'cha Elohai ki shimecha nikra al ircha ve'al amecha.
Avînu Av Harachamán, hareinu ot letová uqabetz nefutzoteinu me arbá kanfot haaretz. Yachîru veyêdu col hagoyim ki atah Adonai Avînu atah. Anachnu hachomer veatah yotzerênu umaaseh yadecha culanu.

Avinu Malkeinu, Tzurênu vegoaleinu, chusah Adonai al amêcha veal titen nachalatecha lecherpah limshal bam goyim, lamah yomru vaamim ayei Eloheihem. Yadaanu Adonai ki chatanu, veen mi yaamod beadênu ela shimecha hagadol yaamod lanu beet tzarah. ucherechem av al banim racheim aleinu. Chamol al amecha veracheim al nachalatecha. Chusah na kerov rachamecha chanênu Malkeinu vaaneinu. Lecha Adonai hatzedakah oseh niflaot bichol et vaet. Habêit na vehoshiah na tson mareitecha. Al yimshol banu ketzef ki lecha Adonai hayeshuah becha tochlatênu. Eloah selichot ana selach na. Ki El tov vesalach atah.

Aná Melech rachum veChanun, zechor vehabét livrit bein habetarim. Veteiraé lefanêcha akeidat Yachid. Ulemáan Yisraél Avinu. Al taazvénu Avinu. Veal titshénu Malkeinu veal tishkachénu Yotzrénu. Veal taás imánu chaláh begaluteinu. Ki El Melech Chanun veRachum Atá.

Eín kamocha chanún verachum Eloheinu. Eín kamocha El erech apayim verav chesed veémet. Hoshíenu verachaménu meráash umerogez hatsílenu. Zchor laavadecha leAvraham leYitzchak uleYaakov al tefen el keshei haam haze veel rishéo veel chatatam. Shuv mecharon apecha vehinachém al haraah leamecha. Vehaser mimenú machat hamavet ki rachum atah. Ki chen darkécha laasót chesed chinam bekol dor vador. Ana Hashem hoshía na. Ana Hashem hatzlichah na. Ana Hashem anénu beyom karenu. Lecha Hashem kivinu. Lecha Hashem chikinu. Lecha Hashem neyachel al techesheh utéanenu. Ki naamu goyim avdah tikvátam. Kol berech lecha tichra vechol komah lefanécha tishtachaveh.

Hapotêach yad bitshuvá lekabel poshím vechatáim. Nivhalá nafshenu merov itzevoneinu. Al tishkacheinu netsach kuma vehoshíeinu. Al tishpoch charonecha aleinu ki ammecha anachnu bnei brittecha. El habita. Dal kevodeinu bagoyim veshekketzunu ketumeat hanidá. Ad matai ozcha bashvi vetifartecha beyad tzar. Hemá yiru veyevoshu veyechatu migvurátem. Ora gevuratecha vehoshíeinu lemaan shemecha. Al yimeatu lefanecha telaoteinu maher yekadmunei rachamecha be'et tzaroteinu. Lo lema'aneinu ela lema'anacha peul ve'al tashchet et zecher she'eriteinu. Ki lecha meyachalot eineinu ki El Melech chanun verachum atá. Uzechor eduteinu bechol yom tamid omrim pa'amayim be'ahavá: Shema Yisra'el Adonai Elohênu Adonai echad.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabá. [Amén] Be'alma di vra, kirvutéh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amén] Be'chayechon uv'yomeichon uv'chayei dechol beit Yisra'el, ba'agalá uvizman kariv, ve'imru amén. [Amén] Yéhe shemeh rabá mevarach le'alam ul'alméi almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpa'ar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyit'aleh. Veyithalal shemeh dekudsha, barch hu. [Amén] Le'ela min chol birchata shirata, tushb'chata venechemata, da'amiran be'alma, ve'imru amén. [Amén]
Torah Reading: Sefer Torá:
Antes da retirada da Torá em um dia em que se reza Tachanun, diz-se:
El Erekh Apayim veRav Chesed veEmet, El beApecha tochicheinu, chusah Adonai al Yisra'el amecha, veHoshieinu michol ra, chatanu lecha, Adon selach na, kerov rachamecha el.
El Erekh Apayim uMalei rachamim, El tastir panecha mimenu, chusah Adonai al she'erit Yisra'el amecha, vehatzileinu michol ra, chatanu lecha, Adon selach na, kerov rachamecha el.
Em um dia em que não se recita o Tachanun, diz-se:

Yehi Adonai Eloheinu imanu kaasher hayah im avoteinu al yaazveinu veal yitteinu. Hoshiah et amecha uvaerech et nachalatecha ureem venasseim ad haolam. Baavur David avdecha al tashéven pené meshichecha.

Ao retirar a Torá, dizem: Baruch hamakom shenatan torah leamo Yisra'el, baruch hu: Ashrei ha'am shekachah lo, ashrei ha'am sheAdonai Elohav. Gadlu laAdonai iti, unromemah shemo yachdav. Romemu Adonai Eloheinu vehishtachavu lahador raglav, kadosh hu. Romemu Adonai Eloheinu vehishtachavu lehar kodsho, ki kadosh Adonai Eloheinu. Ein kadosh k'Adonai, ki ein biltecha, ve'ein tzur k'Eloheinu. Ki mi Elohim mibaleadei Adonai, umei tzur zulatei Eloheinu. Torah tzivah lanu Moshe, morashah kehillat Ya'akov. Etz chayim hi lamachazikim bah, vetomcheha me'ushar. Deracheha darchei no'am, vechol netivoteha shalom. Shalom rav le'ohavei toratecha, ve'ein lamo michshol. Adonai oz le'amo yiten, Adonai yevarech et amo bashalom.
Quando chega ao púlpito, ergue o Sefer Torá e mostra a escrita para a congregação, e dizem:
Vezot Hatorah Asher Sam Moshe Lifnei Bnei Yisra'el. Torá Tzivá Lanu Moshe, Morashá Kehilat Ya'akov. Ha'El Tamim Darko, Imrat Adonai Tzerufá, Magen Hu Lekhol Hachosim Bo.
E o ofertante diz: Adonai Imachem.
E a congregação responde: Yevarechecha Adonai.
E o ofertante diz: Barechu et Adonai hamvorach.
E a congregação responde: Baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam va'ed.
E o ofertante repete: Baruch Adonai hamvorach leolam vaed.
E o ofertante faz a bênção antes da leitura.
Baruch ata Yehovah, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher bachar banu mikol haamim venatan lanu et Torato. Baruch ata Yehovah, noten haTorah. [Amein].
Após a leitura, o ofertante faz a bênção.
Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher natan lanu et Torato Torat emet, vechayei olam nata betocheinu. Baruch ata Adonai, noten haTorah. [Amein].
Baruch ata Adonai, Elohênu mêlech haolam, hanotêh lachayavim chayim.
O último ofertante diz o Chatsi Kaddish.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabba. [Amen] Bealma divra, kiruteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amen] Bechayechon uvyomeichon uvchayei dechol beit Yisrael, baagalá uvizman kareev, veimru amen. [Amen] Yehê shemeh rabba mevarach lealam ulalmê almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyitaleh. Veyithalal shemeh dekudsha, brikh hu. [Amen] Leela min chol birchata shirata, tushbechata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru amen. [Amen].
Ashrei: Yehiy chasdecha Yehovah aleinu kaa'sher yichalnu lach.
Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od yehalelucha selah. Ashrei haam shekacha lo, ashrei haam sheAdonai Elohav.

Tehilá leDavid (Salmos 145:1-2) Arômimcha Elohai hamelech va'avarechah shimcha le'olam va'ed. B'chol yom avarechecha va'ahalelah shimcha le'olam va'ed. Gadól Adonai u'mehulal me'od veligdulato ein cheker. Dor lador yeshabeiach ma'asecha ugevurotecha yagidu. Hadar kavod hodcha vedivrei nifla'otecha asichah. Ve'ezuz nor'otecha yomru ugdulatcha asaperenah. Zecher rav tuvcha yabi'u vetsidkatcha yeranenu. Chanun verachum Adonai erech apayim ugedol chesed. Tov Adonai lakol verachamav al kol ma'asav. Yoduchah Adonai kol ma'asecha vachasidecha yevarechucah. Kevod malchutecha yomru ugevuratcha yedabru. L'hodi'a livnei ha'adam gevurotav uchvod hadar malchuto. Malchutecha malchut kol olamim umemshaltecha b'chol dor vador. Someich Adonai lechol hanoflim vezokeif lechol hakefufim. Einei chol eleicha yesabeiru ve'ata noten lahem et ochlam be'ito. Potei'ach et yadecha umasbia lechol chai ratzon. Tzadik Adonai bechol derachav vechasid bechol ma'asav. Karov Adonai lechol kor'av lechol asher yikra'u oto be'emet. Retzon yere'av ya'aseh ve'et shav'atam yishma v'yoshia'eim. Shomer Adonai et chol ohavav ve'et kol har'sha'im yashmid. Tehilat Adonai yedabber pi vivarech kol basar shem kodsho le'olam va'ed. Va'anachnu nevarech Yah me'atah va'ad olam Halelu-Yah.
Em um dia em que não se recita Tachanun, omite-se "Lamenatzeach".

Lamnatzeiach (Tehilim 20:1-9) Mizmor Ledavid. Yaanecha Hashem Beyom Tzarah, Yesagevcha Shem Elohei Yaakov. Yishlach Ezrecha Mikodesh, Umitzion Yisadecha. Yizkor Kol Minchotecha, Ve'olatcha Yedashneha Selah. Yiten Lecha Kilvavecha, Vecol Atzatcha Yemalei. Neranena Biyshuatecha, Uveshem Eloheinu Nidgal. Yemalei Hashem Col Mishalotecha. Atta Yadati Ki Hoshia Hashem Meshicho, Yaanehu Mishemei Kodsho, Bigvurot Yeshua Yemino. Eleh Barechev Ve'eleh Basusim, Ve'anachnu Beshem Hashem Eloheinu Nazkir. Hemah Kar'u Venafalu, Ve'anachnu Kamnu Vanitodad. Hashem Hoshiah, Hamel ech Yaaneinu Beyom Kareinu.
Uva LeSion: Uva LeTzion Goel(E um redentor virá a Tzion.).

Uva LeTzion Goel Uleshavei Pesha Beyaakov Neum Yehovah. Vaani Zot Beriti Itam Amar Yehovah Ruchi Asher Alecha Udvarai Asher Samti Beficha Lo Yamushu Mipicha Umipi Zaracha Umipi Zera Zaracha Amar Yehovah Meata Ve'ad Olam. Ve'ata Kadosh Yosheb Tehillot Yisra'el. Vekara Zeh El Zeh Ve'amar Kadosh Kadosh Kadosh Yehovah Tzeva'ot Melo Chol Ha'aretz Kevodo. Umevakelim Dein Min Dein Ve'omrim: Kadosh Bishmei Meroma Ila'a Beit Sh'khintei, Kadosh Al Ha'aretz Ovad Gevurtei, Kadosh Le'olam Ule'olmei Olamaya. Yehovah Tzeva'ot Malei Chol Ha'aretz Ziv Yekarei. Vatisa'eini Ruach Va'eshma Acharei Kol Ra'ash Gadol Baruch Kevod Yehovah Mimekomo. Un'talatni Ru'ach Ushema'it Batarai Kol Zia Sagii Dimshabchin Ve'omrim: Brich Yekara D'yehovah Mei'atar Beit Sh'khintei. Yehovah Yimloch Le'olam Va'ed. Yehovah Malchuto Ka'im Le'olam Ule'olmei Olamaya. Yehovah Elohei Avraham Yitzchak VeYisra'el Avoteinu Shemorah Zot Le'olam Leyeitzer Mach'shevot Levav Amecha V'hachen Levavam Eilecha. Vehu Rachum Yechaper Avon Veloh Yashchit Vehirba Leheshiv Apo Velo Ya'ir Col Chamato. Ki Atah Adonai Tov Vesalach Verav Chesed Lecol Kor'eicha. Tzedekatcha Tzedek Le'olam Vetoratecha Emes. Titain Emet Liyakov Chesed LeAvraham Asher Nishbata La'avoteinu Mimei Kedem. Baruch Adonai Yom Yom Ya'amas Lanu Ha'el Yeshu'ateinu Selah. Yehovah Tzeva'ot Immanu Misgav Lanu Elohei Yaakov Selah. Yehovah Tzeva'ot Ashrei Adam Botie'ach Bach. Yehovah Hoshiah Hammelech Ya'aneinu Beyom Kora'einu.

Baruch Elohênu sheberáanu likhvodo, vehivdilanu min hatóim, venatan lanu Torat emet, vechayye olam nata betocheinu. Hu yiftach libeinu betorato, veyasim bilebeinu ahavato veyirato laasot retzono, uleavdo belebab shalem. Lo nigá lariq, velo nelad labehala. Yehi ratzon milefanêcha, Adonai Elohênu veElohei avoteinu, shenishmor chukecha umitzvotecha baolam hazzeh, venizke, venechaye, veneirash tovah uvracha lechayye haolam haba: Le maan yezammercha kavod velo yidom, Adonai Elohai leolam odecha. Adonai chafeitz lemaan tzidko yagdil torah veyadír: Veyivtechu vecha yodei shemecha ki lo azavta doréshcha Adonai: Adonai Adoneinu mah addir shimecha bechol haaretz: Chizku veyametz levavchem kol hamyachalim laAdonai.
E o chazan diz o Kaddish Tiskabel.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemêh rabá. [Amên] Bealma divrá, kirvutêh, veyamlich malchutêh, veyatzmach purkanêh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amên] Bechayêchon uvêmôchon uvêchayê dêchol beit Yisra'el, baagalá uvizman kareev, veimru amên. [Amên] Yehê shemêh rabá mevorach lealam ulalmê almayá yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromám. Veyitnassê. Veyithadar. Veyitaalê. Veyithalal shemêh dekudsha, bêrich hu. [Amên] Leela min chol birchatá, shiratá, tushb'chatá venechematá, daamiran bealma, veimru amên. [Amên].
Titkabal Tselotaná Uvaotaná, Im Tselotehon Uvautehon Déchal Beit Yisra'el, Kodam Avuná Débishmayá Ve'ará, Ve'imru Amen. [Amen].
Yehê shlamá raba min shmaya. Chayim vesava vishuá venechamá. Vesheizava urefuá ugeulá uslichá vecapará veravach vehatzala lanu ulchol amo Yisraél. Veimru amen. [Amen].
Ele dá três passos para trás. Osseh shalom bimromav. Hu verachamav yaaseh shalom aleinu veal kol amo Yisra'el. Veimru amen. [Amen].
E devolvem o Sefer Torá ao seu lugar e dizem Halleluyah.

Yehalelu et Shem Adonai, ki nisgav Shemo levado, hodô al eretz veShamayim. Vayarêm keren leAmo, tehillah lechol chasidav, livnei Yisra'el am krovô, haleluyah. Adonai hu haElohim, Adonai hu haElohim, baShamayim mima'al ve'al ha'aretz mitachat, ein od. Ein kamocha ba'Elohim Adonai, ve'ein kema'asecha. Hashiveinu Adonai elecha venashuvah, chadesh yameinu kekedem.
Beit Yaakov: Em dias em que não se diz Tachanun, não se diz a oração de Tehilim de David.

Tefilah (Tehilim 86) leDavid. Hatteh-Adonai oznêcha anêni ki ani veEvyon ani. Shamerah nafshi ki chasid ani. Hoshia avdecha atah Elohai haboteach Eleicha. Chanêni Adonai ki eleicha ekra chol hayom. Sameach nefesh avdecha ki eleicha Adonai nafshi esa. Ki atah Adonai tov vesalach verav chesed lechol koreecha. Haazinah Adonai tefilati vehakshivah bekol tachanunotai. Beyom tzarati ekraecha ki taaneini. Ein chamocha baElohim Adonai veEin kemasecha. Col goyim asher asita yavo'u veyishtachavu lefanêcha Adonai vechabedu lishmecha. Ki gadol atah veoseh niflaot. Atah Elohim levadecha. Horeni Adonai darkecha ahalech beEmetêcha. Yached levavi lirot shemecha. Odecha Adonai Elohai bechol levavi vechabedah shimecha leolam. Ki chasdecha gadol alay vehatzalta nafshi meshoal tachtiah. Elohim zedim kamu alay veadat aritsim bikshu nafshi velo samucha lenegdam. Veata Adonai El rachum vechanun erech apayim verav chesed veEmet. Peneh eilay vechanêni tenah ozêcha leavdecha vehoshiya leven amatecha. Aseh imadi ot letovah veyiru sonai veyevoshu ki atah Adonai azartani venichamtani.

Beit Yaakov, lechu venelcha beor Adonai. Ki chol haamim yelchu ish besheim Elohayv, veanachnu nelcha besheim Adonai Eloheinu leolam vaed. Yehi Adonai Eloheinu imanu kaasher hayah im avoteinu, al yaazveinu val yitshenu. Lehatot levaveinu eilav, lalachet bechol derachav, velishmor mitzvotav vechukav umishpatav asher tzivah et avoteinu. Veyihyu devarai eleh asher hitchananeti lifnei Adonai krovim el Adonai Eloheinu yomam valaylah, laasot mishpat avdo umishpat amo Yisrael devar yom beyomo. Leama'an daat chol amei haaretz ki Adonai hu HaElohim, ein od.

Shir (Tehilim 124:1-8) Hammaalot leDavid. Lulei Adonai shehayah lanu yomar na Yisrael. Lulei Adonai shehayah lanu bekum aleinu adam. Az chayim belaunu bacharot apam banu. Az hamayim shtafunnu nachalah avar al nafsheinu. Az avar al nafsheinu hamayim hazaidonim. Baruch Adonai shelo natananu teraf lishineihem. Nafsheinu ketzipor nimletah mipach yokshim hapach nishbar vaanachnu nimlatnu. Ezreinu besheim Adonai oseh shamayim vaaretz.
Song of the Day: Shir Shel Yom(Cântico do Dia)
Todos os dias se diz o salmo correspondente àquele dia.
Salmo para o primeiro dia. Hoje é o primeiro dia do Shabat Kodesh, a canção que os Leviim costumavam cantar sobre o ducan:

Ledavid (Tehilim 24:1-2) Mizmor l’Adonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshevee vah. Ki hu al yamim yesadah v’al neharot yechonenah. Mi yaaleh v’har Adonai umi yakum bimkom kodsho. Neki chapayim uvar levav asher lo nasa lashav nafshi velo nishba l’mirmah. Yisa berachah me’eit Adonai utzedakah meiElohei yishuo. Zeh dor dorshav mevakshei fanekha Yaakov selah. Se’u shearim rasheichem v’hinase’u pitechei olam v’yavo melech hakavod. Mi zeh melech hakavod Adonai izuz v’gibor Adonai gibor milchamah. Se’u shearim rasheichem use’u pitechei olam v’yavo melech hakavod. Mi hu zeh melech hakavod Adonai Tzevaot hu melech hakavod selah. E continua: "Hoshieinu" (Salvai-nos).
Salmo para o segundo dia. Hoje é o segundo dia do Shabat Kodesh, a canção que os Leviim costumavam cantar sobre o ducan:

Shir (Tehilim 48:1-14) Mizrôm Libnei Korach. Gadól Adonai umehulal meód beIr Eloheinu har kodsho. Yefê nof meshosh col haaretz har Tziyon yarchetei tzafon kiryat melech rav. Elohim bearmenoteha nodá lemisgav. Ki hineh hamelachim noadu avru yachdav. Hemá rau chen tamáhu nivhalu nechpazu. Readá achazatám sham chil kayoledá. Beruach kadim teshaber oniyot Tarshish. Kaasher shamánu chen raínu beIr Adonai Tzevaot beIr Eloheinu Elohim yechonená ad olam selá. Diminu Elohim chasdecha bekerev heichalecha. Keshimcha Elohim chen tehilatecha al katvei aretz tzedek malá yeminecha. Yismach har Tziyon tagelna bnot Yehudá lemaan mishpatecha. Sovu Tziyon vehakifuá sifru migdaleha. Shitu libchem lecheylá pasgu armenoteha lemaan tesapru ledor acharon. Ki zeh Elohim Eloheinu olam vaed hu yenahageinu al mot. E continua: "Hoshieinu" [Salve-nos].
Salmo para o terceiro dia. Hoje, o terceiro dia do Shabat Kodesh, a canção que os Leviim costumavam cantar sobre o ducan:

Mizmor (Tehilim 82:1-2) LeAsaf Elohim nitsav baadat-Eil bekerem Elohim yishpot. Ad-matai tishpetu-avven uphenei resha'im tisu-selah. Shifhtu-dal veyatom ani vavarash hatzdiku. Paleitu-dal ve'evyon miyad resha'im hatzilu. Lo yade'u velo yavinu bachashechah yithalachu yimmotu chol-mosedei aretz. Ani-amarti Elohim atem uvenei Elyon kulchem. Achen ke'adam temutun uche'achad hasarim tipolu. Kumah Elohim shoftah ha'aretz ki-atah tinchal bekhol-hagoyim. E continua: "Hoshieinu" (Salvai-nos).
Salmo para o quarto dia. Este é o quarto dia da semana, no Shabat sagrado, a canção que os Leviim costumavam cantar sobre o ducan:

El-nekamot (Tehilim 94:1-23) Adonai El-nekamot hofía. Hinasei shofet haaretz, hashiv gemul al-geim. Ad-matai reshaim Adonai, ad-matai reshaim yaalu zu. Yabiu yedabru atak, yitamru chol poalei oven. Amecha Adonai yidakeu, venachalatecha yeaniu. Almanah vegeir yaharogu, viyatomim yeratzechu. Vayomeru lo yireh-Yah, velo-yavin Elohei Yaakov. Binu boarim baam, uchesilim matai taskilu. Hanota ozen halo yishma, im-yotzer ayan halo yabit. Hayoser goyim halo yokich, hamelamed adam daat. Adonai yodea machshvot adam, ki-hemah hevel. Ashrei hagever asher-teyasreinu Yah, umitoratecha telammedeinu. Lehaskit lo miméi ra, ad yikkareh larasha shachat. Ki lo-yitosh Adonai ammo, venachalato lo-yaazov. Ki-ad-tzedek yashuv mishpat, veacharav chol yishrei-lev. Mi yakum li im-mereim, mi yityatzev li im-poalei oven. Lulei Adonai ezratá li, kimat shachenah dumah nafshi. Im-amarti matah ragli, chasdecha Adonai yisadeini. Berov sareifai bekirbi, tanchumeicha yeshaashu nafshi. Haiychavrcha kisei havot, yotzer amal alai-chok. Yagodu al-nefesh tzadik, vedam naki yarshi'u. Vayehi Adonai li lmisgav, veElohai letzur machsi. Vayashev aleihem et-onam, uvraatem yatzmitém, yatzmitém Adonai Eloheinu. E continua: "Hoshieinu" (Salve-nos).
Salmo para o quinto dia. Este é o quinto dia da semana, no Shabat Kodesh. Esta é a canção que os Leviim costumavam cantar sobre o ducan:

Lamenatzeach (Tehilim 81:1-16) Al-hagitit leAsaf. Harninu leElohim ozeinu, hariu leElohei Yaakov. Seu-zimrah utnu-tof, kinor naím im-navel. Tiku vachodesh shofar, bakeiseh leyom chageinu. Ki chok leYisrael hu, mishpat leElohei Yaakov. Eidut beYehosef samo, betzeto al-eretz Mitzrayim, safat lo-yadaati eshma. Hasiroti miseivel shichmo, kapav midud taavornah. Batzarah karata vaachaltzecha, eenecha beseter raam, evchancha al-mei merivah selah. Shema ami veoida bach, Yisrael im-tishma-li. Lo-yihye vecha El zar, velo tishtachaveh leEl nechar. Anochi Adonai Eloheicha, hamaalecha me'eretz Mitzrayim, harchev-picha vaamaleihu. Velo-shama ami lekolí, veYisrael lo-avah li. Vaashalchehu bishrirut libbam, yelechu bemoa'atoteihem. Lu ami shomea li, Yisrael bidrachai yeilechu. Kim'at oyveihem akni'ah, ve'al tzareihem ashiv yadi. Mesanei Adonai yechashu-lo, vihi ittam le'olam. Vayachilem mechelev chitah, umitzur devash asbi'eicha. E continua: "Hoshieinu" (Salve-nos).
Salmo para o Sexto Dia: "Hoje é o sexto dia, no Shabat sagrado, a canção que os Leviim costumavam cantar sobre o ducan:

(Tehilim 93:1-5) Yehovah malach, geut lavesh; laveish Yehovah oz hitazáir, af tichon tevel bal timot. Nakhon kisacha meiaz; meiolam atah. Nasu neharot Yehovah, nasu neharot kolam, yisu neharot dachyam. Mikolot mayim rabim, adirim mishberei-yam, adir bammarom Yehovah. Edotecha neemnu meod, leveitcha naavah-kodesh, Yehovah leorech yamim. Hoshiêynu Adonai Eloheinu vekabtsêynu min-hagoyim lêhodot lêshêm kodshêkha lêhishtabêach bit'hilatêkha. Baruch Adonai Elohei Yisra'el min-ha'olam vê'ad ha'olam vê'amár khol-ha'am Amen Halleluyah. Baruch Adonai mitziyon shokhen Yerushalayim Halleluyah. Baruch Adonai Elohim Elohei Yisra'el osêh nifla'ot l'vado. Uvaruch shêm k'vodo l'olam v'yimalê khevodo et-khol ha'aretz Amen v'Amen.
No jejum de Gedalyah e no dia dez de Tevet, recitam-se.

Shir (Tehilim 83:1-3) Mizmor LeAsaf. Elohim Al Domi Lach, Al Techeras VeAl Tishkot El. Ki Hinei Oyvecha Yehemayun UMeshan'eicha Nas'u Rosh. Al Amecha Ya'arimu Sod VeYitya'atzu Al Tzefuneicha. Amru Lechu VeNachchideim Migoy VeLo Yizacher Shem Yisrael Od. Ki No'atzu Lev Yachdav Alecha Brit Yichrotu. Ohalei Edom VeYishme'elim Mo'av VeHagrim. Geval VeAmmon VaAmalek P'leshet Im Yosh'vei Tzor. Gam Ashur Nilva Imam Hayu Zero'a Livnei Lot Selah. Aseh Lahem KeMidyan KeSisra KeYavin BeNachal Kishon. Nishmedu BeEin Dor Hayu Domem La'adamah. Shitem Nediveimo KeOrev VeKheZe'ev UcheZevach UcheTzalmunna Kol Nese'icheimo. Asher Amru Nirshah Lanu Et Ne'ot Elohim. Elohai Shitem Kegalgal KeKash Lifnei Ru'ach. KeEsh Tiv'ar Ya'ar Uchelahavah Telahet Harim. Chen Tirdem B'Sa'arecha Uv'Sufatcha Tevahalem. Malei Peneihem Kalon ViVakeshu Shimcha Adonai. Yevoshu ViYibahalu Adei Ad Veyachperu ViYoveidu. ViYede'u Ki Atah Shimcha Adonai Levadecha Elyon Al Kol Ha'aretz.
No dia seguinte a Yom Kipur dizem:

Lamnatseaĥ (Tehilim 85:1-3) Livnei-Korach Mizmor. Ratzita Hashem Artzecha Shavta Shivat Yaakov. Nasata Avon Amecha Kisita Kol-Chatatam Selah. Asafeta Kol-Evratecha Heshivota Mecharon Apacha. Shuvenu Elohei Yisheinu Vehaper Ka'ascha Imanu. Hale'olam Tea'nof-Banu Timshoch Apcha Ledor Vador. Haloh-Ata Tashuv Techayenu Ve'amcha Yismechu-Vach. Hareinu Adonai Chasdecha Veyish'acha Titen-Lanu. Eshme'a Mah-Yedaber Ha'el Adonai Ki Yedaber Shalom El-Ammo Ve'el-Chasidav Ve'al-Yashuvu Lechislah. Ach Karov Lire'av Yish'u Lishkon Kavod Be'artzeinu. Chesed Ve'emmet Nifgashu Tzedek Vishalom Nashaku. Emet Meeretz Titzmach Vetzedek Mishamayim Nishkaf. Gam-Hashem Yiten Hatov Ve'artzeinu Titen Yevulah. Tzedek Lefanav Yehalech Veyasem Lederech Pe'amav.
Durante o Chanucá dizemos:

Mizmóhr (Tehilim 30:1-2) Shir-Chanukkat Habáyit L'Dávid. Arómimchah Yehováh Ki Dillitani Velo Simachta Oyevai Li. Yehováh Elohai Shivati Eilecha Vatirpafeni. Yehováh Heélita Min-Sheol Nafshi Chiyiytani MiYordei-Bor. Zamru L'Yehováh Chasidav Vehodú L'Zécher Kodsho. Ki Réga B'Apo Chayim BiRtzonó Va'erev Yalin Bechi Velaboker Rinah. Va'ani Amarti Beshalvi Bal Emot Le'olam. Yehováh BiRtzoncha He'amadatah Lehari'i Oz Histarta Panecha Hayiti Nivhal. Eilecha Yehováh Ekra Ve'el-Adonai Etchanan. Mah Betza B'Dami Beridti El Shachat Hahodcha Afár Hahagid Amittecha. Shema-Yehováh VeChaneni Yehováh Heyeh-Ozer Li. Hafachta Mispedi Lemachol Li Fitcha Sakki Vate'azréni Simchah. LeMa'an Yezammercha Kavod Veló Yiddom Yehováh Elohai Le'olam Odecha.
No jejum de Ester e em Purim dizem:

Lamnatseach (Tehilim 22:1-2) Al Ayeylet Hashachar Mizmor Ledavid. Eli Eli Lamah Azavtaní Rachok Mishuati Divrei Shaagati. Elohai Ekra Yomam Veló Taane Veleyla Veló Dumiyá Li. Veatah Kadosh Yoshév Tehilot Yisrael. Becha Vat'chu Avoteinu Vat'chu Vatefalteimo. Eleicha Zaaku Venimlatu Becha Vat'chu Veló Voshu. Veanchi Tolat Veló Ish Cherpat Adam Uvezi Am. Kol Roai Yalagú Li Yaptiru Vesafa Yaníu Rosh. Gol El Adonai Yifalteihu Yatzileihu Ki Chafetz Bo. Ki Atah Gochi Mibaten Mavtiachi Al Shedei Imi. Aleycha Hashlachtí Merachem Mibeten Imi Eli Atah. Al Tirkhak Mimeni Ki Tzarah Kerovah Ki Ein Ozeir. Sevavuni Parim Rabim Abirei Bashan Kitreuini. Patzu Alay Pihem Arye Toref Veshaeg. Kamayim Nishpachtí Vehitparedu Chol Atzmotai Hayah Libi Chadonag Namess Betoch Mei. Yavesh Kacheres Kochi Uleshoni Mudbak Malkochoi Velagafor mavet Tispeteni. Ki Sevavuni Kelavim Adat Mereim Hikifuni Kaari Yadi Veraglai. Asaper Col Atzmotai Hemmah Yabitú Yiru Bi. Yechallelu Vegadai Lahem Veal Levushí Yafillu Gorol. Veatah Adonai Al Tirchak Eyeluti Leezratí Chusha. Hatzila Mecherev Nafshi Miyad Kelev Yechidati. Hoshieini Mipi Arye Ume Karnéi Reim Anitani. Asaper Shimcha Leechái Betoch Kahal Ahallecha. Yirei Adonai Haleluhu Col Zerua Yaakov Kabedu Hu Veguru Mimenú Col Zerua Yisrael. Ki Lo Bazah Veló Shikatz Enut Ani Veló Histir Panav Mimenu Uveshavu Eilav Shamá. Meiitcha Tehilati Bekahal Rav Nedarai Ashaleim Neged Yereav. Yochelu Anavim Veyisbeu Yehalelu Adonai Dorshav Yechi Levavechem Laad. Yizkeru Veyashuvu El Adonai Col Afsei Aretz Veyishtachavu Lefanecha Col Mishpechot Goyim. Ki Ladonai Hameluchah Umóshel Bagoyim. Achlu Vayishtachu Col Dishnei Aretz Lefanav Yichreu Col Yordéi Afar Venafsho Lo Chiya. Zerua Yaavdenú Yesufar Laadonai Ladór. Yavo'u Veyagidu Tzidkato Leam Nolad Ki Asah.
No dia dezessete de Tammuz, dizemos:

Mizmor (Tehilim 79:1) LeAsaf Elohim Ba'u Goyim BeNachalatecha Tim'u Et Heichal Kodsh'cha Samu Et Yerushalayim Le'Iyim. Natnu Et Nevlat Avadecha Ma'achal Le'Oaf HaShamayim Besar Chasidecha LeChayatoh Aretz. Shafchu Damam KaMayim Sevivot Yerushalayim VeEin Koveir. Hayinu Cherpat LiShecheneinu La'ag VaKheles LiSvivoteinu. Ad Matai Yudahovah Te'enaf Lanetzach Tiva'ar KeMo Esh Kin'atcha. Shfoch Chamatcha El Hagoyim Asher Lo Yeda'ucha Ve'al Mam'lachot Asher BeShimcha Lo Karau. Ki Achal Et Ya'akov Ve'et Nav'hu Heshamu. Al Tizkor Lanu Avonot Rishonim Maher Yekadmuna Rachamecha Ki Dalnu Me'od. Oznenu Elohei Yishe'einu Al Devar Chevod Shimcha VeHatzileinu VeChapeir Al Chatot'einu LeMa'an Shimcha. Lamah Yomru Hagoyim Ayeh Eloheihem Yivadah Bagoyim LeEineinu Nikmat Dam Avadecha Hashafuch. Tavo Lefanecha Enkat Asir KeGodel Zero'a'cha Hoter Bnei Temutah. VeHashev LiShecheneinu Shiv'atayim El Cheikam Cherpatam Asher Cherfu'cha Adonai. VaAnachnu Ammecha VeTzon Mar'itecha Nodeh Lach Le'Olam Ledor VaDor Nesaper Tehilatecha.
Na casa do enlutado dizem:

Lamnatseaḥ | (Tehilim 49:1-3) Livnei Korach Mizmor. Shime'u Zot Kol Ha'amim Ha'azinu Kol Yoshevei Chaled. Gam Bnei Adam Gam Bnei Ish Yachad Ashir Ve'evyon. Pi Yedaber Chochmot Ve'hagut Libi Tevunot. Atah Lemashal Ozni Eftach Bechinor Chidati. Lamah Ira Bimei Ra Avon Akevai Yesuveni. Habotchim Al Cheilam Uverov Osheram Yit'hallelu. Ach Lo Fado Yifdeh Ish Lo Yiten Leilohim Kforo. Ve'yekar Pidyon Nafsham Ve'chadal Le'olam. Vi'chi Od Lanetzach Lo Yireh Hashachat. Ki Yireh Chachamim Yamutu Yachad Kesil Vavaer Yovedu Ve'azvu Le'acherim Cheilam. Kirbam Bateihem Le'olam Mishchenotam Ledor Vador Kar'u Bishmotam Al Adamot. Ve'adam Biykar Bal Yalin Nimshal Kabehemot Nedmu. Zeh Darkam Kesel Lamo Ve'achareihem Be'fihem Yirtzu Selah. Katzon Lish'eol Shatu Mavet Yir'em Vayirdu Vam Yesharim Laboker Vetzirim [Ve'tzuram] Levalot Sheol Miz'evul Lo. Ach Elohim Yifdeh Nafshi Miyad Sheol Ki Yikacheini Selah. Al Tira Ki Ya'asir Ish Ki Yirbeh Kevod Beito. Ki Lo Bemoto Yikach Hakol Lo Yered Acharei Kevodo. Ki Nafsho Be'chayav Yevarech Ve'yoduca Ki Teitiv Lach. Tavo Ad Dor Avotav Ad Netzach Lo Yir'u Or. Adam Biykar Ve'lo Yavin Nimshal Kabehemot Nedmu.
E há quem acrescente: Uteshu'at Tzadikim MeiAdonai Ma'ozam Be'et Tzarah. Vay'azeirem Adonai Vayefalletem Yefalletam Mereshaim Ve'yoshia'eim Ki Chasu Vo.
E recitam o Kaddish "Yehê Shlammá".

Yitgadal Ve'yitkadash Shmei Raba. [Amein] Be'alma Di Vra, Kir'utei, Ve'yamlich Malchutei, Ve'yatzmach Purkanei, Vi'karav Meshichei. [Amein] Be'chaiyeichon U've'yomeichon U've'chaiyei Dechol Beit Yisra'el, Ba'agala Uvizman Kariv, Ve'imru Amein. [Amein] Yehê Shmei Raba Mevarach Le'alam Ule'almei Almaya Yitbarach. Ve'yishtabach. Ve'yitpa'ar. Ve'yitromam. Ve'yitnasei. Ve'yithadar. Ve'yit'aleh. Ve'yithalal Shmei De'kudsha, Bric Hu. [Amein] Le'ela Min Kol Birkhata Shirata, Tushb'chata Ve'nechemata, Da'amiran Be'alma, Ve'imru Amein. [Amein].

Yehê Shlâmâ Rabbâ Min Shemayyâ. Chayyim VeSavâ VeYishuâh VeNechâmâ. VeShizavâ URefuâh UGeulâh USlichâh VeChaparâh VeRevach VeHatzalâh Lânou ULeChol Amo Yisrâêl. VeImru Amên. [Amên]. Osseh Shalôm Bimromâyv. Hu VeRachamayv Yaaseh Shalôm Aleinu VeAl Kol Amo Yisrâêl. VeImru Amên. [Amên]
Alenu: Alênu lishabêach laAdon haccol, latêt g'duláh liYotser b'reshit, shelo asanu k'goyêi haaratzot, v'lo samanu k'mishp'chot haadamah, shelo sam chelkênu cahem v'goralênu k'chol hamonam, sh'hêm mish'tachavim lahem v'rîk, umitpallêlim el El lo yoshia. VaAnachnu mishtachavim lifnei Mêlech malkêi hamm'lachim hakadosh Baruch Hu, sh'Hu notê shamayim v'yosêd aretz, umoshav y'karo bashamayim mima'al, ush'chinat uzô b'gav'hê m'romim. Hu Elohênu, v'ein od acher, emet malchênu v'efes zulato. Kachcatuv baTorah. V'yadaata hayom v'hashevota el l'vav'cha ki Adonai Hu haElohim bashamayim mima'al v'al haaretz mitachat ein od.

Al kên n'kavê lach, Adonai Eloheinu, lir'ot m'hêrah b'tif'êret uzach, l'ha'avir gilulim min haaretz, v'ha'elilim charot yikareitun, l'taken olam b'malchut Shaddai, v'chol b'nei basar yikr'u bishm'cha, l'hanfot eilecha chol rish'êi aretz. Yachiru v'yêdu kol yosh'vei têivel, ki l'cha tichra kol bêrech, tishava kol lashon. L'fanêcha, Adonai Eloheinu yichr'yu v'yipolu, v'lichvod shimcha y'kar yitênu, v'yikab'lu chulam et ol malchutecha, v'timloch alêhem m'hêrah l'olam va'ed. Ki hamalchut shelcha hi, u'l'olmêi ad timloch b'chavod. Kachcatuv b'Torat'cha: Adonai yimloch l'olam va'ed. V'ne'emar. V'haya Adonai l'melech al chol haaretz bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ush'mo echad.
Uv'Toratecha Adonai Eloheinu catuv lêmor: Sh'ma Yisra'el, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai Echad.

Vayomer im shamoa tishma l'kol Adonai Elohecha v'hayashar b'einav ta'aseh v'ha'azanta l'mitzvotav v'shamarta col chukav col hamachalah asher samti b'Mitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha. Etz chayim hi lamachazikim ba v'tomcheha meushar. Darcheihu darchei no'am v'chol netivoteha shalom. Migdal oz shem Adonai bo yarutz tzadik v'nissagav. Ki vi yirbu yamecha v'yosifu lecha shnot chayim.

L'David (Tehillim 27:1-2): Adonai ori v'yish'i mimmi ira, Adonai ma'oz chayai mimmi efchad. Bikrov alai m're'im l'echol et basari tzarai v'oivei li hemah cashlu v'nafalu. Im tachaneh alai machaneh lo yira libi im takum alai milchamah bezot ani votach. Achat shaalti mei'eit Adonai otah avakesh shivti b'veit Adonai col yemei chayai lachazot b'no'am Adonai ul'vaker b'heichalo. Ki yitzpeneini b'sukkah b'yom ra'ah yastireini b'seter ohalo b'tzur yerommeneini. V'atah yarum roshi al oivai svivotai v'ezb'cha b'oholo zivchei teru'ah ashira va'azam'rah laAdonai. Sh'ma Adonai koli ekra v'chaneni va'aneini. Lecha amar libi bakshu fanai et panecha Adonai avakesh. Al tastir panecha mimeni al tat ba'af avdecha ezrati hayita al tit'sheni v'al ta'azveni Elohei yish'i. Ki avi v'imi azavuni v'Adonai ya'aspeni. Horeini Adonai darkecha u'nechenu b'orach mishor l'ma'an shorerai. Al titteni benefesh tzarai ki kamu bi edei sheker vipeach chamas. Lule he'emanti lir'ot b'tov Adonai b'eretz chayim. Kave el Adonai chazak v'ya'ametz libecha v'kave el Adonai.

Thirteen Principles of Faith: Harei ani maamin beemunah shleimah biseloshah asar ikkarim shel haTorah hakdosha: **Aleph** ShehaKadosh Baruch Hu matzui umashgiach, **Beit** Vehu echad, **Gimel** V'ein lo guf ve'ein lo demut haguf, **Dalet** Veshehu kadmon lechol kedumim, **Heh** V'ein avodah lezulato, **Vav** Veyodea machshvot bnei adam, **Zayin** Unevuate Moshe Rabeinu aleihem hashalom emet, **Chet** Veshehu adon lechol hanviim, **Tet** VeshehaTorah netunah min hashamayim, **Yod** Veshe'lo tishtaneh beshum zman chas vshalom, **Yod Aleph** VeshehaKadosh Baruch Hu maanish larsha'im umeshalem sachar tov latzadikim, **Yod Beit** Vesheyavo melech hamashiach, **Yod Gimel** Veshehametim atidim lehichayot, Yehi ratzon milefanecha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu shetachof yetzreinu laavodatecha col yemei chayeinu tamid, Amen ken yehi ratzon.
Ten Remembrances: Esrei Zechirot (Dez Lembranças).

Para unir Kudsha Brich Hu e Sh'chinatêh, eis que estou cumprindo a mitzvá das dez lembranças que todo homem é obrigado a recordar todos os dias, e estas são: 1. Ietsiat Mitzrayim (a saída do Egito), 2. V’hashabat (o Shabat), 3. V’haman (o maná), 4. Umaaseh Amalek (o ato de Amalek), 5. Umaamad Har Sinai (o evento no Monte Sinai), 6. E como nossos antepassados provocaram a ira do Santíssimo, Baruch Hu, no deserto e especialmente com o bezerro de ouro, 7. E o conselho de Balak e Bil'am para fazer aos nossos antepassados, para que conheçamos as justiças de Yehovah, 8. U’maaseh Miryam Han’viá (o ato da profetisa Miriam), 9. A mitzvá de “V’zacharta et Yehovah Elohecha ki hu hanotên lecha choach laasot chayil” (e lembrarás de Yehovah teu Deus, pois Ele é quem te dá força para produzires riqueza), 10. E a lembrança de Yerushalayim, que será reconstruída e estabelecida em breve, em nossos dias, amém.
Há quem diga que o texto foi organizado por Chid"a, de abençoada memória, no livro Kaf Achat.

Leshem yichud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchinteih, bidchilu urechimu, urechimu udchilu, leyachda shem Yod Kei uvav Kei biyichuda shleim, beshem col Yisra'el, hareini ba lekayem mitzvat hazchirot bapeh. Letaken shoresh mitzvot eleh bemakom elyon, la'asot nachat ruach leyotzreinu. Vihî no'am Adonai Elohênu aleinu uma'aseh yadeinu chonenah aleinu uma'aseh yadeinu chonenêhu.
(1) Eis-me aqui a recordar a saída de Mitzrayim, como está dito (Shemot 13:3): "Lembra-te deste dia, em que saístes de Mitzrayim, da casa da servidão, pois com mão forte Adonai vos tirou de lá."

Vihî ratson milifanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu. SheTitmale rachamim aleinu likvod sh'chinatcha. Vehaír panecha al-mikdashcha hashamem l'maán Adonai. Uchesheim shebchasadecha hamrubeem vehagedolim higdalta et chasdecha imanu ugealtanu vegaalta et avoteinu mimitzrayim, vehaélita b'chochacha col-nitzotzei hakdushah asher nafotzu shamah bimitzrayim, velo nishar bah shum nitzotz kdushah. Ken bachasadecha hagedolim totziénu migalut zeh. Taka beshofar gadol l'cheirutenu, veKabetz n'futzoteinu me'arba kanfot haaretz, vetotzi l'or col-nitzotzei hakdushah asher nitme'u bein haklipot, chayil bala vay'kiénu mibitno yorishénu El. Galeh chevod malchutecha aleinu mehera, uva letzion goel, vetivneh beit hamikdash bimehera biyameinu. Aseh l'maán shemcha, aseh l'maán yemincha, aseh l'maán k'dushatcha, aseh l'maán toratcha, aseh bizchut Avraham Yitzchak vYaakov Moshe vAharon Yosef vDavid. Vechimei tzeitenu mimitzrayim hareinu niflaot. Vehaya Adonai lemélech al-col-haaretz bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.
(ב) Eis que estou lembrando o Shabat, como está escrito (Shemot 20:8): "Zachor et yom haShabat lekadesho."

Vehiye ratson milefanêcha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetimale rachamim aleinu veal col Yisra'el, utzachenû lishmor yom haShabbat kodesh col yemei chayeinu, bemachshava uvedibur uvema'aseh. Utzachenû lehit'aneg bo kemó she'ne'emar, vekaratá lashabbat oneg, likdosh Adonai mechubad. Veyih'yu col ma'aseinu lesheim shamayim, vetatzilenû milachato'o. Velishmor pinu uleshoneinu shelo nedaber bashabbat dibur shel chol veshum dibur asur. Veló nechetá beshum ma'aseh issur celal. Utzachenû leyached zechor veshamor Shabat laAdonai, ulechaber hadodim yachdav. Vetamshích shefa kedushat haShabbat, sheyimshóch aleinu biymei hachol shefa kedusha vetahora la'asót retzonecha kir'tzonecha, velaha'sok baTorah lishmah uvemitzvot ugemilut chasadim. Vetigalenû ge'ulah shlemah lema'an shemêcha. Bimeirá biyameinu, Amen.

(3) E eis que estou lembrando o evento no Monte Sinai, como está dito (Devarim 4:9): "Apenas cuide de si mesmo e guarde sua alma diligentemente, para que não se esqueça das coisas que seus olhos viram, e para que não se desviem de seu coração todos os dias de sua vida; e as fará conhecer a seus filhos e aos filhos de seus filhos." O dia em que vocês se posicionaram diante de Hashem, seu Elohim, em Chorev, quando Hashem me disse: "Reúna para Mim o povo, e farei com que ouçam Minhas palavras, para que aprendam a temer-Me todos os dias que viverem sobre a terra, e ensinarão a seus filhos."

Vihî ratson milifanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu. She titmale rachamim aleinu, vetita ahavah veachvah, shalom veriut beineinu uvein col Yisraêl, venihyeh leachadim, kesheim shebehár Sinai hayah shalom beineinu, kedichtiv, vayichan sham Yisraêl neged hahar: keish echad beachdut gamur, chen berachamecha harabim tezakênu lehaavir mimenu sinah vekinah vetacharut, venihyeh ohevím zeh lazeh, vetasim shalom beineinu. Uchesheim shebemaamad har Sinai paskah zuhamá mimenu, vezichachtanu vetihartanu micol tumah vechelalah vezuhamá, vekidastanu bikdushatecha, chen berachamecha harabim tetaharenu mitumatênu umizuhamateinu, utekadshênu bemitzvotecha, utetaher raionênu velibênu laavodatecha uleyiratecha, utita Toratcha bilebênu, vetihyeh yiratcha al paneinu levilti nechetá, uteorér libênu leahavat Toratcha, uvcol yom yihyeh beêneinu keilu anu mekablim Toratcha bideiká vachashiká vachafitzá. Vehaer eineinu betoratecha, utedabek libênu bemitzvotecha, uteyacheid levaveinu leahavá ulyirah et shimcha hagadol hagibor vehanora. Vetigaalênu lemaan rachamecha. Utizakênu lekabel velishmoa Torah mipícha, kemó she neemar, vechol baneich limudei Adonai verav shalom banayich. Bimehera biyameinu amen chen yehi ratson.
(4) E eis que estou cumprindo o versículo que está escrito (Devarim 8:18): "E lembrar-te-ás de YHVH teu Elohim, pois é Ele que te dá força para adquirir riqueza."

Vehareini maamin shehakol mimenu yitbarach, vechol hatov sheyesh lanu bein tovat haguf bein tovat hanefesh, hakol meito yitbarach asher higidil chasdo imanu bechol tzidkotav, uchrov rachamav yitbarach veyitaaleh. Viyehi ratzon milfanecha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, sheetimalei rachamim aleinu vetashpia aleinu shefa yeshuah verachamim, venehiye biriim bechol ramach evareinu veshasah giddeinu laavodatecha uleyiratecha. Vetatzileinu michol cholei umichol keev umichol mechush umichol midot raot. Refaeinu Adonai venirafeh, hoshieinu venevashaeah ki tehilateinu atah. Vetashpia tal haelyon mitren mazalim notzer venakeh derech cheich vegaron leaba veima, umeaba veima lizeir anpin, umizeir anpin lachakal tapuchin kadishin, umisham yishtashel veyagiya veyerache sefa yeshuah verachamim bechol haolamot, veraveh pnei teivel, vasabea et haolam kuloh mituvacha, umalei yadeinu mibirkhotcha umeosher matnot yadecha, utfarneseinu lanu ulechol benei beiteinu parnasah tovah vecalkalah miyadcha hamaleah veharchavah, bereivuach veheter venachat, bli shum ayin hara. Uverov rachamecha tatzileinu michol chet vehirhur veashmah varesha. Utzakeneinu lachazor bitshuvah sheleimah velasaok batorah lishmah uvemitzvot ugemilut chasadim. Venaaseh chayil mitovah umitzvot. Veloh yimatze vanu uvezar'einu uvezera zar'einu shum pegam veshum pesul. Utkeim banu mikra shekatuv lo yamusu mipicha umipi zarecha umipi zera zarecha amar Adonai meatah veed olam. Amen ken yehi ratzon.

(5) E eis que me recordo, com amargura de alma, de tudo o que nossos antepassados provocaram a ira do Santo, bendito seja Ele, no deserto e especialmente no bezerro de ouro, como está escrito (Devarim 9:7): "Lembra-te, não te esqueças de como provocaste à ira o Eterno, teu Elohim, no deserto; desde o dia em que saíste da terra de Mitzrayim até chegares a este lugar, fostes rebeldes contra o Eterno."

Veharei anu bushim venechlamim meod al maase avoteinu, veal maaseinu hara’im, asher chata’anu avinu ufasheanu, veavarnu al chamah meraham mitzvot aseh, veal chamah mishashah lo taaseh, ufgamnu benafshenu rucheinu venishmateinu, ufgamnu bamidot haelyonot uvchol mesilot derech hashefa’a hanishpa’ah lenafshenu rucheinu venishmateinu. Oy vaavoy lanu, ein lanu peh lehashiv velo metzach leharim rosh. Veatah, beruach nishbarah venefesh nemuchah veguf kafuf anu modim lefanecha veomrim chata’anu avinu pasheanu anachnu veavoteinu, veharei anu shavim bitshuvah. Viyehi ratzon milefanecha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, sheetmalle rachamim aleinu, utesakeinu latchazor eilecha bitshuvah sheleimah, vetatzileinu miyetser hara. Veatah berov rachamecha tetaher et kol asher fgamnu, utetaken et asher ivatnu, utelaket et asher fizarnu, utemale et col hashemot shefgamnu bahem. Azreinu Elohei yisheinu al devarecha kedvoreshem shemecha, vehatzileinu vechapeir al chatoteinu lemaan shemecha. Yihyu leratzon imrei fi vehagyon libi lefanecha Adonai tzuri veg’ali.

(6) E eis que estou lembrando a lembrança do maná com o qual o Santo, bendito seja Ele, alimentou nossos antepassados no deserto, como está dito (Devarim 8:2): "E te lembrarás de todo o caminho pelo qual o Eterno, teu Elohim, te conduziu nestes quarenta anos no deserto, para te humilhar e te provar, para saber o que estava em teu coração, se guardarias os Seus mandamentos ou não. E Ele te humilhou, e te deixou com fome, e te alimentou com o maná, que tu não conhecias, nem tampouco teus antepassados, para que Ele te fizesse saber que nem só de pão viverá o homem."

Viyehi ratson milifanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu. SheTitmale rachamim aleinu, ucheshem sherachamta al avoteinu bamidbar umancha lo manaata mipihem, vehayu pneiim laasok baTorah, chein berachamecha harabim tatzileinu michol tircha umikaf kol oreiv veoyev umichol choli, venihyeh pneiim laasok beToratecha hakdoshah. Veatah berov rachamecha tachon vetchamol aleinu, vetiten lanu ulechol benei veiteinu lechem leechol uveged lilbos, kesheim shenatata pisat lechem leechol uveged lilbos leYaakov avinu hanikra ish tam, ki ata HaEl hatov hazan umefarnes umechalkel bachasadecha lechol briyotecha, kedichtiv, poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chai ratzon. Uchetiv, noten lechem lechol basar, uchetiv, tov Adonai lachol verachamav al chol maasav. Uvechen yehi ratson milifanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shenihyeh anachnu vechol benei veiteinu bichlal harachamim vehachesed, shetiten lanu mezonoteinu bemilui uvirevach ki rachum atah. Yihyu leratson imrei fi vehagyon libi lefanecha Adonai tzuri vegooli.

(7) E eis que me recordo do que o Santo, bendito seja Ele, fez à profetisa Miriam, como está dito: (Devarim 24:9) "Lembra-te do que Hashem teu Elohim fez a Miriam, pelo caminho, quando saíeis de Mitzrayim."

Perush (haRambam z"l sof Hilchot Tum'at Tzara'at perek tza"s vahalacha hey) Hitbonenu mah eira leMiryam haNevi'ah sheDibrah beAchiha sheHayetah gdolah mimenu bashanim vegidlat oto al birkheiha vesichnah bezmam lehatsilô min hayam vehi lo dibrah bignuto eleh ta'atah shehisvato lish'ar nevi'im vehu lo hikpid, ve'af al pi chen miyad ne'enashah betsara'at: Uvechen yir'ah verad yavo vanu, al col asher chatanu avinu ufash'anu, vedibarnu lashon hara al chaverênu, ve'al hagedolim vetovim mimenu, ve'al chachmei Yisra'el. Oy lanu, ahah el nafshênu, ufagamnu balashon gam bashéker vechazav uletzanut vechanufah, vehayinu michelal arba' kutot she'einan mekablot pnei hashchinah. Al zeh hayah daveh libênu al eleh chashchu eineinu. Veharei anu mitchar'tim charatah gemurah vesha'vim beteshuvah, umevaksim mechilah uselichah vecapharah al asher no'alnu va'asher chatanu avinu ufash'anu: Viyehi ratzon milfanecha Adonai Elohênu veilohei avoteinu. SheTimchol vetislah utechaper et col chata'oteinu ufsha'einu, utizkeinu lachazor eilecha beteshuvah shlemah, utizkeinu lishmor pînu uleshonênu bakol mikol kol, veyashuv le'eitano harishon, velo yidach mimenu nidach. Amen ken yehi ratzon.

(8) E eis que estou cumprindo a mitzvá de lembrar o que Amalek fez, como está dito (Devarim 25:17): "Lembra-te do que te fez Amalek no caminho quando saíste de Mitzrayim. Como te atacou no caminho e cortou todos os fracos que ficaram para trás, e tu estavas cansado e exausto, e ele não temeu Elohim." E acontecerá, quando Hashem teu Elohim te der descanso de todos os teus inimigos ao redor na terra que Hashem teu Elohim te dá como herança para possuí-la, apagarás a memória de Amalek de debaixo dos céus; não te esquecerás.

Ribono shel olam. Yecherad libênu veyitár mimmeqomô. Asher kivyachol ein hashêm shalem veêin kissô shalem ad sheyimacheh zêcher Amalek, zê kamá meot shanim. Oy na lanu ki chatanu, vehên beavon cholanu, chulin hu lanu, ki avonoteinu hittu ele leachêv mechiate Amalek, mah nedabêr umah nitzahek, uvlev nishbar venidkeh atanu lechalót panecha. Anna Adonai aseh lemaan shimcha hagadol, vetachnia vetimacheh et zêcher Amalek, uteabêd col-zêcher lamo. Veh' Adonai leolam yeshêv, konein lamishpat kissô. Bimehera beyameinu, amen.

(9) E eis que estou cumprindo a mitzvá de lembrar como o Nome salvou nossos antepassados de Balak e Bil'am, como está dito (Mikhah 6:5): "Povo meu, lembra agora do que planejou Balak, rei de Moav, e do que respondeu a ele Bil'am ben Beor, desde Shittim até Gilgal, para que conheçamos as justiças de Hashem."

Ribono shel olam. Modim anachnu lach al col hatovot vehanissim vehaniflaot sheasis imanu veim avoteinu, uvechelal rachamecha mah shehifleta laasôt laavoteinu bamidbar vehitzaltam mibalak uvilam, vehafarta atzatam vekilkalta machshavotam, velo nitkaas bayout hayem. Vecatuv, vaiyahafoc Adonai Eloheicha lecha et haklalah livracha ki ahavcha Adonai Eloheicha. Veal culam yitbarech veyitromem veyitnasê shimecha malkeinu leolam vaed. Vecol hachayim yoduchah selah. Veyehi ratzon milfanecha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu. She titmale rahamim aleinu. Yehi chasdecha Adonai aleinu caasher yichalnu lach. Vetaper atzat oyveinu, hareir atzatam vekalkel machshavotam, vehashêv gemulam beroshâm, velo taaseinah yedeihem tusiah. Uftzeinu vehatzileinu micol tzarah, ki becha batadnu, uvechasdecha hagadol beemet nishanadnu, uveshimecha neezaradnu. Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha, vehamracheim ki lo tamu chasadecha, ki meiolam kivvinu lach. Chus veracheim ki shimecha nikra aleinu. Vekayeim lanu mah shehibtachtanu veaf gam zot biheyotam beeretz oyveihem lo meastim velo gealtim lechalotam lehafer briti itam ki ani Adonai Eloheihem. Yihyu leratzon imrei fi vehagyon libi lefanecha Adonai tzuri vegôali.

(10) Eis que estou lembrando de Yerushalayim, como está dito (Tehilim 137:5): "Se eu me esquecer de ti, Yerushalayim, que minha mão direita se esqueça. Minha língua se apegue ao meu céu da boca se eu não me lembrar de ti, se não elevar Yerushalayim acima da minha maior alegria."

Viyehi ratson milfanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, sheetrachêm al Yerushalayim ir hakodesh, hair asher bacharta, veal mikedashcha berachamecha harabim. Vekayeim lanu mah shehibtachtanu boneh Yerushalayim Adonai, nidchei Yisrael yechanes. Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, melech rachaman rachêm aleinu, tov umeitiv hidarêsh lanu, shuvah aleinu bahamon rachamecha, biglal avot sheasu retzonecha, konein beit mikedashcha al mechono, hareinu bevinyano, samecheinu betikunô, vehashev Shechinatcha letôcho, vehashev cohanim leavodatam, uleviim leshiram ulzimram. Bimehera beyameinu, Amen.

Quando sai da sinagoga, diz: Adonai nachêni vetsidkatecha lemaan shorerai, hayasher lefanai darkecha. Veiakov halach ledarko vayifgeu vo malachei Elohim. Vayomer Yaakov chaasher raam machaneh Elohim zeh, vayikra shem hamakom hahu Machanaim.

Offerings: Tefilat Minchá Leyamê Hachol (Oração de Minchá para os Dias da Semana.).

Leshem yichud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchintêhu, bidchilu urchimô, urchimô udchilu, leyachda shêm Yod Kei uvavô Kei biychuda shlem beshêm col Yisraêl. Hinê anachnu baím lehitpalel tefilat Mincha, shitkên Yitzchak Avinu alav hashalom, im col hamitzvot haclelot bah, letaken et shorshah bimkom elyon, laasôt nachat ruch lêyotzerênu ulaasôt retson boreinu. Vihî nôam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu umaaseh yadênu conenah aleinu umeaseh yadênu conenêhu.

Lamnatseach al-hagitit livnei-Korach mizmor. Mah-yedidot mishkenotecha Hashem Tzevaot. Nichsafa vegam-calta nafshi lechatzrot Hashem libbi uvesari yeranenu el-El chai. Gam-tzipor matsa bayit uderor ken lah asher-shata efrocheha et-mizbotecha Hashem Tzevaot Malki veElohai. Ashrei yoshvei beitecha od yehalelucha selah. Ashrei adam ooz-lo vacha mesilot bilvavam. Ovrei be'eimek habacha maayan yesitehu gam-berachot yaateh moreh. Yelchu mechaiyil el-chayil yerae el-Elohim betziyon. Hashem Elohim Tzevaot shim'ah tefilati haazina Elohei Yaakov selah. Maginenu ree Elohim vehabet panei meshichecha. Ki tov yom bachatzeirecha mealaf bacharti histofef beveit Elohai midur beohalei-resa'im. Ki shemesh umagen Hashem Elohim chen vecavod yiten Hashem lo yimanah-tov laholechim betamim. Hashem Tzevaot ashrei adam boteach bach.

Vayidabêr Adonai el-Moshê leimor. Tzav et-bnei Yisra'el ve'amarta aleihem et-korbanî lachmî le'ishî rei'ach nichochî tishmeru lehakriv li bemo'ado. Ve'amarta lahem zeh ha'ishah asher takrivu laAdonai kevasim bnei-shanah temimim shnayim layom olah tamîd. Et-hakeves echad ta'aseh baboker ve'et hakeves hasheni ta'aseh bein haarbayim. Va'asirit ha'eifah solet leminchah belulah beshemen katit revi'it hahin. Olat tamîd ha'asu'ah behar Sinai lerei'ach nicho'ach isheh laAdonai. Veniskô revi'it hahin lakeves ha'echad ba'kodesh hasech nesec shechar laAdonai. Ve'et hakeves hasheni ta'aseh bein haarbayim keminchat haboker ucheniskô ta'aseh isheh rei'ach nicho'ach laAdonai.
Atta hu Adonai Elohênu, shehektiru avotênu lefanêcha et ketoret hasamim, bizman sheBeit Hamikdash kayam, kaasher tsivita otam al-yad Moshe neviacha, kakatuv beToratêcha.

Vayomer Adonai el Moshe: Kach lecha samim, natáf ushékhelet vechelevneh, samim ulevonah zakáh. Bad bevad yihyeh. Veasisá otá ketoret rokéach maaseh rokéach memulách tahor kodesh. Vesachakta mimmená hadek, venatata mimmená lifnei haedut beohel moed, asher ivade lach shamá. Kodesh kadashim tihyeh lachem. Veneemar vehiktir alav Aharon ketoret samim, baboker baboker, behetivo et hanerot yakhtirena. Uvehaalot Aharon et hanerot bein haarbayim yakhtirena, ketoret tamid lifnei Adonai ledoroteichem.

Tanu rabanan: pitum haqtoret keitzad? shelosh meot veshishim ushmonah manim hayu bah. shelosh meot veshishim vachamishah keminyan yemot hachamah, mane bemcol yom, machatsito baboker umachatsito baerev. usheloshah manim yetirim, shemeihem makhnis kohen gadol, venotel meihem melo chafnav beyom hakipurim, umachziran lemachtet bam erev yom hakipurim, kedai lekayem mitvat dakah min hadakah. veachad asar samanim hayu bah, veelu hen:

1. Hats'tsori, 2. Vehatsiporen, 3. Vehachalbenah, 4. Velvonah, mishkal shiv'im shiv'im maneih. 5. Mor, 6. Uketzi'ah, 7. Veshiboleth ner'de, 8. Vecharkom, mishkal shisha asar shisha asar maneih. 9. Kosht shneim asar, 10. Kippulah shloshah, 11. Kinamon tish'ah, borit-karsheinah tish'ah kabin. 12. Yayin kaprisin se'in telat ve'kabin telata. 13. Ve'im lo matsa yayin kaprisin, mevi chamra chivvar atik. 14. Melach sedomit, rova. 15. Ma'aleh ashan, kol shehu. 16. Ribbi Natan habavli omer: af kippat hayarden kol shehi, im natan bah devash p'salah, ve'im chiser achat mikol sammaneyha, chayav mitah.

Rabán Shim'on ben-Gamliel omer: hatsori einô ela sheráf, hanotef me'atzei hak'taf. Bôrit karsheená, lema hi vaá? kedê lishapot bah et-hatsipôren, kedê shet'hê naá. Yáin kaprisin, lema hu va? kedê lishrót vo et-hatsipôren kedê shet'hê azá. Vehalo mei raglayim yafeen lah? Elá she'ein makhnisin mei raglayim bamikdash, mifnei hakavód.

Tanya Ribbi Natán omer: keshé hu shokhéq, omer: hadék heitev, heitev hadék. mifnéi shehaqól yafe laressamim. pittmah lachatáim, kesherá. lashalish ulreviá, lo shamánu. amar Ribbi Yehudá: zéh haklal, im kemidatáh, kesherá lachatáim. veim hissér akhat mikol sammanéihá, khayav mitá.

Tani Bar-Kappara: Achat leshishim o leshivim shanim, haytah vaah shel Shirayim lachatzayim. Veod tani Bar-Kappara: Ilu hayah noten bah kartov shel devash, ein adam yachol laamod mifnei reichah. Velamah ein mearevin bah devash, mipnei shehaTorah amrah: Ki chol seor vechol devash lo taqtiru mimenu isheh LaAdonai. Adonai Tzevaot imanu, misgav lanu Elohei Yaakov selah. Adonai Tzevaot, asheri adam botayach bach. Adonai hoshiah, hamelech yaaneinu beyom korenu. Veareivah LaAdonai minchat Yehudah viYerushalayim, kiymei olam ucheshanim kadmoniyot.
Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od yehalelucha selah. Ashrei haam shekachá lo, ashrei haam sheAdonai Elohav.

Tehilá leDavid. Arômimchá Elohai hamelech, veavarechá shimechá leolam vaed. Bechol yom avarechechá, veahalelách shimechá leolam vaed. Gadól Adonai umevulál meod, veligdulató ein cheker. Dor ledor yeshabach maasechá, ugevurotechá yagidu. Hadar khevód hodécha, vedivrei niflaotechá asichá. Veozuz norotechá yoméru, ugdulátecha asaperená. Zecher rav tuvechá yabiu, vetsidkatechá yeranenu. Chanun verachum Adonai, erech apayim ugdol chesed. Tov Adonai lachol, verachamav al kol maasáv. Yoduchá Adonai chol maasechá, vechasidechá yevarechucha. Khevód malchutechá yoméru, ugevurátecha yedabéru. Lehodiya libnei haadam gevurotav, uchevód hadar malchuto. Malchutechá, malchut chol olamim, umemshaltécha bechol dor vador. Someich Adonai lechol hanoflim, vezokef lechol hakefufim. Einei chol eleicha yesabéru, veata noten lahem et ochlam beitó. Foteach et yadechá, umasbia lechol chai ratzon. Tzadik Adonai bechol derachav, vechasid bechol maasáv. Karov Adonai lechol koreav, lechol asher yikrauhu beemet. Retzon yereav yaaseh, veet shavatám yishma, veyoshiaem. Shomer Adonai et chol ohevav, veet chol harashaim yashmid. Tehilát Adonai yedabér fi, veyivarech chol basár shem kodsho leolam vaed. Vanachnu nevarech Yah, meata veed olam. HaleluYah.
Tikon tefilati ketoret lefanêcha masat kapai minchat-arev. Haqshiva leqol shav'ati malki veElohai ki-elecha etpallel.
E o chazan diz o Chatzi Kaddish.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemêh rabá. [Amên] Bealma divrá, kiruteh, veyamlich malchutêh, veyatzmach purkanêh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amên] Bechayêchon uvêyomechon uvêchayê dechol beit Yisra'el, baagalá uvizman kariv, veimru amên. [Amên] Yehê shemêh rabá mevorach lealam ulalmê almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnassei. Veyithadar. Veyitalle. Veyithalal shemêh dekudsha, bêrich hu. [Amên] Leela min chol birchata shirata, tushbchata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru amên. [Amên]
Amida: Amidá para Dia Comum.
Adonai sefatái tiftách ufí yagíd tehilatecha.

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, veElohei Yaakov.
