HaEl hagadol hagibor vehanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, koneh hakol, vezocher chasdei avot, umeivi goel livnei veneihem lemaan shemo beahavah. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: Zochreinu lechayim, melech chafetz bachayim, katveinu besifer chayim, lemaancha Elohim chayim. Melech ozer umoshia umagen. Baruch ata Adonai, magen Avraham.
Atta gibor leolam Adonai, mechayeh metim ata, rav lehoshia.
No verão: morid hatal. No inverno: mashiv haruach umorid hageshem.

Mekhalkhel chayim bechesed, mechayeh metim berachamim rabbim, someich nophlim, verofê cholim, umatir asurim, umekayem emunato liyshenei afar. Mi chamocha ba'al gevurot, umi dome lecha, melech memit umechayeh umatzmiach yeshuah. Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento dizemos: Mi chamocha av harachaman, zocher yetsurav berachamim lechayim. Veneeman atah lehachayot metim. Baruch ata Adonai, mechayeh hametim.
Kedushah:   Durante a repetição do Shemoneh Esrei, dizem:

Nakdishách venaaritzách, kenó'am sich sóde sarféi kodesh, hamshalleishim lach kedushá, vechén katuv al yad neviách: vekará zé el-zé veamár, kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai Tzevaot, melo chol ha'aretz kevodo. Leumamátam meshabchím veomrim: baruch kevod Adonai mimekomó. Uvedevaréi kodeishách katuv le'emor: yimloch Adonai leolam, Elohai'ich Tziyon ledor vador, haleluyá.
Atta kadosh veShimcha kadosh, uKdoshim bechol yom yehalelucha selah. Baruch ata Adonai, HaEl hakadosh. Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento dizemos: hamelech hakadosh.
Atta chonen leadam daat umelamed leenosh binah. Vechanênu meiit'cha chochmah binah vedaat. Baruch ata Adonai, chonen hadda'at.
Hashivênu Avinu letorátecha, veqarvênu Malkeinu laavodatecha, vehachazirênu bitshuvah shlemah lefanêcha. Baruch ata Adonai, harotzeh bitshuvah.
Sélach lanu Avinu ki chatanu, méchol lanu Malkênu ki fasha'anu, ki El tov vesalach atah. Baruch ata Adonai, chanun hamarbeh lisloach.
Reê na beonênu, veribá ribênu, umaheir legaaleinu geuláh shelêmáh lemaan shemêcha, ki El goel chazák atah. Baruch ata Adonai, goel Yisraêl.
No jejum público, o shaliach tzibur repete em voz alta.

Anênu Avinu, anênu bêyom tsom hataaniit haze, ki vetsarah gêdolah anachnu. Al-têfen lêrishênu, veal-tit'alám malchênu mibakkashatênu. Heye na karov lêshavatênu, terem nikra êlecha atah taane, nêdaber veatah tishma, kadavar shenêemar: vehaya terem yikrá'u vaani eeneh, od hem m'dabrim vaani eshma. Ki atah Adonai podeh umatsil, veoneh um'rachêm bêchol-êt tsarah vêtsuka.
Baruch ata Adonai, haoneh leamô Yisra'el be'et tzarah.

Refáeinu Adonai venêrafêa, hôshíeinu venevashêa, ki tehilatênu atá, vehealeh aruchá umarpe lechol tachaluênu ulechol machovênu ulechol makotênu. Ki El rofe rachmán venéemán atá. Baruch ata Adonai, rofe cholê amo Yisra'el.
No verão:

Baruchênou Adonai Elohênu bechol maasei yadênou, ubevarech shenatênou betallei ratson berachá unedavá, utêhi acharitá chayim vesava veshalom cashanim hatovot livracha, ki El tov umetiv atá umevarech hashanim. Baruch ata Adonai, mevarech hashanim.
No inverno:

Barêch alênu Adonai Elohênu et-hashanah hazot veet-kol-minei tevuatah letovah, vetên tal umatar livrachah al kol-pnei haadamah, veraveh pnei tevel vesava et-haolam kulô mituvecha, umalei yadeinu mibirkhotêcha umeosher matanot yadecha. Shomerah vehatsilah shanah zo michol davar ra, umichol-minei mashchit umichol-minei puraniut, vaaseh lah tikvah tovah veacharit shalom. Chus verachêm aleha veal kol-tevuatah ufeiroteha, uvorchah bigishmei ratzon berachah unedavah, utehi acharitah chayim vesava veshalom. Kashanim hatovot livrachah, ki El tov umeitiv atah umevarech hashanim. Baruch ata Adonai, mevarech hashanim.
Teaka beshofar gadol lecheiruteinu, vesá nés lekabetz galuyoteinu, vekabetzeinu yachad me'arba kanfot ha'aretz le'artzeinu. Baruch ata Adonai, mekabetz nidchei amo Yisra'el.

Hashivá shofteynu kivarishoná, veyo'atzeynu kivatchilá, vehaser mimenu yagón va'anachá. Umeloch aleinu meheirá atah Adonai levadecha, bechesed uverachamim, betzedek umishpat. Baruch ata Adonai, melech ohev tzedakah umishpat. Durante os dez dias de arrependimento dizemos: hamelech hamishpat.

Lamminim velamalshinim al-tehi tikvá, vecol-hazedim kerega yovedu, vecol-oyevecha vesoneicha meherá yicaretu, umalcút harishá meherá teaker veteshaber vetecalém vetachniéhem bimeherá beyameinu. Baruch ata Adonai, shover oyevim umachnia minim.

Al hatsadiqim veal hachasidim, veal she'erit am'cha beit Yisra'el, veal pleitát beit sof'reihem, veal geré hatsedeq ve'alénu, yehemu na rachamecha, Adonai Eloheinu, veten sachar tov lechol habot'chim beshim'cha be'emeth, vesim chelkenu imahem. ule'olam lo nevosh ki vecha vatáchnu, ve'al chasdecha haggadol be'emeth nish'anánu: Baruch ata Adonai, mis'an umivtach latsadiqim.
Tishkon betoch Yerushaláim irêcha casher dibartá, veçissei Dávid avdêcha mheirá betochah takín, uvéne otáh binyán olám bimheirá beyamêinu.

No nono dia de Av dizemos: Nacheim Adonai Elohênu et avelei Tsiyon ve'et avelei Yerushaláim, ve'et haír hachareivah vehabzuyah, vehashomemah, mibeli vanéiha hi yoshévet, veroshája chafui k'ishshah akrarah sheilo yaladah. Vayevale'uha ligyonim vayirashuha, vayatilu et amecha Yisra'el lacherev, vayahargu vezadon chasidêi elyon. Al kein Tsiyon bamerer tivkeh, viYerushaláim titen kolah: Libbi libbi al chaleileihem, me'ay maiy ay al harugeihem. Ki ata Adonai ba'esh hetzatah, uvá'esh ata atid livnotah, kakanú: Vaani eh'yeh lah, ne'um Adonai, chomat ésh saviv, ulechavod eh'yeh betochah.
Baruch ata Adonai, menacheim Tsiyon bivniyan Yerushalaim. E continuamos com "Et tzemach" etc.
Baruch ata Adonai, boneh Yerushalaim.
Et Tsemach David avdêcha mheirá tatzmíach, vekarnô tarúm bishuátêcha, ki lishuátêcha kivínu chol-hayom. Baruch ata Adonai, matzmiach kerem yeshuá.

Shemá kolênu, Yehová Eloheinu, Av harachaman, rachêm aleinu, vekabeil berachamim uveratson et tefilatênu, ki El shomea tefilot vetachanunim atá. Umilfanecha Malkênu, reikam al teshiveinu, channeinu vaaneinu ushema tefilatênu.

Na oração de jejum, o indivíduo diz "Anenu", e também o emissário da congregação que esqueceu de recitá-la entre a Bênção do Redentor e a Bênção do Cura-dor deve dizer aqui “Anenu” sem encerramento. Anenu Avinu, anenu beYom tzom haTa'anit hazeh, ki vetzarah gedolah anachnu. Al-tenaf leRisheinu, veAl-tit'alam Malkeinu mibakkashateinu. Heyeh na karov lishav'ateinu. Terem nikkra elecha atah ta'aneh, nedaber veAtah tishma, kadavar shenemar: vehaya terem-yikra'u ve'ani e'eneh, od hem medabrimim ve'ani eshma. Ki Atah Adonai podeh umatzil veoneh umeracheim bekhol-eit tzarah vetzukah.

O texto do "Anenu" nos Três Jejuns (citado em Sanhedrin 3:9 ): Anênu Avinu, anênu beyom tsom hataanit hazeh, ki vetsarah gedolah anachnu. Al kol asher chata nu avinu pashanu anachnu vaavoteinu, veal yedei zeh charvah irênu veshamem mikdashênu. Oy vaavoy lanu, ki avonoteinu hitu eleh ufsheaneinu heerichu kitzênu. Ein lanu peh lehashiv velo metzach leharim rosh, uchemotsa'ar benafshênu al churban Beit Hamikdash uvittul Torah vaavodah, zeh kamah meot shanim, vezeh tza'ar hashamayim, ahah aleinu. Lachen ata shavnu eilecha bevoshet vecherpah uchlimah uvdeima lev nevakshah meEloheinu meracheim. Ana Adonai, yehi ratzon milfanecha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, sheyehi mi'ut chelevênu vedamênu hamitma'et beta'aniteinu hayom kachélev munach al gabbei hamizbe'ach, shtechefer bo chol chatoteinu avonoteinu ufsheaneinu. Ha'er panecha al mikdashecha hashamem lema'an Adonai, uvá letzion go'el. Al tefen lerisheinu, ve'al tit'alám Malkeinu mibakashateinu. Heye na karov lesha'avateinu. Terem nikra eilecha atah ta'aneh, nedabber ve'atah tishma, kadavar shene'emar: Vehayah terem yikra'u va'ani e'eneh, od hem medabrim va'ani eshma. Ki ata Adonai podeh umatzil ve'oneh umeracheim bechol et tzarah vetzukah.
Ki atáh shomeá tefilát kol peh. Baruch atáh Adonai, shomeá tefilá.

Rétze Adonai Eloheinu veammecha Yisra'el velitfilatám shéa, vehashéiv haavodá lidvir betécha, veishei Yisra'el utfilatám, meherá beahavá tekabel beratzón, utéhi leratzón tamíd avodát Yisra'el ammecha.
No início do mês e em todos os dias festivos dizem:

Elohênu veElohêi avotênu, yaaleh veyavo, veyagia veyeráeh, veyerátseh veyishamá, veyifakéd veyizakeir, zikhronênu vezikhron avotênu, zikhron Yerushaláim irêcha, vezikhron Mashiach ben-David avdêcha, vezikhron kol-amêcha beit Yisraél lefanêcha, lifleitá, letová, lechen, lechesed ulerachamim, lechayim tovim uleshalom, beyom...
No início do mês: "Rosh Chodesh Hazeh",
Durante Chol HaMoed Pesach: "Chag Hamatzot Hazeh, Beyom Mikra Kodesh Hazeh",
Durante Chol HaMoed Sukkot: "Chag Hasukkot Hazeh, Beyom Mikra Kodesh Hazeh",

Leracheim bo aleinu, ulhoshieinu. Zachreinu Adonai Eloheinu bo letovah, ufokedeinu bo livracha, vehoshieinu bo lechayim tovim, bidvar yeshua verachamim. Chus vechaneinu, vechamol veracheim aleinu, vehoshieinu ki elecha einenu, ki El Melech chanun verachum ata.
Veachatah berachamecha harabim, tachpótz banu vetirtzénu, vetechézenah eineinu beshuvcha letziyon berachamim. Baruch ata Adonai, hamachazir shechinató letziyon.
Na bênção de "Modim", ele se inclinará em "Modim" e se levantará com o Nome. (Ben Ish Chai, Beshalach 21).

Modim anáchnu lach, sheátta hú Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu leolam vaed, tsurênu tsur chayênu umagen yishênu atah hú, ledor vador nodeh lach unesaper tehilatecha, al chayênu hammsurim beyadecha, veal nishmoteinu happekudot lach, veal nissecha shebekhol yom immanu, veal niflotêcha vetovotecha shebekhol et, erev vavoker vetsahorayim. Hatov, ki lo chalu rachamecha, hamrachem, ki lo tamu chasadecha, ki meiolam kivvinu lach.

Modim Derabanan: Durante a repetição do Shemoneh Esrei, quando o chazan diz Modim, a congregação recita: MoDim Anachnu lach, sheAtah hu Adonai Eloheinu vElohei Avoteinu, Elohei kol basar, Yotzerenu Yotzeir Bereishit. Berachot vHodaot lShimcha hagadol v’hakadosh, al sheHechayitanu vKiyamtanu. Kein techayeynu utchanenu vTese'of galuyoteinu lChatzrot kodshecha, lishmor chukecha vLa’asot retzonecha uLe’avdecha b’levav shaleim, al sheAnachnu modim lach, Baruch El hahodaot.
Em Chanucá e Purim dizemos:
Al hannissim veal hafurkan veal hagevurot veal hatteshuot veal hanniflaot veal hannechamot sheasisa laavoteinu bayamim haheim bazman haze.

Na época de Chanucá, dizemos: Bimê Matityah ven-Yochanan kohen gadol, Chashmonaí uvaneh em ked amda malchut Yavan harshaah al amêcha Yisra'el, lishakcham Toratecha ulha'aviram mechukei ratzoncha. Ve'atah berachamecha harabim amadata lahem be'et tzaratam, ravta et rivam, danta et dinam, nakamta et nikmatam. Masarta giborim beyad chalashim, verabim beyad me'atim, uredashim beyad tzadikim, utme'im beyad tehorim, vezedim beyad osekai Toratecha. Lecha asita shem gadol vekadosh be'olamecha, ule'amcha Yisra'el asita teshu'ah gedolah uforkan kehayom hazeh. Ve'achar kach ba'u vanecha lidvir beitecha, ufino et heichalecha, vetiharu et mikdashecha, vehadliku nerot bechatzrot kodshecha, ve'kav'u shemonat yemei Chanukah eleh behallel uvehoda'ah. Ve'asita imahem nissim venifla'ot, vene'odeh lishimcha hagadol selah.

Em Purim dizemos: Bimey Mord'chay veEstêr beshushan habirah. Keshe'amad aleihem Haman harasha. Bikésh lehashmid, laharog uleabed et col hayehudim mina'ar ve'ad zaken, taf venashim beyom echad. Bishloshah asar lechodesh shneim asar, hu chodesh Adar, ushelalam lavoz. Ve'atah berachamecha harabim hefartah et atzato vekilkaltah et machashevato, vehashevotah lo gemulo verosho. Vetalu oto ve'et banav al ha'etz. Ve'asita imahem nes vafela venodeh lesheimcha hagadol selah.

Veachal kulám yitbaréch, veyitromám, veyitnassé, tamíd, shimcha Malkeinu, leolám vaéd. Vechol hachayím yoduchá selá. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: Uchetov lechaiim tovim kol bnei beritecha. Viyehalelu viyvarechu et shimcha hagadol be'emét leolam ki tov, ha'el yeshuateinu ve'ezrateinu selá, ha'el hatov. Baruch ata Adonai, hatov shimcha ulecha naé lehodot.
Birkat Cohanim:
Durante o jejum público, quando se reza a Minchá pequena dentro de meia hora próximo ao pôr do sol, diz-se a Birkat Cohanim:

Quando o Cohen se levanta para erguer suas mãos [para abençoar], deve dizer (Ben Ish Chai, Tetzavê 12): Leshem yichud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchintêi. Bidchilu urchimu, urchimu udchilu. Leyachda shem Yod Kei uvav Kei biyichuda shleim. Beshem col Yisraêl, hinê anochi muchan umzuman lekayem mitzvat ase levarêch et Yisraêl birchat Cohanim binisiut capayim, laasot nachat ruach leyotzerênu ulhamsheech shefa uvracha lcol haolamot uleasot retzon boreênu. Vihii noam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu umaase yadeinu conenah aleinu umaase yadeinu conenêhu.

E quando os Cohanim se colocam no duchan [após responderem Modim d'Rabbanan], dizem: Yehiyê ratson milifanecha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu sheetihyeh berachá zo sheetzivitanu levarech et amecha Yisra'el berachá shlemá velo yihyeh bah michshol ve'avon me'ata ve'ad olam.

Se houver mais de um Cohen presente, o chazan chama-os: Cohanim. E os Cohanim abençoam: Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu Melech haOlam, asher kidshanu bikdushato shel Aharon, vetzivanu levarech et amo Yisrael beAhava. A congregação responde: Amem.
E o chazan repete, e os Cohanim atrás dele, palavra por palavra:
Yevarechecha Adonai veYishmerecha. E respondem: Amém. Yaer Adonai panav eilecha vihunecha. E respondem: Amém. Yisa Adonai panav eilecha veyasem lecha shalom. E respondem: Amém.

E quando o emissário da comunidade ( shelich tzibur) começa a recitar "Shim Shalom", então eles voltam seus rostos em direção ao heichal, e não devem virar seus rostos antes disso; e então os Cohanim dizem: Ribon ha'olamim, asinu mah shegazarta aleinu, aseh ata mah she'hibtachta otanu. Hashkifah mime'on kodsh'cha min ha'shamayim u'varech et am'cha et Yisra'el.
Se não houver kohanim, o chazan diz:
Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, barechenu habberachah hamushellet bahatorah hakktuvah al yedei Moshe avdecha, haamurah mipi Aharon uvanei hem haccohanim am kedoshecha kaamur:
"Yevarechecha Adonai v'yishm'recha." E respondem: "Ken yehi ratzon."
"Ya'er Adonai panav eilecha vi'chuneka." E respondem: "Ken yehi ratzon."
"Yissa Adonai panav eilecha v'yaseim lecha shalom." E respondem: "Ken yehi ratzon." "V'samu et shemi al bnei Yisrael va'ani avarechem."

Sim shalom tová uverachá, chayim chen vachesed verachamim, aleinu veal col Yisra'el amechá. Uvarcheinu Avinu culanu keechad beor panécha, ki veor panécha natata lanu Adonai Elohênu Torá vechayim, ahavá vachesed, tzedaká verachamim, berachá veshalom. Vetov be'einecha levarecheinu ulevarech et col amechá Yisra'el, berov oz veshalom. Durante os Dez Dias de Arrependimento dizem: uvasefer chayim, berachá veshalom, ufarnasá tová viyshu'á venechamá, ugezerot tovot, nizakeir venicatév lefanecha, anachnu vecol amechá Beis Yisra'el, lechayim tovim uleshalom. Baruch ata Adonai, hamevarech et amo Yisra'el bashalom. Amen.
Yihyu leratzon imrei fi vehagyon libi lefanêcha, Adonai tzuri vegóali.

Elohái, netsór lishoní merá vesiftoí midabêr mirma, velimkalai nafshi tidom, venafshi keafár lachol tihyeh. Petach libí betoratecha, veacharei mitzvotecha tirdef nafshi. Vechol haqamim alai leraá, meheirá haref atzatam vekalkeil machshavotam. Yihyu kemot lifnei ruach, umalach Adonai docheh. Kabêl rinat amecha. Sagbénu taharenu norá. Ase lemaán shemcha, ase lemaán yeminecha, ase lemaán toratecha, ase lemaán kedushatcha.
É uma virtude dizer o versículo que começa e termina com a letra com a qual o nome dele começa e termina: "Lema'an yeichaltzun Yedidecha, hoshia yeminecha va'aneini."

Yihyu leratzon imrei-fi vehagyon libi lefanêcha, Adonai tzuri vegóali. Yehi ratzon milfanêcha, Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, shetiten lanu chayim aruchim, chayim shel shalom, chayim shel tovah, chayim shel brachah, chayim shel parnasah, chayim shel chilutz atzamot, chayim sheyesh bahem yirat chet, chayim sheein bahem bushah uchlumah, chayim shel osher vekavod, chayim shetehê bahem ahavat Torah veyirat shamayim, chayim shetemale et kol mishalot libeinu letovah.

Quem deseja jejuar um jejum individual no dia seguinte, deve aceitar o jejum durante a oração de Minchá com esta formulação: Ribon haolamim, hareini lefanêcha al tenai b'ta'anit nedavah lemáchar me'alot hashachar ad tset hakochavim, ve'im lo uchal o lo ertzeh, kesheomer mizmor ledavid Adonai roi, uchal lehafsiach, velo yihyê bi shum avon. Aval yehi ratzon milfanecha Adonai Elohái veilohei avotai, shetiten bi choach uvrirut, ve'ezke lehit'anot lemáchar, utkableni be'ahavah uveratzon, utzakêni lashuv bitshuvah shelemah, vet'aaneh atirati, vetishma tefilati, ki ata shome'a tefilat kol peh, baruch shome'a tefilah.

Em um dia de jejum deve-se dizer: Ribon haolamim, galui lefanêcha bizman sheBeit hamikdash kayam, adam chote veumakriv korban, veêin makrivim mimenu ela cheilbo vedamo umitchaper lo. Veachshav yashavti betaanit venitmaet cheilbi vedami. Yehi ratzon milfanêcha sheyehi cheilbi vedami shenitmaet keilu hikravti otfan lefanêcha al gabbei hamizbeach vetirtzêni.
Oseh shalom, Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: Hashalom. Bimeromav, hu verachamav yaaseh shalom aleinu, veal kol amo Yisra'el, veimru amen.
Yehi ratzon milfanêcha, Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetivneh Beit hamikdash bimeheirah biyameinu, veten chelkeinu betoratecha laasot chukei retzoncha uleavdacha belebab shalem.
Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos:
Avinu Malkeinu, chatanu lefanêcha, racheim aleinu.
Avinu Malkeinu, asseh imanu lema'an shemecha.
Avinu Malkeinu, chadesh aleinu shanah tovah.
Avinu Malkeinu, batel mealeinu kol gezerot kashot vera'ot.
Avinu Malkeinu, batel machshavot soneinu.
Avinu Malkeinu, haref atzat oyveinu.
Avinu Malkeinu, kaleh kol tzar umasitín mealeinu.
Avinu malkeinu kaleh dever vecherev veráah veráav ushvi uvizá umashchit umageifá veyétser hará vejoláim raím mibenê beritêcha.
Avinu Malkeinu shalach refuáh shelemáh lechol cholei amêcha:
Avinu Malkeinu mena maggeifáh minnachalátecha:
Avinu Malkeinu zachuhr ki afár anáchnu:
Avinu Malkeinu mechol useleach lechol avonoteinu:
Avinu Malkeinu kera roá gezar dineinu: (yichaven beshem kar"a shat"an).
Avinu Malkeinu mechok berachamecha harabim chol shitrei chovoteinu:
Avinu Malkeinu meche vehaaver peshaeinu mineged einecha:
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besêfer chayim tovim:
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besêfer tzadikim vechasidim:
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besêfer yesharim uteimim:
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besêfer parnasáh vecalkaláh továh:
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besêfer mechiláh uselicháh vecapparáh:
Avinu Malkeinu katveinu besêfer geuláh viyshuáh:
Avinu Malkeinu zachreinu bezichron tov milfanêcha:
Avinu Malkeinu hatzmach lanu yeshuáh bekarov:
Avinu Malkeinu harem keren Yisraél amêcha:
Avinu Malkeinu veharem keren meshichecha:
Avinu Malkeinu chanênu vaaneinu:
Avinu Malkeinu hachazireinu bitshuváh shelemáh lefanêcha:
Avinu Malkeinu shema koleinu chus veracheim aleinu:
Avinu Malkeinu aseh lemaánacha im lo lemaáneinu:
Avinu Malkeinu kabêl berachamim uveratzon et tefilateinu:
Avinu Malkeinu al teshiveinu reikam milfanêcha:
Nos dias em que não se diz Tachanun, dizemos:

Yehi shem Adonai mevorách, meata veád olam. Mimizrach shemesh ad mevoó, mehulál shem Adonai. Ram al col goyim Adonai, al hashamáyim kevodó. Adonai adonênu, mah adir shimchá becol haaretz. E depois o chazan diz o Chatzi Kaddish.
Vidui: Viduí.

Aná Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu. Tavo lefanêcha tefilateinu. Veal tit'alám melecheinu mit'chineinu. She'ein anachnu azêi fanim uk'shei oref lomar lefanêcha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu tzadikim anachnu velo chatanu. Aval chatanu. Avinu. Fash'anu. Anachnu vaavoteinu veanshei veiteinu: ashmanu. Bagadnu. Gazalnu. Dibarnu dofí uleshon hara. He'evinu. Vehirsh'anu. Zadnu. Chamásnu. Tafalnu sheker umirmah. Ya'atstnu etzot ra'ot. Kizavnu. Ka'asnu. Latznu. Maradnu. Marinu devarecha. Ni'atznu. Ni'afnu. Sararnu. Avinu. Fash'anu. Pagamnu. Tzararnu. Tza'arnu av va'em. Kishinu oref. Rash'anu. Shichatnu. Ti'avnu. Ta'inu veti'ate'anu. Vesarnu mimitzvotecha umimishpatecha hatovim velo shavá lanu. Veatah tzadik al kol haba aleinu. Ki emet asita. Va'anachnu hirsh'anu.

El erech apayim ata uvaal harachamim. Gedulat rachamecha vechasadecha hodaata leanav mikedem. vecen katuv betoratecha. Vayered Adonai beeanan vayityatzev imo sham, vayikra beshem Adonai. Vesam neemar.
Vayaavor Adonai al panav vayikra, Adonai Adonai, El rachum vechanun, erech apayim verav chesed veemet. Notzer chesed laalafim, nose avon vapesha vechataah venakeh.
Rachum vechanun, chatanu lefanecha, racheim aleinu vehoshieinu.
Deve ser dito sentado.

Ledavid (Tehilim 25) Elecha Adonai nafshi esa. Elohai becha vatachti al-eboshah, al-yaaltzu oyevai li. Gam chol-koveicha lo yevoshu, yevoshu habogdim reikam. Derachecha Adonai hodiaeni, orchoteicha lamdeini. Hadricheni veamitecha velammedeni ki-ata Elohei yishii, otcha kiviti chol-hayom. Zchor-rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meiolam hemah. Chatot neuray ufshaay al-tizkor, kechasdecha zchor-li-ata, lemaan tubcha Adonai. Tov veyashar Adonai, al-ken yoreh chataim baderech. Yadreich anavim bamishpat vilammed anavim darko. Col-orchot Adonai chesed veemet, lenotzrei berito veedotav. Lemaan-shimcha Adonai vesalachta laavonai ki rav-hu. Mi-ze haish yere Adonai, yorenu bederech yivchar. Nafsho betov talin vezar'o yiyras aretz. Sod Adonai lire'av uvrito lehodi'am. Einei tamid el-Adonai ki hu-yotzi mereset raglai. Peneh-elai vechanneini, ki-yachid veani ani. Tzarot levavi hirchivu mimitsukotai hotzi'eni. Re'eh onyi ve'amali, vesa lechol-chatotai. Re'eh-oyvai ki-rabu, vesinat chamas saneuni. Shemrah nafshi vehatzileini, al-ebosh ki-chasiti vach. Tom vayosher yitzruni, ki kiviti cha. Feideh Elohim et-Yisrael michol tzarotav. Vehu yifdeh et-Yisrael michol avonotav.
Adonai Elohei Yisra'el, shuv mecharon apêcha vehinachêm al hara'ah le'amêcha.

Avînu Malkeinu, Avînu Atah. Avînu Malkeinu ein lanu melech ella Atah. Avînu Malkeinu rachêm alênu. Avînu Malkeinu chanênu va'anênu ki ein banu ma'asim. Aseh imanu tzedakah vachesed lema'an shimcha hagadol vehoshî'einu. Va'anachnu lo nedah mah na'aseh ki aleicha eineinu.

Zechor rachamecha Adonai vachasadecha ki meiolam hemah. Yehi chasdecha Adonai aleinu ka'asher yichalnu lach. Al tizkor lanu avonot rishonim maher yekadmuna rachamecha ki dalnu meod. Ezrenu beshem Adonai oseh shamayim va'aretz. Chanênu Adonai chanênu ki rab sava'nu buz. Berogez rachem tizkor. Berogez ahavah tizkor. Berogez akeidah tizkor. Berogez temimut tizkor. Adonai hoshiah hammelech ya'anenu beyom koreinu. Ki hu yada yitzreinu zochur ki afar anachnu. Ozrenu Elohei yisheinu al devar kevod shemecha vehatzilênu vechapeir al chattoteinu lema'an shemecha.
E o chazan diz o Kaddish Tiskabel.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabba. [Amein] Be'alma di vra, kir'uteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amein] Bechayêchon uv'yomeichon uv'chayê dechol beit Yisra'el, ba'agala uvizman kariv, ve'imru amein. [Amein] Yehê shemeh rabba mevorach le'alam ul'almei almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpa'ar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyit'aleh. Veyithalal shemeh dekudsha, barch hu. [Amein] Le'ela min kol birkhata shirata, tushb'chata venechemata, da'amiran be'alma, ve'imru amein. [Amein].
Titkabal tzelotána uvautána, im tzelotehon uvautéhon dechol beit Yisra'el, kodam avuná debishmayá ve'ará, ve'imru amen. [Amen].
Yehê shlamá raba min shmayá. Chayim vesava vishu'á venchamá, vesheizava urfu'á uge'ulá uslichá vechapará verauach vehatzalá lanu ulchol amo Yisra'el. Ve'imru amen. [Amen].
Deve dar três passos para trás. Osseh shalom bimromáv, hu verachamáv ya'aseh shalom aleinu ve'al kol amo Yisra'el. Ve'imru amen. [Amen].
Na véspera de Shabat não se recita "Lamenatzeach", e durante Chol HaMoed de Sukot e Pesach, alguns têm o costume de recitar o salmo do festival em vez de "Lamenatzeach".

(Tehilim 67). Lamenatzeach binginot mizmor shir. Elohim yechonenú viverachenu, yaír panav itanu selá. Ladáat baaretz darkecha, bechol goyim yeshuatecha. Yoducha amim Elohim, yoducha amim culam. Yismechu viranenu leumim ki tishpot amim mishor uléumim baaretz tanchem selá. Yoducha amim Elohim, yoducha amim culam. Eretz natnah yevulah, yevarecheinu Elohim Eloheinu. Yevarecheinu Elohim veyiru oto chel afsei aretz.
Na véspera de Shabat, recita-se o salmo "Adonai Malach" em lugar de "Lamnatzeach".

(Tehilim 93). Yehovah malach, geut lavesh; labeish Yehovah oz hitazar; af tikon tevel bal timot. Nakhon kisacha meaz; meolam atah. Nas'u neharot Yehovah; nas'u neharot kolam; yisu neharot dachyam. Mikolot mayim rabim, adirim mishberei-yam; adir bammarom Yehovah. Edotecha neemnu meod; leveitcha naaveh-kodesh; Yehovah le'orech yamim.
Em um jejum coletivo, recita-se:

(Tehilim 102:1-2). Tefilá leani ki ia'tof velifnei Adonai yishpoch sichó. Adonai shim'á tefilati veshaavatí elécha tavó. Al tastir panecha mimeni beyom tzar li haté elai oznécha beyom ekra maher anéni. Ki cholú veashán Yamai veatzmotái kemoked nicharu. Huká kaeisev vayivash libi ki shachachti meachol lachmi. Mikol anchatí davaqa atzmi livshari. Damiti likat midbar hayiti ketzippor bodéd al gag. Col haiom cherpuni oyevai meholalái bi nishbau. Ki eifer kalechem achalti vesiquvai bivechi masachti. Mipnei za'amcha ve'kitzefecha ki nesatani vatashlichéni. Yamai ketzel natui vaani ka'eisev ibash. Veata Adonai le'olam teshev vezichrecha ledor vador. Ata takum terachem Tzion ki et lechenenah ki va moed. Ki ratzu avadecha et avaneha ve'et afarah yechonenu. Veyiru goyim et shem Adonai vecol malchei ha'aretz et kevodecha. Ki vaná Adonai Tzion nirá bichvodo. Paná el tefilat ha'ar'ar velo vazá et tefilatam. Tikatev zot ledor acharón ve'am nivrá yehalel Yah. Ki hishkip mimrom kodesh Adonai mishamaim el eretz hibit. Lishmoa enkat asir lefateach benei temutá. Lesaper betzion shem Adonai ut'hilato birushaláim. Behikabetz amim yachdav umamlachot la'avod et Adonai. Iná baderech cochi kitza yamai. Omaír Eli al ta'aléni bachatsi yamai bedor dorim shnotécha. Lifaním ha'aretz yasadta ume'asei yadecha shamayim. Hemá yovédú veata ta'amod veculám kabeged yivlu kalbush tachalifém veyachalifu. Veata hu ushnotécha lo yitamu. Benei avadecha yishkonu vezar'am lefanecha yikon.
E dizem o Kaddish "Yehê Shlamei".

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemêh rabá. [Amên] Bealma divra, kirvuteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkanêh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amên] Bechayêchon uvêyomeichon uvêchayê dechol beit Yisra'el, baagalá uvizman kariv, veimru amên. [Amên] Yehê shemêh rabá mevarach lealam ulalmê almayá yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyitaaleh. Veyithalal shemêh dekudsha, bêrich hu. [Amên] Leela min chol birchatá, shiratá, tishbachatá venechematá, daamiran bealma, veimru amên. [Amên].

Yehê shlamá raba min shmaya. Chayim vesava viyshuá venechamá. Veshezava urefuá ugeulá uselichá vechapará veravach vehatzalá lanu ulechol amo Yisra'el. Veimru amên. [Amên]. Osseh shalom bimromav. Hu berachamav yaaseh shalom aleinu veal kol amo Yisra'el. Veimru amên. [Amên]
Alenu: Alênu leshebeach laAdon haKol, latent gëduláh liYotser bërashit, shelo asanu këgoyêi haaratzot, velo samanu këmishp'chot haadamah, shëlo sam chelqenu cahem ugoraleinu këchol hamonam, sheheim mish'tachavim lahëvel varik, umitpalelim el-El lo yoshia. Va'anachnu mishtachavim lifnei Melech malkêi hamëlachim hakadosh Baruch Hu, shëhu noteh shamayim veyosëd aretz, umoshav yëkaro bashamayim mima'al, ush'chinat uz'o bigvohêi mëromim. Hu Eloheinu, ve'ein od acher, emet malkeinu ve'efes zulato. Kachkatuv baTorah. Veyadata hayom vahasheivota el lëvavecha ki Adonai hu haElohim bashamayim mima'al ve'al ha'aretz mitachat ein od.

Al kein nekaveh lach, Adonai Eloheinu, lireot meheirah betif'eres uz'cha, leha'avir gilulim min ha'aretz, veha'elilim carot yichar'tun, letaken olam bemalchut Sha'dai, vechol bnei basar yikreu vishmecha, lehafnot eilecha chol rish'ei aretz. Yachiru veyedu chol yosh'vei teivel, ki lecha tichra chol berech, tishava chol lashon. Lefanecha, Adonai Eloheinu yichre'u vayipolu, velichvod shimecha yekar yiteinu, vikablu cholam et ol malchutecha, vetimloch aleihem meheirah le'olam va'ed. Ki hamalchut shelcha hi, ule'olmei ad timloch bechavod. Kachkatuv beToratecha: Adonai yimloch le'olam va'ed. Vene'emar: Vehayah Adonai lemelech al kol ha'aretz, bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ushemo echad.
Uv'Toratecha Adonai Eloheinu katuv le'emor: Shema Yisra'el, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai Echad.

Barchu: Tefilat Arvit para Dias de Semana.
Na noite de Rosh Chodesh, há aqueles que têm o costume de recitar.

Bar'chi (Salmos 104) nafshi et Adonai. Adonai Elohai gadalta me'od, hod vehadar lavashta. Oteh ohr kasalma, noteh shamayim kay'ria. Hamakareh bamayim aliyotav, hasam avim rechubo, ham'halech al canfei ruach. Oseh mal'achav ruhot, mesharsav eish lohet. Yasad eretz al mechoneha, bal timot olam va'ed. Tehom kal'lavush kisitah, al harim ya'amdu mayim. Min ga'arat'cha yenusu, min kol ra'am'cha yechafzu. Ya'alu harim yerdu v'kayot, el mekom zeh yasadta lahem. Gvul samta bal ya'avru, bal y'shuvu l'chasot ha'aretz. Ham'shale'ach ma'ayanim ban'chalim, bein harim y'halchu. Yashku chol chayat sadei, yishbru f'ra'im tz'mam. Aleihem of hashamayim yishkon, mibein ofayim yitnu kol. Mashke harim me'al'yotav, mipri ma'asecha tisba ha'aretz. Matzmich chatzir lab'heimah, v'esev la'avodat ha'adam, l'hotzi lechem min ha'aretz. V'yayin y'same'ach l'vav enosh, l'hats'il panim mishemen, ulechem l'vav enosh yis'ad. Yisbe'u atzei Adonai, arzei L'vanon asher nata. Asher sham tziforim y'kanenu, chasidah b'roshim beita. Harim hag'vohim lay'elim, s'la'im machseh lashfanim. Asah yare'ach l'mo'adim, shemesh yada mevo'o. Taset chosech vihi laylah, vo tirmos kol chayato ya'ar. Hach'firim sho'agim lateref, ul'vakesh mei'el ochlam. Tizrach hashemesh ye'asefun, ve'el m'onotam yirbatzun. Yetze adam l'fa'olo, ul'avodato adé-arév. Mah rabu ma'asecha Adonai, kulam b'chochma asita, mal'ah ha'aretz kinyanecha. Zeh hayam gadol, urechav yadáyim, sham remes ve'ein mispar, chayot k'tanot im g'dolot. Sham aniyyot y'halchu, livyatán zeh yatzarta l'sacheik bo. Kulam eilecha y'sab'reun, latet ochlam b'ito. Titén lahem yilkotun, tiftach yad'cha yisbe'un tov. Tastir fanecha yivahelu, toséf ru'acham yigva'un, ve'el afar'am y'shuvun. T'shallach ru'achá yibare'un, ut'chadesh p'nei adama. Y'hi chevod Adonai l'olam, yismach Adonai b'ma'asav. Hamabit l'aretz vatireid, yigga be'harim v'ye'ashanu. Ashira laAdonai b'chai, azammera l'Elohai b'odi. Ye'arév alav sichi, anochi esmach baAdonai. Yitamu chata'im min ha'aretz, u'r'sha'im od einam. Bar'chi nafshi et Adonai, halleluya.

Leshem yichud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchinteih, bidchilu urechimu, urechimu udchilu, leyachda shem Yod Kei Vav Kei beyichuda shleim, beshem col Yisra'el, hineh anachnu ba'im lehitpalel tefilat arvit shetiken Ya'akov avinu aleih hashalom, im col hamitzvot hach'lulot bah, letaken et shorshah bemakom elyon, la'asot nachat ru'ach leyotz'renu ula'asot retzon boreinu. "Vihi no'am Adonai Eloheinu aleinu uma'aseh yadeinu chonenah aleinu uma'aseh yadeinu chonen'hu. (Repita duas vezes).".
Adonai tzevaot imanu misgav lanu Elohei Yaakov selá. Adonai tzevaot asheri adam botéach bach. Adonai hoshia hamélech yaanenu beyom korenu.
E o chazan diz o Chatsi Kaddish.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabba. [Amen] Bealma divra, kirvuteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amen] Bechayeychon uv'yomeychon uv'chayey dechol beit Yisra'el, baagala uvizman kariv, veimru amen. [Amen] Yehê shemeh rabba mevarach lealam ulalmey almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyitalleh. Veyithallal shemeh dekudsha, brikh hu. [Amen] Leela min chol birkhata shirata, tushbchata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru amen. [Amen].
Vehu rachum yechaper avon velo yashchit vehirba lehashiv apo velo ya'ir chol chamato. Yehovah hoshiah hamel ech ya'aneinu beyom koreinu.
E o chazan diz: "Barechu et Adonai hamvorach."
E o kahal responde: "Baruch Adonai hamvorach le'olam va'ed".
E o chazan diz: "Baruch Adonai hamvorach le'olam va'ed".
The Shema: Shemá e suas Bênçãos.

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu melech haolam, asher bidvaro maariv aravim bechochmah, pocheach shaarim bitevunah, meshaneh ittim, u machalif et hazmanim, u mesader et haccocavim bemishmeroteihem barakia, kirchonô. Borei yomam valailah, golel or mipnei chosech vechoshech mipnei or. Hamaavir yom umevi lailah, u mabdil bein yom uvein lailah, Adonai tzevaot shemo. Baruch ata Adonai, hamaariv aravim.

Ahavat olam beit Yisra'el amecha ahavta, Torá u mitzvot chukim u mishpatim otanu limadta, al kein Adonai Eloheinu, beshochbenu uvekumenu nasiach bechukecha, venismach vene'aloz bedivre talmut Toratecha u mitzvotecha vechukotecha leolam va'ed, ki hem chayeinu ve'orech yameinu, uvahem nehageh yomam valailah, ve'ahavatcha lo tasur mimenu le'olamim. Baruch ata Adonai, ohev et amo Yisra'el.

Antes de recitar a Leitura do Shemá, deve ter a intenção de cumprir o mandamento positivo de recitar o Shemá duas vezes ao dia e também ter a intenção de cumprir o mandamento positivo de unificar o Nome. Fechará os olhos com sua mão direita no primeiro versículo até que complete “Baruch Shem”, e assim está escrito: “Shemá Yisrael” – ou seja, aceite estas palavras, compreenda-as e saiba que você crê nelas, pois Hashem é o nosso Elohim. E ainda, Ele é o único Hashem. Assim, há neste ato tanto uma aceitação quanto uma confissão em dois aspectos: o primeiro é a aceitação do Reino dos Céus, ao dizer “Hashem Eloheinu”, o que significa admitir que aceitamos Sua divindade para ser nosso Elohim e nós servimos a Ele; o segundo é o conceito da unicidade do Nome ao declarar “Hashem Echad”, que Ele é sem qualquer associação [com outro] (Berachot 13b).
Shema Yisra'el, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai echad.
Em voz baixa: Baruch Shem kevod Malchuto le’olam va’ed.

Ve'ahavta (Devarim 6:5) et Adonai Elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol me'odecha. Vehayu hadevarim ha'eileh asher anochi metzavecha hayom al levavecha. Ve'shinantam levanecha vedibarta bam beshivtecha be'veitecha uvlechtecha va'derech uvshachbecha uvkumecha. Ukshartam le'ot al yadecha vehayu letotafot bein einecha. Uchetavtam al mezuzot beitecha uvish'arecha.

Vehaya (Devarim 11:13) im shamoa tishme'u el mitzvotai asher anochi metzaveh etchem hayom le'ahavah et Adonai Eloheichem ule'avdo bechol levavchem uvechol nafshechem. Venatati metar artzechem be'ito yoreh umalkosh ve'asaf'ta deganecha vetirosh'cha veyitzharecha. Venatati eisev besadecha livhemtecha ve'achalta vesava'ta. Hisamru lachem pen yiftah levavchem vesartem va'avadetem Elohim acheirim vehishtachavitem lahem. Vecharah af Adonai bachem ve'atzar et hashamayim velo yihyeh matar veha'adamah lo titen et yevulah va'avadtem meheirah me'al ha'aretz hatovah asher Adonai noten lachem. Vesamtem et devarai eleh al levavchem ve'al nafshechem ukshartem otam le'ot al yedchem vehayu letotafot bein eineichem. Velimad'tem otam et bneichem ledaber bam beshivtecha be'veitecha uvlechtecha va'derech uvshachbecha uvkumecha. Uchetavtam otam al mezuzot beitecha uvish'arecha. Lem'an yirbu yemeichem viyemei vneichem al ha'adamah asher nishba Adonai la'avoteichem latet lahem kiymei hashamayim al ha'aretz.

Vayomer (Bamidbar 15:37) Adonai el Moshe leimor. Daber el Bnei Yisra'el ve'amarta aleihem ve'asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vigdeihem ledorotam venatnu al tzitzit hakanaf patil techelet. Vehaya lachem letzitzit ure'item oto uzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai va'asitem otam velo taturu acharei levavchem ve'acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem. Lem'an tizkeru va'asitem et kol mitzvotai viheyitem kedoshim le'Eloheichem. Ani Adonai Eloheichem asher hotzeiti etchem me'eretz Mitzrayim lihyot lachem le'Elohim ani Adonai Eloheichem. Emet. E o chazan repete: Adonai Eloheichem emet.

Ve'emunah kol zot ve'kayam aleinu, ki hu Adonai Eloheinu ve'ein zulato, ve'anachnu Yisra'el ammo. Hafodeinu miyad melachim, hago'eleinu malkeinu mikaf kol aritzim, ha'El hanifra lanu mitzareinu, hamashalem gemul lechol oyvei nafsheinu. Hasam nafsheinu bachayim, velo natan lamot ragleinu, hamadrichenu al bamot oyveinu, vayarem karnenu al kol soneinu. Ha'El ha'oseh lanu nekamah befaraoh, be'otot uv'mofetim be'admat bnei Cham. Hamachah be'evrato kol bechori Mitzrayim, vayotzi et amo Yisra'el mitocham lecheirut olam. Hama'avir banav bein gizrei Yam Suf, ve'et rodfeihem ve'et soneihem bitehomot tib'a. Ra'u vanim et gevurato, shibchu vehodu lishmo, u'malchuto beratzon kiblu aleihem. Moshe u'vnei Yisra'el lecha anu shirah besimchah rabah, ve'amru kulam. Mi chamocha ba'elim Adonai, mi kamocha ne'edar bakodesh, nora tehilot osseh fele. Malchutecha Adonai Eloheinu ra'u banecha al hayam, yachad kulam hod'u vehimlichu ve'amru. Adonai yimloch le'olam va'ed. Vene'emar. Ki fada Adonai et Ya'akov, uge'alo miyad chazak mimenu. Baruch ata Adonai, ga'al Yisra'el.

Hashkiveinu Avinu l'shalom, veha'amideinu Malkeinu l'chayim tovim ul'shalom. Ufroshe aleinu sukkat shlomecha, vetakneinu Malkeinu be'etzah tovah milfanecha, vehoshi'einu meheirah lema'an shemecha. Vehagen ba'adeinu, vehaser me'alenu makkat oyeiv, dever, cherev, cholim, tzarah, ra'ah, ra'av, veyagon, umashchit, umageifah. Shevor vehaser hasatan mill'faneinu ume'achareinu, uv'tzel c'nafecha tastireinu, ush'mor tzeiteinu uvo'einu l'chayim tovim ul'shalom me'atah v'ad olam. Ki El shom'reinu u'matzileinu atah mikol davar ra umipachad laylah. Baruch ata Adonai, shomer et amo Yisra'el la'ad. Amen.
E o chazan diz o Chatzi Kaddish.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabba. [Amen] Bealma divra, kirvuteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amen] Bechayeychon uvyomeychon uvchayey dechol beit Yisrael, baagalá uvizman kariv, veimru amen. [Amen] Yehê shemeh rabba mevorach lealam ulalmey almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasse. Veyithadar. Veyitalleh. Veyithallal shemeh dekudsha, brikh hu. [Amen] Leela min chol birkhata shirata, tushbchata venechamata, daamiran bealma, veimru amen. [Amen].
Amidah: Tefilat Amidá para Dia de Semana.
Adonai sefatay tiftach ufí yagíd tehilátecha.

Baruch ata Adonai, Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, Elohei Avraham, Elohei Yitzchak, veElohei Yaakov. HaEl hagadol hagibor vehanora, El elyon, gomel chasadim tovim, koneh hakol, vezocher chasdei avot, umevi goel livnei veneihem lemaan shemo beahava. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá recitamos: " Zachrénu lachayim, mélech chaféts bachayim, katvénu vesefer chayim, lemaanchá Adonai Elohim".
Atta gibor leolam Adonai, mechayeh metim atta, rav lehoshia.
No verão: Morid HaTal. No inverno: Mashiv HaRuach U'Morid HaGeshem.

Mekhalkhel chayim bechesed, mechayeh metim berachamim rabbim, someich nophlim, verofê cholim, umatir asurim, umekayem emunato liyshenei afar. Mi chamocha ba'al gevurot, umi dome lecha, melech memit umechayeh umatzmiach yeshuah. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: Mi Chamocha Av HaRachaman, Zocher Yetzurav B’rachamim L’chayim. Vene'eman atah lehachayot metim. Baruch ata Adonai, mechayeh hametim.
Atah kadosh vesheimcha kadosh, ukedoshim bechol yom yehalelucha selah. Baruch ata Adonai, ha'El hakadosh. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: HaMelech HaKadosh.
Atta chonen leadam daat umelamed leenosh binah.
Após o Shabat e o Yom Tov dizemos:

Atta chonantanu Adonai Eloheinu madaat vehaskel, ata amarta lehavdil bein kodesh lechol uvein or lechoshech uvein Yisra'el la'amim, uvein yom hashvi'i lesheishes yemei ha'ma'aseh. Kesheim shehivdalta Yisra'el Adonai Eloheinu me'ammei ha'aratzot umimishpechot ha'adamah, chach padeinu vehatzileinu misatan ra umifeg'a ra, umichol gezerot kashot ver'ot hamitragshót lavo va'olam.
Vechaneinu me'itecha chochmah binah vedaat. Baruch ata Adonai, chonen haddaat.
Hashiveinu Avinu letoratecha, vekareveinu Malkeinu la'avodatecha, vehachazireinu bitshuvah sheleimah lefanecha. Baruch ata Adonai, harotze bitshuvah.
Selach lanu Avinu ki chatanu, mechol lanu Malkeinu ki pasha'anu, ki El tov vesalach ata. Baruch ata Adonai, chanun hamarbeh lisloach.
Reê na beonênu, verivá rivênu, umaheir legaaleinu geulá shlemá lemaan shemêcha, ki El goel chazák atá. Baruch ata Adonai, goel Yisraêl.

Refáeinu Adonai veneirafê, hoshíeinu venivashêah, ki tehilatênu atá, vehaaleh aruchá umarpe lechol tachaluênu ulechol machovênu ulechol makkotênu. Ki El rofe rachmán venéeman atá. Baruch ata Adonai, rofe cholê amo Yisraêl.
No verão:

Barênu Adonai Eloheinu bechol maasei yadeinu, uvarêch shenatênu betallei ratzon berachá unedavá, utêhi acharitá chayim vesava veshalom cashanim hatovot livrachá, ki El tov umetib atá umevarech hashanim. Baruch ata Adonai, mevarech hashanim.
No inverno:

Barêch aleinu Adonai Eloheinu et hashaná hazot veet kol minei tevuatá letová, veten tal umatar livrachá al col penei haadamá, veraveh pnei tevel vesava et haolam culó mituvecha, umalei yadeinu mibrichotecha umeosher matnot yadecha. Shomrá vehatzilá shaná zot michol davar ra, umichol minei mashchit umichol minei puraniut, veaseh lá tikvá tová veacharit shalom. Chus verachem aleha veal col tevuatá ufeiroteha, uvarechá begishmei ratzon berachá unedavá, utêhi acharitá chayim vesava veshalom. Cashanim hatovot livrachá, ki El tov umetib atá umevarech hashanim. Baruch ata Adonai, mevarech hashanim.
Teka beshofar gadol lecheruteinu, vesa nes lekabetz galuyoteinu, vekebetzeinu yachad me'arba kanfot haaretz leartzeinu. Baruch ata Adonai, mekabetz nidchei amo Yisraêl.

Hashivah shofteinu kivarishonah, veyoatzeinu kevatchilah, vehaseir mimenu yagon vaanachah. Umeloch aleinu meheirah atah Adonai levadcha, bechesed uverachamim, betzedek uvemishpat. Baruch atah Adonai, melech ohev tzedakah umishpat. Durante os dez dias de Teshuvá dizemos: HaMelech HaMishpat.

Lamminim velamalshinim al-tehi tikvah, vechol-hazedim kerégua yovedu, vechol-oyvecha vesoneicha meheirah yikaretu, umalchut harishah meheirah teaker uteshaver uchalem vetachniehem bimeheirah beyameinu. Baruch ata Adonai, shover oyvim umachnia minim.

Al hatsadikim veal hachasidim, veal sheerit amechá beit Yisraél, veal pleitát beit sofrehem, veal geirei hatzedek vealeinu, yehemu na rachamecha, Adonai Eloheinu, veten sachar tov lechol habotcheim beshimcha beemet, vesim chelekenu itam. Uleolam lo nevosh ki vecha vatanchu, veal chasdecha hagadol beemet nisheanenu. Baruch ata Adonai, mishean umichtach latsadikim.
Tishkón betóch Yerushaláyim irêcha kaasher dibbarta, vechissé David avdêcha meherá betócha tachín, uvne otáh binyán olám bemheirá beyamênu. Baruch ata Adonai, boneh Yerushaláyim.
Et tsemach David avdêcha meherá tatzmích, vekarnó tarum biyeshuatêcha, ki liyeshuatêcha kivvinu chol hayom. Baruch ata Adonai, matzmich keren yeshuá.

Shema kolênu, Adonai Eloheinu, Av harachaman, racheim aleinu, veqabel berachamim uvratzon et tefilateinu, ki El shomea tefilot vetchanunim atah. Umilfanêcha malkeinu, reikam al teshivênu, chanênu vaaneinu ushema tefilateinu.

Em Tisha B'Av, alguns dizem: Aneinu Avinu, aneinu beyom tsom hataanit hazeh, ki vetzarah gedolah anachnu. Al tefen lersheinu, veal titallam malkeinu mibakashateinu. Heye nah karov leshevateinu. Terem nikra elecha atah taaneh, nedaber veatah tishma, kadavar sheneemar: vehayah terem yikru vaani eeneh, od hem medabrim vaani eshma. Ki atah Adonai podeh umatzil veoneh umerachem bechol et tzarah vetsukah.

Versão de "Aneinu" para os três jejuns (baseado em Sanhedrin 26b). Anenu Avinu, anenu beyom tzom hata'anit hazeh ki vetzarah gedolah anachnu. Al kol asher chatanu, avinu, pashanu anachnu va'avoteinu, ve'al yedei zeh charvah ir'einu vesha'mem mikdasheinu. Oy va'avoy lanu ki avonoteinu hitu eleh u'fshaeinu he'arichu kitzteinu. Ein lanu peh lehashiv velo metzach leharim rosh, u'chmo tza'ar benafsheinu al churban Beit Hamikdash uvittul Torah va'avodah zeh kamah me'ot shanim vezeh tza'ar hashamayim, ahahh alaynu. Lachen atah shavnu eilecha bevo'shet vecherpah uchlimah uvedema lev nevakshah me'Eloheinu meracheim. Ana Adonai, yehi ratzon milefaneycha Adonai Eloheinu ve'Elohei avoteinu, sheyehi mi'ut chelevainu vedameinu hamitma'et beta'aniteinu hayom kachelvei munach al gabei hamizbe'ach, sheet'chappr bo chol chatoteinu avonoteinu ufshaeinu. Ha'er panecha al mikdashecha hashameim lema'an Adonai, uva letziyon go'el. Al tefen lerisheinu, ve'al tit'allem Malkeinu mibakashateinu. Heyeh na karov lesha'avateinu. Terem nikra eilecha atah ta'aneh, nedabber ve'atah tishma, kadavar shene'emar: vehayah terem yikra'u va'ani e'eneh, od hem medabrim va'ani eshma. Ki atah Adonai podeh umatzil ve'oneh umeracheim bechol et tzarah vetzukah.
Ki atah shome'a tefillat kol peh: Baruch atah Adonai, shome'a tefillah.

Ratzeh Adonai Eloheinu be'ammecha Yisrael velitfillatam she'ah, vehashiv ha'avodah lidvir beitecha, ve'ishei Yisrael utfillatam, meherah be'ahavah tekabel beratzon, utehi leratzon tamid avodat Yisrael ammecha.
No início do mês e em Chol HaMoed dizem:

Eloheinu ve'Elohei avoteinu, ya'aleh ve'yavo, ve'yagia ve'yera'eh, ve'yeratzeh ve'yishama, ve'yifkedei ve'yizakeir, zikhronenu ve'zikhron avoteinu, zikhron Yerushalayim ircha, ve'zikhron Mashiach ben David avdecha, ve'zikhron kol ammecha Beit Yisrael lefanecha, lifleitah, letovah, le'chen, le'chesed u'l'rachamim, le'chayim tovim u'leshalom, beyom.
No início do mês: "Rosh Chodesh hazeh,"
Em Chol HaMoed de Pesach: "Chag HaMatzot hazeh, beyom mikra kodesh hazeh,"
Em Chol HaMoed de Sukkot: "Chag HaSukkot hazeh, beyom mikra kodesh hazeh,"

Lerachem bo aleinu ulehosheinu. Zochreinu Adonai Eloheinu bo letovah, ufadekeinu bo livrachah, vehoshieinu bo lechayim tovim, bidvar yeshuah verachamim. Chus ve'chanenu, vachamol verachem aleinu, vehoshieinu ki eilecha eineinu, ki El Melech chanun verachum atah.
Ve'atah berachamecha harabim, tachpots banu vetirtzeinu, vetechazeynah eineinu beshuvcha letzion berachamim: Baruch atah Adonai, hamachazir shechinato letzion.
Na bênção "Modim" (Ação de Graças), deve-se inclinar ao dizer "Modim" e erguer-se ao pronunciar o Nome [Divino]. (Ben Ish Chai, Shemot, Bo 21).

Modim anachnu lach, she'atah hu Adonai Eloheinu ve'Elohei avoteinu le'olam va'ed, tzureinu tzur chayeinu u'magen yisheinu atah hu, le'dor va'dor nodeh lach u'nesaper tehilatecha, al chayeinu ha'mesurim be'yadecha, ve'al nishmoteinu ha'pekudot lach, ve'al nisecha she'b'chol yom imanu, ve'al nifle'otecha ve'tovotecha she'b'chol et, erev va'vo'ker ve'tzohorayim. Ha'tov, ki lo chalu rachamecha, ha'merachem, ki lo tamu chasadecha, ki mei'olam kivvinu lach.
Em Chanucá e Purim dizem:
Al hanissim ve'al hapurkan ve'al hagevurot ve'al hateshuot ve'al haniflaot ve'al hanechamot she'asita la'avoteinu bayamim hahem bazman hazeh:

Em Chanucá dizem: Bimei Matityahu ben Yochanan Kohen Gadol, Chashmonai u'vanav, keshe'amdah malchut Yavan har'sha'ah al ammecha Yisrael, leshachecham Toratecha uleha'aviram meichukei retzonecha. Ve'atah berachamecha harabim amadta lahem be'eit tzaratam, ravta et rivam, danta et dinam, nakamta et nikmatam, masarta giborim be'yad chalashim, verabim be'yad me'atim, uredashim be'yad tzadikim, uteme'im be'yad tehorim, vezedim be'yad osekai Toratecha. Lecha asita shem gadol vekadosh be'olamecha, ule'ammecha Yisrael asita teshu'ah gedolah u'purkan kehayom hazeh. Ve'achar kach ba'u vaneicha lider beitecha, ufinu et heichalecha, vetiharu et mikdashecha, vehidliku nerot be'chatzrot kodshecha, ve'kav'u shemonat yemei Chanukah eilu behallel uvehoda'ah. Ve'asita imahem nissim veniflaot, vene'odeh lishimcha hagadol selah.

Em Purim dizem: Bimei Mordechai ve'Esther b'Shushan habirah, keshe'amad aleihem Haman harasha, bikesh lehashmid, la'harog ule'abed et kol haYehudim mi'na'ar ve'ad zaken, taf ve'nashim, beyom echad, bishloshah asar lechodesh shneim asar, hu chodesh Adar, u'shelalam lavoze. Ve'atah berachamecha harabim hefarta et atzato ve'kilklta et machashto, v'hashevota lo gemulo b'rosho, ve'talu oto ve'et banav al ha'etz. Ve'asita imahem nes va'pele, vene'odeh lishimcha hagadol selah.

Ve'al kullam yitbarach, veyitromam, veyitnasei, tamid shimcha malkeinu, le'olam va'ed. Vechol hachayim yoduchah selah. Nos dez dias de Teshuvá dizem: "Uchtev l'chayim tovim kol b'nei beritecha." Viyehallu viyvarechu et shimcha haggadol be'emeth le'olam ki tov, ha'el yeshu'atenu ve'ezratenu selah, ha'el hatov. Baruch atah YHVH, hatov shimcha ulecha na'eh lehodot.

Sim shalom tovah uverachah, chayim chen vachesed verachamim, aleinu ve'al kol-Yisra'el amecha. Uvarcheinu Avinu kulano ke'echad be'or panecha, ki ve'or panecha natata lanu Adonai Eloheinu Toráh vechayim, ahavah vachesed, tzedakah verachamim, berachah veshalom. Vetov be'einecha levarecheinu ulevarech et-kol-amcha Yisra'el, berov oz veshalom. Nos dez dias de Teshuvá dizem: "Uv'sefer chayim, b'rachah v'shalom, u'parnasah tovah viyshuah v'nechamah, u'gezerot tovot, nizakeir v'nikateiv l'fanecha, anachnu v'chol am'cha Beit Yisra'el, l'chayim tovim." Baruch Atah Adonai, hamevarech et amo Yisra'el bashalom. Amen.
Yihyu leratzon imrei-fi vehagyon libi lefanekha Adonai tzuri vegoralí.

Elohai, netzor leshoni meirá ve sifatái mi dabér mirma, velimkalai nafshi tidom, venafshi ke afar lachol tihie, petach libi betoratecha, ve acharé mitzvotecha tirdef nafshi. Vechol ha kamim alai leraá, meheirá haref atzatam ve kalkeil machshavotam. 'Yihyu kemo chaff lifnei ruach umalákh Adonai docheh. Kabel rinat amecha. Sagbeinu tahareinu nora.' Asseh lema'an shemácha, Asseh lema'an yemínácha, Asseh lema'an Toratácha, Asseh lema'an kedushatácha.
É uma prática valorosa recitar um versículo que começa e termina com a mesma letra com a qual o nome da pessoa começa e termina: "L'ma'an yeichaltzun y'didecha, hoshia y'mincha va'aneini."

'Yihyu leratzon imrei-fi vehegyon libi lefanécha, Adonai tzuri vegóali. Yehi ratzon milfanécha, Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetiten lanu chayim aruchim, chayim shel shalom, chayim shel tovah, chayim shel brachah, chayim shel parnassah, chayim shel chilutz atzamot, chayim sheyesh bahem yirat chet, chayim she'ein bahem bushah uchlimah, chayim shel osher vechavod, chayim sheteha vanu ahavat Torah veyirat shamayim, chayim shetemalle et chol mishalot libeinu letovah.'
Osseh shalom nos dez dias de Teshuvá diz: "HaShalom", bimeromav, Hu v'rachamav ya'aseh shalom aleinu, v'al kol amo Yisra'el, ve'imru amen.
'Yehi ratzon milefanécha, Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu, shetivneh Beit Hamikdash bimeheirah beyameinu, veten chelkeinu betoratecha la'asot chukei retzonecha ule'avdácha belebab shaleim.'
Yehi shem Adonai mevorach me'atah ve'ad olam. Mimizrach-shemesh ad mevo'o mehulal shem Adonai. Ram al kol-goyim Adonai, al hashamayim kevodo. Adonai Adoneinu, mah adir shimecha bechol-ha'aretz.
Em todas as noites dos dias comuns, exceto no Motza'ei Shabat, pula-se para o Kaddish Tiskabel.

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeh rabba. [Amein] Be'alma di vra, kir'uteh, veyamlich malchuteh, veyatzmach purkaneh, vikarev meshicheh. [Amein] Bechayeychon uv'yomeychon uv'chayei dechol beit Yisrael, ba'agala uvizman kariv, ve'imru amein. [Amein] Yehê shemeh rabba mevorach le'alam ul'almei almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpa'ar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyit'aleh. Veyithalal shemeh dekudsha, brikh hu. [Amein] Le'ela min kol birkhata shirata, tushb'chata venich'mata, da'amiran be'alma, ve'imru amein. [Amein].
No Motza'ei Shabat dizem:
Antes de "Shuvah", alguns têm o costume de dizer esta prece:

Hareini mechin atzmi lekabel or tosefet kedushat Shabbat limei hachol, ve'etkadesh bezrat Hashem yitbarach biméi hachol mikedushat haShabbat, kemo she'tzivanu Adonai Eloheinu betorato hakdoshah: vehitkadishtem viheyitem kedoshim, vihi ratzon milefanecha Adonai Elohai ve'Elohei avotai, she'yaaleh lefanecha ke'ilu ki vantí bechol hachavanot hare'uot lechaven bazeh.

Shuvah Adonai ad-matai, ve'hinachem al-avadécha. Savenu baboker chasdecha, u'nranena ve'nismecha be'chol-yamenu. Samecheinu kimot inítanu, shnot ra'inu ra'ah. Yera'eh el-avadécha fa'alécha, va'hadarcha al-bneihem. Vihi no'am Adonai Eloheinu aleinu, u'ma'aseh yadeinu chonenah aleinu, u'ma'aseh yadeinu chonenéhu.

Yosheb (Tehilim 91) beseter Elyon, betzel Shaddai yitalon. Omár la'Adonai machsi ume'tzudati, Elohai evtach-bo. Ki hu yatzilcha mipach yakush, midever havot. Be'avrato yasech lach, vetachat-chenafav techaseh; tzinah vesocherah emito. Lo tira mipachad laylah, mechetz ya'uf yomam. Midever ba'ofel yahaloch, mi'ketev yashud tzohorayim. Yipol mitzidecha elef, u'revavah miminecha; eilecha lo yigash. Rak be'einecha tabit, ushilumát resha'im tir'eh. Ki atah Adonai machsi, Elyon samta me'oncha. Lo te'uneh eilecha ra'ah, vene'egav lo-yikráv be'ohalecha. Ki mal'achav yetzaveh-lach, lishmorcha be'chol-derechecha. Al-kappayim yisa'uncha, pen-tigof ba'even raglecha. Al-shachal vafeten tidróch, tir'mos kefir vetannin. Ki vi chashak va'afal'tehu, asageveihu ki-yada shemi. Yikrá'eini ve'e'enehu, imo-ani betsarah achal'tzehu va'achbadéhu. Orech yamim asbi'ehu, ve'ar'éhu biyshu'ati.

Veatah Kadosh Yoshev Tehilot Yisrael. Vekara zeh el-zeh veamar Kadosh Kadosh Kadosh Adonai Tzevaot melo kol-haaretz kevodo. Umekablin dein min dein veamrin Kadish bishmei meroma ilaah beit shechinteh, Kadosh al ar'a osav gevurteh, Kadosh leolam uleolmei olmaya, Adonai Tzevaot malya kol ar'a ziv yikreh. Vatisaeni ruach vaeshma acharei kol ra'ash gadol Baruch kevod-Adonai mimkomo. Untalateni rucha ushma'it batrai kal zia saggi'a dimeshabechin veamrin, Barich yekara d'Adonai me'atar beit shechinteh, Adonai yimloch leolam va'ed. Adonai malchutei ka'im leolam uleolmei olmaya. Adonai Elohei Avraham Yitzchak veYisrael avoteinu shomerah-zot leolam leyetzer machshevot levav amecha vehachen levavam eleicha. Vehu rachum yechaper avon velo-yashchit vehirbah lehashiv apo velo-ya'ir kol-chamato. Ki-atah Adonai tov vesallach verav-chesed lekol-korecha. Tzidkatecha tzedek leolam vetoratecha emet. Titen emet leYaakov chesed leAvraham asher-nishba'ta la'avoteinu mimei kedem. Baruch Adonai yom yom ya'amas-lanu ha'El yeshuateinu selah. Adonai Tzevaot imanu misgav-lanu Elohei Yaakov selah. Adonai Tzevaot ashrei adam voteach bach. Adonai hoshia'h hamelech ya'anenu beyom-koreinu.

Baruch Eloheinu shebaraanu likhvodo, vehivdilanu min hatoim, venatan lanu Torat Emet, vechayei olam nata betocheinu. Hu yiftach libeinu betorato, veyasim belibeinu ahavato veyirato laasot retzono ulavdo belevav shaleim. Lo niga larik, velo neled labehala. Yehi ratzon milfanekha Adonai Eloheinu veElohei avoteinu shenishmor chukekha umitzvotecha baolam hazeh, venizkeh venichyeh venirash tovah uverachah lechayei haolam haba: Lemaan yezammerkha kavod velo yidom, Adonai Elohai leolam odeka. Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko, yagdil Torah veyaadir. Veyivtchu vekha yodei shemecha, ki lo azavta dorshekha Adonai. Adonai Adoneinu, mah adir shimcha bechol haaretz. Chizku veyaametz levavchem, kol hameyachalim laAdonai.
E o Hazan diz: "Kaddish tatkabel".

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeih raba. [Amen] bealmah di vera, kir'uteih, veyamlikh malkhuteih, veyatzmakh purkaneih, vikareiv meshikheih. [Amen] bechayei'khon uveyomei'khon uvechayei dechol beit Yisrael, ba'agala uvizman kariv, ve'imru amen. [Amen] Yehei shemeih raba mevarach le'alam ule'almei almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpa'ar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyit'aleh. Veyithalal shemeih dekudsha, barikh hu. [Amen] le'ela min kol birchata shirata, tushbechata venechemata, da'amiran be'alma, ve'imru amen. [Amen].
Titkabel tzelotana uva'utana, im tzelotehon uva'utehon dekol beit Yisrael, kodam Avuna dishmaya ve'ara, ve'imru amen. [Amen].
Yehe shelama raba min shemaya, chayim vesava vishuah venechamah, vesheizaba urefuah ugeulah uslichah vekapparah verevach vehatzalah lanu ulchol amo Yisrael. Veimru amen. [Amen].
Osseh shalom bimromav, hu berachamav yaaseh shalom aleinu veal kol amo Yisrael, veimru amen. [Amen].

Shir (Tehilim 121:1-2) Lama'alot essa einai el-heharim mei'ayin yavo ezri. Ezri mei'im Adonai, oseh shamayim va'aretz. Al-yitten lammot ragleycha al-yanum shomerecha. Hineh lo-yanum velo yishan shomer Yisrael. Adonai shomerecha Adonai tzilecha al-yad yeminecha. Yomam hashemesh lo-yakekha veyareach balaylah. Adonai yishmerekha mikol-ra yishmor et-nafshecha. Adonai yishmor-tzet'cha uvo'echa mei'attah ve'ad-olam.
E aqui dizem o Kadish "Yehé Shelama".

Yitgadal veyitkadash shemeih raba. [Amen] bealma di vera, kir'uteih, veyamlikh malkhuteih, veyatzmach purkaneih, vikarev meshicheih. [Amen] bechayeichon uveyomeichon uvechayei dechol beit Yisrael, baagala uvizman kariv, veimru amen. [Amen] Yehe shemeih raba mevarach lealam ulealmei almaya yitbarach. Veyishtabach. Veyitpaar. Veyitromam. Veyitnasei. Veyithadar. Veyitaleh. Veyithalal shemeih dekudsha, barikh hu. [Amen] le'ela min kol birchata shirata, tushbechata venechemata, daamiran bealma, veimru amen. [Amen].
Yehe Shlama Raba Min Shemaya, Chayim Vesava Vishuah Venechama, Veshezava Urefuah Ugeulah Uslichah Ukapparah Verevach Vehatzalah Lanu Ulechol Amo Yisrael. Veimru Amen. [Amen].
Osseh shalom bimromav, hu berachamav yaaseh shalom aleinu veal kol amo Yisrael. Veimru amen. [Amen].
Diz: Bare'chu et Adonai hamevorach.
E a congregação responde:  Baruch Adonai hamvorach leolam va'ed.
E repete: Baruch Adonai hamvorach leolam va'ed.
Alenu: Aleinu leshabeach laAdon hakol, latet gedulah leyotzer bereshit, shelo asanu kegoyei ha’aratzot, velo samanu kemishpechot ha’adamah, shelo sam chelkeinu kahem vegoralenu kechol hamonam, shehem mishtachavim lahevel varik, umitpalelim el el lo yoshia. Va’anachnu mishtachavim lifnei melech malchei hamelachim hakadosh baruch hu, shehu noteh shamayim veyosed aretz, umoshav yekaro bashamayim mima’al, ushchinat uzo begovhei meromim. Hu Eloheinu, ve’ein od acher, emet malkenu ve’efes zulato. Kakatuv baTorah: Veyada’ta hayom vehashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu ha’Elohim bashamayim mima’al ve’al ha’aretz mitachat, ein od.

Al ken nekaveh lach, Adonai Eloheinu, lir'ot meheirah betif'eret uzecha, leha'avir gilulim min ha'aretz, veha'elilim karot yikaretun, letaken olam bemalchut Shadai, vechol benei basar yikre'u vishmecha, lehafnot elecha kol rishei aretz. Yakiru veyede'u kol yoshvei tevel, ki lecha tichra kol berech, tishava kol lashon. Lefanecha, Adonai Eloheinu, yichre'u veyipolu, velichvod shimcha yekar yitenu, vikablu kulam et ol malchutecha, vetimloch aleihem meheirah leolam va'ed. Ki hamalchut shelcha hi, uleolmei ad timloch bechavod. Kakatuv betoratecha: Adonai yimloch leolam va'ed. Vene'emar: Vehayah Adonai lemelech al kol ha'aretz, bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ushemo echad.
Uvetoratecha Adonai Eloheinu katuv lemor. Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai Echad.

Counting of the Omer: Leshem Yichud Kudsha Berich Hu Ushchintei, Bidchilu Urchimu, Urchimu Udchilu, Leyached Shem Yod Kei BeVav Kei Beyichuda Sheleim, Beshem Kol Yisrael. Uveshem Kol Hanefashot Veruchot Veneshamot Hamityachasim El Shorshei Nafsheinu Verucheinu Venishmateinu Umalbusheihem Vehakrovim Lahem, Shemikhlalut Atzilut Beriyah Yetzirah Asiyah, Umikol Pratet Atzilut Beriyah Yetzirah Asiyah Depratet Uspirah Dipratet Atzilut Beriyah Yetzirah Asiyah. Hareini Muchan Umezuman Lekayem Mitzvat Aseh Shel Sefirat HaOmer Lispor Yamim Veshavuot Kaasher Tzivanu Adonai Eloheinu Betorato Hakkedoshah. (Na noite do 49º [dia], pule os versículos) 'Usfartem Lachem Mimacharat Hashabbat Miyom Haviachem Et Omer Hatnufah Sheva Shabbatot Temimot Tihiyenah: Ad Mimacharat Hashabbat Hashvi'it Tisperu Chamishim Yom Vehikravtem Minchah Chadashah LaAdonai. Vene'emar Shiv'ah Shavuot Tispor Lach Mehachel Cheresh Bakamah Tachel Lispor Shiv'ah Shavuot.' Laasot nachat ruach leyotzreinu velaasot retzon boreinu, asher kidshanu bemitzvotav vetzivanu bemitzvah zo, letaken shoresh mitzvah zo bemakom elyon beshiur komah, lehashlim ilan haelyon ulehashlim adam haelyon, ulehakim et-sukat David lehachazir atarah leyashnah, levarer uletaken ulhaalot kol-hanefashot veruhot veneshamot venitzotzei hakdushah shenafelu baklipah al-yedei adam harishon veal yadeinu, begilgulim eleh uvegilgulim acheirim ushe'erit harapach nitzotzin ulehashlim sheleimut tikun nafsheinu rucheinu venishmateinu shemiklelut atzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah, umikol-peratei atzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah dechol-partzuf usefirah difratei atzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah hamityachasim el tikun mitzvah zo, vegam lehashlim sheleimut tikun evrei nefashot ruchot uneshamot dechol-yisrael hachayim vehametim hachaserim metikun mitzvah zo. Vihi ratzon milfanekha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu, sheyihyeh atah et ratzon lefanekha lihiyot olah mitzvah zo letaken et-kol-pgameinu upgamei adam harishon asher pagamnu bichlelut atzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah, uvechol-tzalmei levushei nefesh ruach neshamah chayah yechidah daatzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah, uletzaref ulevareir ulehasir hasigim mitzalmei levushei nefesh ruach neshamah chayah yechidah dichlelut uperatut atzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah, ulevareir chelkei hanefesh shenifgamu venafelu benogah daatzilut beriah yetzirah asiyah, venogah ka'or tihyeh el mekom hakodesh. Ana Adonai hafred na mealeinu tzad hara shebayetzer hara, utezakecheinu utelabneinu bekoach hayetzer hatov, veyityachadu arba otiot hashem (Yud-Heh-Vav-Heh) baruch hu beyichuda shelim, veyihyu kiseh shalem asher bahem yitpashet shefa ein sof, veyityachadu Abba veImma beyichuda shelim (Yah-Havah) veyizdavegu (ZaN) tiferet umalchut zivuga shalem beshem (Yah-Adonai) umisham yimmashech shefa uverachah bechol-haolamot lezakech nafsheinu rucheinu venishmateinu sheyihyu reuyim leorer mayin nukvin ulehamshich mayin dechurin, veal-yeakev shum chet veavon vehirhur ra et-hamitzvah hazot, vetaaleh leratzon lereiach nichoach lefanekha Adonai Eloheinu veilohei avoteinu. Vihi ratzon milfanekha Adonai Elohai veilohei avotai, shebechoach mitzvat hasfirah hazot yetukan mah-shepagamti bisefirot zeir anpin venukveih shehem tiferet umalchut shel halaylah hazot. Vihi ratzon milfanekha sheyihyeh chashuv umekubal umerutzeh lefanekha haval hayotze mipinu behavarachah vehasfirah shel haomer, lehamshich or makif bamakom harauy kirzonekha, veyihyeh chashuv umekubal umerutzeh sich sifoteinu bevakashatenu al chazarat avodat beit hamikdash limekomah letaken beor penimi kirzonekha. Vihi noam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu umaaseh yadeinu konenah aleinu umaaseh yadeinu konenehu: (duas vezes). Ribon alamah, tivu saggi avadt im amakh Yisrael deitrerit behu bilchodayhu, vaavadt lehon amma yechidah vaalmah, vekarit lehon goy echad, viyhavt lehon orayta dikshot, upakadt lehon bekamma pikudin leitatra behu, viyhavt lehon cheila lemevad retzutakh. Uvit'aruta dilehon letata bemilim uveavada, yitar cheila le'ella. Ribon alamah anan ba'inan le'ishtadla vikarakh, yeheh ra'ava kamakh lemehav lan cheila leit'ara vikarakh, ulemevad retzutakh, ulesadra kolla kidka yaut. Veaf al gav delit anan yade'in leshavva retzuta veliba letakna kolla, yeheh ra'ava kamakh detitrei vemilin dilan, vetatkin tikuna dile'ella kidka yaut, utechashav lan ke'ilu ishtadlan vikarakh kirzutakh, lesadra kolla kidka yaut, uletakna vemilin dilan lehahu darga de'itzterich le'itakna. Vihi noam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu umaaseh yadeinu konenah aleinu umaaseh yadeinu konenehu: Lekhem Yichud Kudsha Berikh Hu Ushkhinteih, Bidkhilu Urkhimu, Urkhimu Udkhilu, Leyached Shem Yod Kei BeVav Kei Beyichuda Sheleim, Beshem Kol Yisrael. Hineh Anakhnu Ba'im Lekayem Mitzvat Aseh Shel Sefirat HaOmer Lispor Yamim VeShavuot Ka'asher Tzivanu Adonai Eloheinu Betorato Hakkedosha (Na noite de 49, pularão os versos.) 'Usefartem Lakhem Mimokhorat HaShabbat Miyom Haviakhem Et Omer Hatnufah Sheva Shabbatot Temimot Tihyenah: Ad Mimokhorat HaShabbat Hashvi'it Tisperu Chamishim Yom Vehikravtem Minchah Chadashah LaAdonai: Vene'emar Shiv'ah Shavuot Tispor Lekh Mehakhelel Khereshev Bakamah Takhel Lispor Shiv'ah Shavuot'. La'asot Nakhat Ru'ach Leyotzerenu Vela'asot Retson Boreinu. Veyihi No'am Adonai Eloheinu Aleinu Uma'aseh Yadeinu Konenah Aleinu Uma'aseh Yadeinu Konnehu: Adonai Yigmor Ba'adi Adonai Khasdekha Le'olam Ma'aseh Yadekha Al Teref: Ekra Le'Elohim Elyon La'El Gomer Alai: Vene'emar: Va'e'evor Alayikh Va'er'ekh Mitboseset Bedamayikh Va'omar Lakh Bedamayikh Khayi Va'omar Lakh Bedamayikh Khayi: Barkhi Nafshi Et Adonai Adonai Elohai Gadalta Me'od Hod Vehadar Lavashta: Oteh Or Kassalmah Noteh Shamayim Kayeri'ah.
O shats diz: "Birshut morai v'rabbota'i."  E a congregação responde: "Shamayim."
Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech HaOlam, Asher Kidshanu Bemitzvotav Vetzivanu Al Sefirat HaOmer. Hayom.

Harachaman Hu Yachazir Avodat Beit Hamikdash Limkomah Bimeherah Beyameinu Amen.

Lamnatze'ach (Tehilim 67:1-3) Bingenot Mizmor Shir. Elohim Yechonenu Veyevarecheinu Ya'er Panav Itanu Selah. Lada'at Ba'aretz Darkecha Bechol Goyim Yeshuatecha. Yoducha Amim Elohim Yoducha Amim Kulam. Yismechu Veyiranenu Le'umim Ki Tishpot Amim Mishor Ule'umim Ba'aretz Tanchem Selah. Yoducha Amim Elohim Yoducha Amim Kulam. Eretz Natnah Yevulah Yevarechenu Elohim Eloheinu. Yevarechenu Elohim Veyire'u Oto Kol Afsei Aretz.
Ana Becho'ach. Gedulat Yeminecha Tatir Tzerurah. (אב"ג ית"ץ)
Kabel Rinat. Amcha Sagevenu Taheram Nora. (קר"ע שט"ן)
Na Gibor. Dorshei Yichudecha Kevavat Shamrem. (נג"ד יכ"ש)
Barechem Taheram Rachamei Tzidkatecha Tamid Gamlem. (בט"ר צת"ג)
Chasin Kadosh. Berov Tuvecha Nahel Adatecha. (חק"ב טנ"ע)
Yachid Ge'ah. Le'amcha Peneh Zochrei Kedushatecha. (יג"ל פז"ק)
Shu'ateinu Kabel. Veshma Tza'akateinu Yode'a Ta'alumot. (שק"ו צי"ת)
Ve'omer Belachash: Baruch Shem Kevod Malchuto Le'olam Va'ed.
Blessing of the Moon: Birkat HaLevanah.

Lamnatzeach (Tehilim 19:1-3) Mizmor LeDavid. Hashamayim Mesaprim Kevod El, Umaaseh Yadav Magid Harakia. Yom Leyom Yabia Omer, Velayla Lelayla Yechaveh Daat. Ein Omer VeEin Devarim, Beli Nishma Kolam. Bechol HaAretz Yatza Kavvam, Uviktzei Tevel Mileihem. Lashemesh Sam Ohel Bahem. VeHu KeChatan Yotze MeChupato, Yasiss Kegibor Larutz Oraḥ. Miketze Hashamayim Motzao, Utekufato Al Ketotam, VeEin Nistar Mechamato. Torat Adonai Temimah Meshivat Nafesh, Edut Adonai Neemanah Machkimat Peti. Pikudei Adonai Yesharim Mesamchei Lev, Mitzvat Adonai Berah Meirat Einayim. Yirat Adonai Tehorah Omedet LaAd, Mishpetei Adonai Emet Tzedeku Yachdav. HaNechemadim Mizzahav UmiPaz Rav, Umetukim Midvash Venofet Tzufim. Gam Avdecha Nizhar Bahem, Beshomram Ekev Rav. Shegiot Mi Yavin, Ministarot Nakeni. Gam Mizedim Chasoch Avdecha, Al Yimsholu Vi Az Eitam, Venikeiti MiPesha Rav. Yihyu LeRatzon Imrei Fi, VeHegyon Libi Lefanecha, Adonai Tzuri VeGoali.
Tzuri BaOlam Hazeh VeGoali LaOlam Haba. VeChol-Karnei Resha'im Agade'a, Teromamnah Karnot Tzadik.

HaleluYah (Tehilim 148). Halelu Et-Adonai Min-Hashamayim, Haleluhu Bamromim. Haleluhu Kol-Malachav, Haleluhu Kol-Tzeva’av. Haleluhu Shemesh Veyare’ach, Haleluhu Kol-Kochvei Or. Haleluhu Shmei Hashamayim, VeHamayim Asher Me’al Hashamayim. Yehallelu Et-Shem Adonai, Ki Hu Tzivah Venivre’u. Vaya’amidem La’ad Le’olam, Chok-Natan VeLo Ya’avor.

Quando disser "Ki er'eh shim'cha ma'aseh etzba'otekha" [Êxodo 3:15], olhará para a lua; mas quando começar a recitar a bênção, não deve olhar para ela até o fim da liturgia(Baal Shem Tov, Vayikra, hakafah 23.).
Ki ereh shamecha maaseh etzbeotecha, yareach vechochavim asher konanta. Adonai Adoneinu, mah-adir shimcha bechol-haaretz.
Antes da bênção dirá:

Lesheim yichud Kudsha Brich Hu ushchinteh, bidchilu urchimu, urchimu udchilu, leyached Shem Yud-Kei beVav-Kei beyichuda shelim beshem kol Yisrael. Hineh anachnu baim levarech birkat halevanah kmo shetiknu lanu rabotenu zichronam livrachah, im kol hamitzvot haklulot bah, letaken et-shorshah bemakom elyon, laasot nachat ruach leyotzerenu velaasot retzon boreinu. Vihi noam Adonai Eloheinu aleinu umaaseh yadeinu konena aleinu, umaaseh yadeinu konenehu. (Duas vezes.).

Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech HaOlam, Asher BeMaamaro Bara Shechakim Uveruach Piv Kol Tzevaam, Chok Uzman Natan Lahem Shelo Yeshanu Et Tafkidam, Sassim USmechim Laasot Rtzon Koneihem, Poel Emet ShePeulato Emet, VelalLevana Amar SheTitchadesh, Ateret Tiferet LaAmusei Vaten, SheGam Hem Atidim LehitChadesh Kmotah ULfaer LeYotzram Al Shem Kevod Malchuto. Baruch Atah Adonai, Mechadesh Chodashim.
Besiman Tov Tehi Lanu ULchol Yisrael.
